jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.candidate_required_location: Anywhere in the World, New York
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York City
URL: https://sanctuary.computer

We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK — Media

At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

⛰️ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

️ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

 Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, here’s an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years →

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart” by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

‍ How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

We’re excited to hear from you! ❤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sanctuary-computer-head-of-technology-1

jobs.title: Delivery Manager and Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About us

Codurance is a leading IT professional services consultancy, helping clients continuously deliver value through the adoption of quality practices and expertise.

We have a culture of continuous learning which means that our people are continually progressing, while our clients are provided with teams that have the complete skill sets required.

We endeavour to provide sustainable software that stands the test of time, but also has a positive impact on both our people and our clients - high-quality software that our teams enjoy working on, and is secure and easy to use for clients.

About the role

We are looking for a Delivery Manager with Business Analyst experience and skillswho shares the same values of pragmatism, professionalism, and transparency. Working from anywhere in Spain, with remote clients, we support our clients in many ways and you will have the opportunity to work on a wide range of internal and client projects.

Perhaps you’ll oversee a client project with our team delivery approach. This may be a greenfield project for a startup or helping to build a mission-critical system for a large enterprise client. Maybe you’ll work with our embedded craftspeople, who are working within our client's existing development to help them to get better at writing their own software.

Responsibilities

  • Help the client and team create a shared vision and strategy
  • Translate the above into a roadmap and ultimately an effective backlog
  • Responsible for conducting resolution and helping the client find the right focus
  • Ensure that the team is fully equipped, focused, and supported to meet their commitments and align with the client's needs
  • Coach and mentor the team to create a cohesive, and healthy culture
  • Align the team towards meeting the goals of the clients and work closely with the client to create a healthy and trustful relationship
  • Your work will be based on sound reasoning, clear agreed KPIs, and a collaborative attitude
  • Help the team proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies to aid our success
  • Be the point of reference of Agile (and the different frameworks available) with regard to the team and client
  • Create and manage the budget for the project
  • Guarantee a successful delivery on time, scope, and budget

Requirements

In order to take ownership of delivery while empowering and equipping the team to optimise efforts you will need:

  • At least 5 years of experience working with software engineering teams (and are comfortable with being involved in high-level technical discussions)
  • Experience managing roadmaps and/or project plans
  • Excellent knowledge of Agile methodologies, processes and documentation
  • Strong people skills and stakeholder relationship management experience
  • Team player mindset with good leadership skills
  • Proficiency in English and Spanish (spoken and written)

Benefits

The gross annual salary range for this role is 45,000€ to 55,000 €.

  • Transparency - all of our salary bandings and company finances are available to everyone from day one.
  • Personal Learning Budget - Access to Learnerbly, our online learning & development tool, to support your personal development and career progression here.
  • Training - No fixed training budget. So long as the course is relevant for the company and you'll do a lightning talk on the subject, we’re happy to pay for it.
  • Working 100% remote (or hybrid if you want to drop by the office from time to time)
  • Private medical and dental insurance
  • Restaurant, transport and nursery tickets (retribución flexible/ tax deductible)
  • Gym discounts
  • Language classes (Spanish, English, French, German)
  • You choose between Linux, Mac or Windows!


We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the EU. However, we are not able to sponsor visas or provide relocation assistance for this role.

Everyone should have the right to bring their whole self to work and be celebrated for who they are. Our people are hired purely on their commitment to these values and their ambition to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Codurance is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

SAP Close Automation Consultant, Spain

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Spain. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

Hands-on design of an automated close in SAP Financial Closing cockpit, SAP AFC, BlackLine or Trintech Cadency. Balance sheet reconciliation, auto-certification, accruals and journal posting. SAP FI/CO. 8+ years' experience.

jobs.title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, L
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Liechtenstein

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Liechtenstein. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

jobs.title: Freight Dispatcher — Remote | Trip Planning
jobs.description:
Freight Dispatcher — Remote | Trip Planning

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Freight Operations

Put Your Transportation Experience to Work in Freight Dispatching

We are hiring a Freight Dispatcher — Remote to support U.S. trucking operations with a focus on trip planning, freight coordination, realistic scheduling, and driver communication.

This position may be a strong fit for transportation professionals, including experienced or former CDL-A drivers, who understand how mileage, driver Hours of Service, appointments, equipment, weather, routing, and freight requirements affect a successful trip.

Previous employment specifically under the title of Freight Dispatcher is not required. Applicants must have relevant U.S. trucking, transportation, logistics, or closely related operational experience.

Trip Planning & Freight Coordination

  • Review pickup and delivery appointments and determine whether proposed schedules are operationally realistic.
  • Evaluate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Consider driver location, available Hours of Service, equipment, routing, weather, and appointment requirements.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, excessive deadhead, unrealistic transit expectations, or other operational concerns.
  • Assist with planning freight around available driver hours and subsequent load requirements.
  • Coordinate pickup and delivery information with drivers and authorized transportation personnel.
  • Communicate schedule changes and transportation exceptions promptly.

Freight Evaluation & Load Boards

  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable U.S. freight load boards to search and evaluate available freight.
  • Compare freight based on lane, equipment type, mileage, rate, appointments, and operating requirements.
  • Identify freight that does not fit the assigned equipment, driver availability, or trip requirements.
  • Present suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.
  • Negotiate freight rates only when specifically authorized.
  • Review rate confirmations for accuracy and consistency with agreed load information.

Driver & Broker Communication

  • Communicate professionally with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, shippers, receivers, and transportation personnel.
  • Confirm pickup and delivery information.
  • Provide drivers with accurate load and trip information.
  • Monitor active freight and communicate relevant updates.
  • Maintain professional telephone, email, and digital communication.
  • Escalate safety, compliance, broker-verification, documentation, or service concerns when appropriate.

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Organize rate confirmations, bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, and related freight records.
  • Document appointment changes, delays, detention, layover, and other applicable transportation exceptions.

About Archer

Archer Review is a private equity-backed education technology company supporting medical and nursing students in their professional journeys. Our mission is to equip health care learners, educators and leaders with the knowledge, resources and confidence they need to succeed.

Archer Review has been recognized for four consecutive years by Inc. 5000 and for two years by Deloitte Technology Fast 500 as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the United States. We are a team of clinicians, educators, technologists, creatives and operators who truly believe that the work we do has a strong impact on making the world a better place.

About the role

Archer Review is looking for a Vice President of Finance to lead strategic finance and FP&A, working closely with the CFO and the executive team. You will own budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis, design our compensation plans, manage treasury, and lead financial diligence on growth opportunities. This is a hands-on, remote leadership role. It suits someone who is equally comfortable building a model, presenting to executives, and coaching a team.

What you'll do

  • Own the annual budget process end to end: work with department leaders, build the plan in Excel and Abacum, and present it for executive approval.
  • Lead monthly P&L forecasting and reforecasting, revenue scenarios and cash forecasting, and present results and outlook at monthly ELT and SLT meetings.
  • Review actual-vs-forecast results and variance analysis each month and turn them into clear insights and recommendations for leadership.
  • Design sales and management compensation plans with Sales and People Operations, and oversee commission, holdback and incentive statement calculations.
  • Manage treasury, including cash management, liquidity planning and banking relationships.
  • Lead financial diligence and modeling for M&A opportunities, and work with the Controller on integration planning.
  • Review customer, vendor, and legal contracts for financial terms, risk and impact on the forecast.
  • Improve reporting and analytics, including Abacum reporting, headcount reporting, and AR and KPI dashboards, so leaders can get answers on their own.
  • Lead and develop the FP&A team, and serve as backup to the CFO and Controller for executive reporting, budget review, and audit planning.

What we need from you

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics. MBA, CPA or CFA preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive finance experience, including 5+ years leading FP&A or strategic finance, ideally at a high-growth subscription, digital or education company.
  • Proven track record building budgets and rolling forecasts and presenting them to executive leadership, boards and investors.
  • Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel, plus experience with FP&A platforms & AI Modeling and cloud ERP systems.
  • Experience designing sales compensation and incentive plans that line up with company goals.
  • Experience with M&A diligence, integration and treasury or cash management.
  • Experience leading and developing remote teams, and the ability to explain financial results clearly to non-finance leaders.
  • Sound judgment, high integrity and discretion with confidential compensation and strategic information.

What success looks like

Our benefits

The fine print (PLEASE READ!)

Position Description

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’sBest Places to Work every year since 2014, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Responsibilities:

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. Physical Demands

Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. jobs.description:
About the company

Paid per approved task, about $100/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works ​

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $100/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

jobs.title: Product Manager:in (alle Identitäten)
jobs.description:
das erwartet dich

Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir verbinden moderne Technologie mit echter Menschlichkeit, damit Patient:innen nach einem Klinikaufenthalt nachhaltig gesund bleiben und Therapeut:innen spürbar entlastet werden.

Gemeinsam mit einem schlagkräftigen Team übernimmst du schrittweise die End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen zentralen Bereich unserer Patient:innen-Anwendung. Was diese Rolle so besonders macht? Du fährst direkt in Partnerkliniken, schaust Patient:innen und Therapeut:innen über die Schulter und übersetzt echte Beobachtungen in messbare Produktverbesserungen.

Wir schätzen deine Expertise und möchten den Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position transparent mit dir teilen. Dein Einstiegsgehalt orientiert sich an deiner Qualifikation, deinem Skill-Set, deiner einschlägigen Berufserfahrung sowie der Marktsituation. Die Vergütung für diese Position erfolgt gemäß unserer Gehaltsbänder und liegt zwischen 57.500 € und 63.000 € brutto pro Jahr (bei Vollzeit 40h).

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn du…

  • Gestalten statt abarbeiten willst: Du steuerst Discovery und Priorisierung selbst und siehst direkt, wie deine Arbeit Patient:innen im Alltag hilft.

  • Evidenz & AI smart verbindest: Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis echter Klinik-Insights und moderner AI-Workflows – in einem sicheren, verlässlichen HealthTech-Umfeld.

  • Augenhöhe statt Egos suchst: Du bringst Design, Tech und Medizin im Product Trio zusammen – in einem Team, in dem gute Argumente zählen und man sich gegenseitig den Rücken stärkt.

deine herausforderungen

  • Produkt-Discovery & echte Klinik-Insights: Eigenständige Planung von Nutzerforschung, Analytics und Experimenten – inklusive 1–2 Klinikbesuchen pro Quartal, bei denen du live miterlebst, wie Patient:innen und Therapeut:innen unsere App nutzen, und daraus direkt spürbare Verbesserungen ableitest

  • Outcome-orientierte Priorisierung mit Gestaltungsmacht: Definition von Zielen, Roadmaps und User Stories auf Augenhöhe im Product Trio – damit du und dein Team nicht einfach Tickets abarbeiten, sondern an den Themen bauen, die den größten Unterschied machen

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung & sichtbarer Erfolg: Begleitung von Features von der ersten Idee bis zum Live-Gang – inklusive Erfolgsmessung mit dem Data-Team und cleveren Testplänen, damit du den messbaren Impact deiner eigenen Entscheidungen Schwarz auf Weiß siehst

  • AI-first Produktarbeit als Produktivitäts-Turbo: Aktiver und kritischer Einsatz moderner KI-Tools in Discovery, Dokumentation und Entscheidungsfindung – so baust du AI-Skills aus und hältst dir den Rücken frei für echte strategische Produktarbeit

  • Regulatorik & Security mit Sinn: Integration von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsstandards (DSGVO, ISO 27001, ISO 13485) in deine Produktentscheidungen, um gemeinsam mit Tech smarte Lösungen zu finden, die sensible Gesundheitsdaten verlässlich schützen

  • Transparentes Stakeholder-Management: Offener und rechtzeitiger Austausch über Ziele, Prioritäten und Risiken mit deinem und angrenzenden Teams – so sorgt ihr gemeinsam für Klarheit und haltet euch bei komplexen Themen gegenseitig den Rücken frei

dein profil

  • Praxiserfahrung im Produktmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Betreuung eines digitalen Produkts oder Feature-Bereichs in einem agilen Team – idealerweise mit ersten messbaren Discovery-Erfolgen

  • Strukturierte, evidenzbasierte Arbeitsweise: Ausgeprägtes Produkturteil, Datenaffinität und ein gründliches Test-Mindset, um auch in dynamischen Phasen den Überblick zu behalten

  • Kommunikationsstärke & Reflexionsfähigkeit: Klare Moderation zwischen Design, Tech und Medizin – gepaart mit der Offenheit, Annahmen zu hinterfragen und rechtzeitig Unterstützung einzufordern

  • Routine mit KI-Workflows: Sicherer Umgang mit KI- und Automatisierungstools im Arbeitsalltag sowie ein kritisches Auge für deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz

  • Empathie & Qualitätsbewusstsein: Echtes Interesse an den Bedürfnissen von Patient:innen und Therapeut:innen sowie ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein für Datenschutz und IT-Sicherheit

  • Sprachen & Reisebereitschaft: Fließendes Deutsch (mind. C1), sehr gutes Englisch sowie Bereitschaft zu 1–2 Klinikbesuchen pro Quartal innerhalb Deutschlands

warum caspar health?

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands

  • Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top

  • Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!

  • Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!

  • Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch

Was uns als Team ausmacht

  • Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag

  • Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur

  • Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft

  • Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität

Lust, Gesundheit neu zu denken?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich!

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil von Caspar Health. Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied.

dein kontakt

Elisabeth Hegele, Talent Acquisition Specialist

Außerdem sind wir an deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deinen Gehaltsvorstellungen interessiert. Solltest du weitere Fragen haben, wende dich bitte an . Wir werden uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir in Verbindung setzen.

Unser Produkt CASPAR Health wird im Umfeld von medizinischen Einrichtungen, Patient*innen, Ärzt*innen und Therapeut*innen eingesetzt. Diversität und Inklusion:

Bei Caspar Health sind wir bestrebt, für alle Casparianer*innen eine freundliche, sichere und einladende Umgebung zu bieten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen aller Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialer Herkunft, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Nichtvorhandensein).

Overview

Overview:

The Director, Risk Adjustment Products will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the product portfolio focused on retrospective risk adjustment solutions. The Director will work closely with technical and operations teams, both internally and externally, to create innovative solutions that deliver measurable impact for our customers. This is a leadership role where you will pair your product development and people management expertise to mentor a high-performance team.

The Opportunity:

  • Define multi-year plans aligned to customer outcomes, regulatory drivers, and market trends in risk adjustment, care management, and provider enablement.
  • Identify and prioritize use cases that leverage AI/ML and real-time data signals to surface high-impact suspects and coding opportunities.
  • Drive innovation leveraging interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, APIs) to enable seamless enablement with EHRs, care management platforms, and third-party integrations.
  • Balance innovation with compliance, audit defensibility, and clinical integrity across all product decisions.
  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, including ideation, requirements gathering, development, launch, and post-launch optimization.
  • Work closely with Engineering and Data Science to build predictive models and real-time data pipelines that power suspecting and concurrent workflows.
  • Ensure products are clinically relevant, user-centric, and integrated into existing payer and provider workflows through interoperability integrations.
  • Set and track KPIs for each product line, such as suspect accuracy, provider engagement, risk score impact, and concurrent coding capture and correction rates.
  • Establish and track KPIs that measure both risk adjustment performance and interoperability success (data exchange rates, provider adoption).
  • Serve as a trusted partner and clinical product expert for internal stakeholders (Sales, Clinical, Operations, Client Success) and external clients (health plans, ACOs, risk bearing provider groups).
  • Lead customer discovery and feedback sessions to deeply understand provider workflows, documentation behaviors, and concurrent coding needs.
  • Present product strategy and roadmap updates to executive stakeholders and client advisory boards.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Policy teams to interpret and operationalize updates from CMS (e.g., Final Rules, model updates, guidance on medical record standards).
  • Implement and monitor processes that ensure defensibility of all outputs, documentation standards, and audit trails.
  • Design and embed audit readiness into product workflows, ensuring all activities are traceable, evidence-backed, and aligned with CMS documentation requirements.
  • Provide strategic recommendations and decision frameworks when trade-offs between revenue, compliance, and user experience arise.
  • Build, lead, and coach a team of Product Managers working across different facets within prospective and concurrent solutions.

  • Request applicable shipment updates and supporting records.
  • Maintain professional telephone, email, and digital communication.

Freight & Load Support

jobs.title: Casper Test Rater (Remote On-Demand Contract Work in the UK)
jobs.description:
Imagine a world where everyone’s full potential is recognized and nurtured.

That’s what we’re building at Acuity Insights.

We believe higher education admissions should look beyond grades and consider the whole person—their experiences, strengths, and unique qualities.

Our flagship assessment, Casper, helps make this possible.

It’s an online test that presents real-life scenarios to evaluate important soft skills like empathy, self-awareness, resilience, and ethical judgment. By looking beyond academic performance, Casper helps create more diverse applicant pools and supports admissions teams in selecting students who are best prepared for success.

Rating a Casper test is a critical part of that work, and we’d like to invite you to join our Rater community as an on-demand contractor.

As a Rater, you have the chance to help our UK-based partners make informed admission decisions.

It is a role that:

  • Is open to people with a variety of backgrounds and experiences.
  • Is flexible and remote, which means you can work at your own pace from anywhere within the UK.
  • Provides you with the opportunity to supplement your income with socially impactful work.

What You’ll Do as a Casper Rater

  • Become a certified Rater. Complete virtual, scientifically backed onboarding training to learn how to rate test responses of applicants to academic programs, including how to combat implicit bias.
  • Complete ongoing training and mandatory annual recertification. Participate in ongoing refresher training and complete our required paid annual Rater recertification, ensuring your quality of work remains high.
  • Rate and score Casper responses. Read and review applicant text and video responses, compare them to the overall pool of test takers, and assign scores following scoring guidelines.
  • Share feedback. Provide feedback to help improve and optimize the Casper test, platforms, and content.

Foundations for Success as a Casper Rater

  • Consistent Engagement & Professionalism. You demonstrate high commitment by consistently participating in rating sessions and upholding a professional demeanour, recognizing the significance of your contribution.
  • Ongoing Skill Development. You regularly engage in the required training and feedback activities to stay informed on best practices and ensure that your evaluations are current and reliable.
  • Effective Communication & Responsiveness. You exhibit clear and effective communication, responding promptly to surveys and feedback, and reflecting a proactive and collaborative mindset.
  • Empathy & Understanding. You approach every response with empathy and fairness, recognizing the impact your evaluations can have on an applicant’s academic journey.
  • Bias Awareness & Integrity. You maintain strong self-awareness, actively reflecting on and addressing potential biases to provide objective and equitable evaluations.

Payments

We issue payments for work you’ve completed via Airwallex once a month.

While there’s no guaranteed minimum work, you can access a quarterly testing schedule, which allows you to choose when to work and estimate potential earnings. Pay may include activities outside of rating, like job training and participating in research studies.

To Qualify as a Casper Test Rater, You Must:

  • Be a UK citizen.
  • Currently reside in the UK
  • Have your own desktop/laptop computer to work on.
  • Have no plans to apply to and become a student in a program using Casper in the next 2-3 years.
  • Communicate effectively and proactively in writing, enabling you to raise issues and clearly articulate Casper score choices.
  • Demonstrate you have the following soft skills:
    • Communication
    • Self-awareness
    • Professionalism
    • Empathy

We welcome applicants from all walks of life across the UK, which means you’ll also be part of a diverse group of Raters!

Steps to Become a Casper Rater

  1. Submit Your Application. Complete the online application form. It includes multiple questions to determine if you meet the basic qualifying criteria to become a Casper Rater.
  2. Take a Mini-Casper and Reading Comprehension Test. If the basic criteria are met, you’ll receive an invitation to take a shortened version of the Casper test. Your responses will be reviewed and rated to determine if you share the four aspects listed in the previous section. You’ll also be required to take a reading comprehension test aimed at evaluating your ability to read and understand written information. This step may take up to 25 minutes to complete.
  3. Meet a Member of the Rating Team. Successful candidates will be invited to a 20-minute 1-1 video conversation with a member of our Rating Team to verify your information. This is also an opportunity to ask any questions you still have about rating and the role.
  4. Complete Paid Online Rater Training. You will receive an invitation to complete our scientifically backed Rater training, which you must complete within 5 business days. Regardless of the outcome, you will be compensated for your time.
  5. Become a Certified Rater. You’ve successfully completed the necessary steps to become a Casper Test Rater. You’re now certified and can start rating Casper test responses!

Casper Rater Training

Our Casper Rater training program will equip you with the skills and knowledge needed to make fair, unbiased judgments. It includes 8 modules covering topics such as Fundamental Rating Principles, Quality Assurance, and Implicit Bias Training.

Throughout the program, you will complete knowledge checks, activities, and exercises that assess and deepen your understanding of the rating criteria. These interactive elements reinforce learning by enabling you to apply knowledge in realistic scenarios, building confidence and accuracy in your evaluations.

Before certification, you must successfully complete a calibration assessment and demonstrate consistent alignment with benchmark ratings to ensure your readiness for live assessments.

About Casper

Casper was invented in 2010 by Acuity Insights co-founders Dr. Kelly Dore and Oncology Professor Harold Reiter to improve the admissions process at McMaster University's School of Medicine in Ontario, Canada. They recognized that traditional entrance exams and cover letters were biased and lacked insight into applicants' social intelligence and professionalism and built the test to assess those skills.

Casper is a situational judgment test applicants take online. It helps admissions teams understand how they might handle real-life situations.

Applicants are given a story or scenario and must answer questions designed to evaluate their approach to handling the situation. The questions are open-ended and have no right or wrong answers, so applicants can take their answers in any direction they see fit.

Each Casper scenario assesses the test-taker for one or more aspects of social intelligence and professionalism, including collaboration, communication, empathy, equity, ethics, motivation, problem-solving, professionalism, resilience, and self-awareness.

Today, Acuity Insights collaborates with admissions teams in over 600 higher education programs across Canada, the U.S., the U.K., Australia, and beyond. These include medical schools, nursing programs, veterinary schools, teacher’s colleges, and, more recently, MBA programs, law and engineering schools.

Since 2014, 1 million applicants have taken Casper. Last year alone, 150,000 applicants completed the test across 90 live online sessions, with our Raters evaluating over 2 million responses.

Thanks for considering contributing to Acuity Insights as a Casper Test Rater!

Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Austria

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Austria. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Growth & Retention
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer growth and retention are built on helping businesses succeed with our software over time. We value people who understand what drives customer loyalty, recognize opportunities for growth, and build strong teams and processes that support lasting customer relationships.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Customer Growth & Retention to lead Bask Health's post-sale customer growth strategy, strengthen customer retention, and develop scalable processes for expanding existing customer relationships.

This role combines customer success leadership, commercial strategy, account management, and operational execution.

You'll be responsible for building a customer success function that helps customers achieve value from Bask Health while supporting strong retention and sustainable recurring-revenue growth.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce businesses, merchant operations, and the challenges entrepreneurs face when building and scaling online businesses.

You'll develop a customer growth and retention strategy that aligns customer needs with Bask Health's broader business objectives.

You'll define how the team approaches customer onboarding, adoption, engagement, renewals, retention, and account expansion.

You'll establish clear processes for identifying customers who are at risk of leaving and developing appropriate retention strategies.

You'll help the team recognize early warning signs of declining engagement, reduced product adoption, or customer dissatisfaction.

You'll develop customer health monitoring practices that provide visibility into retention risks and opportunities.

You'll work with customer success managers to ensure customer goals, account priorities, and growth opportunities are clearly documented.

You'll establish expectations for proactive account management and consistent customer communication.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer success team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll help team members strengthen their ability to manage customer relationships, navigate renewal conversations, and identify appropriate expansion opportunities.

You'll build a team culture that values accountability, strong commercial judgment, and meaningful customer outcomes.

You'll work with leadership to establish customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.

You'll help determine how resources should be allocated across strategic accounts, growing merchants, and smaller businesses.

You'll develop performance metrics and reporting practices for customer growth and retention.

You'll monitor relevant indicators such as customer churn, gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, renewals, expansion, and product adoption.

You'll establish processes for analyzing why customers leave and identifying recurring causes of churn.

You'll use customer feedback and account performance data to recommend improvements.

You'll create proactive strategies for strengthening relationships with customers who show signs of dissatisfaction.

You'll oversee important customer escalations that may affect retention or long-term account value.

You'll build relationships with strategic customer stakeholders, including founders, executives, and business owners.

You'll participate in high-priority customer conversations when leadership involvement can help resolve concerns or strengthen relationships.

You'll guide the team in conducting business reviews focused on customer goals, platform adoption, business performance, and opportunities for growth.

You'll work closely with sales leadership to coordinate renewal preparation and expansion opportunities.

You'll establish clear responsibilities between customer success and sales for identifying, qualifying, and pursuing expansion opportunities.

You'll help ensure commercial conversations are grounded in customer needs and supported platform capabilities.

You'll identify opportunities for customers to adopt additional features or expand their use of Bask Health when those capabilities support their business goals.

You'll collaborate with product and engineering teams to address recurring issues that affect customer satisfaction and retention.

You'll communicate customer feedback, product limitations, and adoption challenges to the appropriate internal teams.

You'll work with technical support and customer success engineering teams to address technical problems that create churn risk.

You'll help identify recurring implementation challenges that prevent customers from realizing value.

You'll support improvements to onboarding, customer education, and implementation handoffs.

You'll ensure the customer success team understands how Bask Health's capabilities support different merchant business models.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll help the team connect these capabilities to practical customer needs without promising unsupported functionality.

You'll establish clear processes for recognizing when customer requests require technical, clinical, pharmacy, or compliance expertise.

You'll coordinate with authorized teams when issues involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll ensure customer-facing processes follow appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling requirements.

You'll develop scalable customer retention and expansion playbooks.

You'll evaluate customer success tools, workflows, and reporting systems to identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll create consistent processes for tracking renewals, retention risks, expansion opportunities, and customer commitments.

You'll collaborate with leadership on organizational planning, staffing needs, and team development.

You'll participate in hiring and evaluating customer success talent as needed.

You'll establish performance coaching and professional development practices that reinforce strong account management and commercial execution.

You'll help create effective collaboration between customer success, sales, product, engineering, and technical support teams.

You'll work directly with company leadership to communicate customer growth performance, retention trends, and emerging risks.

You'll provide recommendations for improving recurring-revenue performance through stronger post-sale customer engagement.

You'll balance customer advocacy with commercial priorities and operational realities.

You'll develop strategies that strengthen long-term customer relationships while supporting responsible revenue growth.

We're looking for a leader with substantial post-sale customer success experience, proven team management ability, and meaningful e-commerce experience.

You should understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate and how customer retention and account expansion contribute to long-term company growth.

You'll need to be comfortable building processes, coaching teams, managing strategic accounts, and making data-informed commercial decisions.

Success in this role means improving customer retention, reducing preventable churn, increasing appropriate account expansion, and building a customer success organization that contributes directly to Bask Health's long-term growth.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Bask Health's customer growth and retention strategy.
  • Develop scalable processes for customer renewals, retention, and expansion.
  • Establish customer health monitoring and churn-risk identification practices.
  • Build proactive strategies to reduce preventable customer churn.
  • Lead and coach customer success team members within the approved organization.
  • Establish clear expectations for account ownership and commercial accountability.
  • Develop customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.
  • Monitor customer retention, churn, renewals, and expansion performance.
  • Track gross revenue retention and net revenue retention where applicable.
  • Establish customer growth and retention reporting practices.
  • Analyze recurring causes of customer churn and recommend improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and product adoption.
  • Oversee strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagements.
  • Guide customer success managers in conducting business reviews and renewal discussions.
  • Support appropriate account expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with sales on customer growth and expansion strategies.
  • Establish clear handoffs between customer success and sales.
  • Work with product and engineering on issues affecting retention.
  • Coordinate with technical support and customer success engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar platforms.

  • Experience improving technical onboarding and implementation handoffs.
  • Familiarity with online storefront, checkout, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology or telehealth businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders and senior company leadership.

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. jobs.title: Systematic Review Methodologist
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for evidence-based research, analyzing complex clinical data, and translating scientific findings into meaningful insights? Are you a detail-oriented professional who combines strong research methodology, critical appraisal, statistical analysis, and project management skills with a collaborative approach and a commitment to advancing healthcare?

The American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) is seeking a Systematic Review Methodologist to lead and coordinate evidence-based medicine projects that support the advancement of plastic surgery. Working closely with our Quality team, internal staff, and physician workgroups, this individual will play a key role in conducting systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and other evidence synthesis projects that inform clinical practice, support decision-making, and contribute to the development of valuable resources for ASPS members and the broader healthcare community.

In this role, you'll manage multiple research projects, develop search strategies and review protocols, critically evaluate scientific literature, and synthesize findings into comprehensive reports and publications. You'll collaborate across teams to address complex clinical questions, assess the effectiveness of healthcare interventions and practices, and help translate research findings into practical tools and resources for physicians, patients, payers, and regulatory officials. Your expertise will help strengthen ASPS's commitment to evidence-based medicine, quality, and excellence in patient care.

ABOUT US

The American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) is the largest plastic surgery specialty organization in the world. Founded in 1931, the Society represents 92 percent of all board-certified plastic surgeons in the United States, and more than 11,000 plastic surgeons worldwide – making ASPS a global institution and leading authority on cosmetic and reconstructive plastic surgery.

For more information about ASPS visit us at:

Follow us: Facebook I Instagram I Threads I X I TikTok I YouTube I LinkedIn

OVERVIEW

Systematic Review Methodologist

Reports to:Quality and Evidence-Based Initiatives Manager

Supervises: None

Location:Remote in the US

Travel:approx 1-2 times per year

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lead and coordinate evidence-based research projects, including systematic reviews, rapid reviews, evidence maps, and meta-analyses.

Develop research questions, review protocols, search strategies, and evaluation criteria to support evidence-based products and clinical guidelines.

Conduct systematic literature reviews, including article screening, data extraction, risk of bias assessments, and critical appraisal of scientific evidence.

Analyze and synthesize research findings using appropriate statistical methods and evidence evaluation frameworks, including GRADE.

Prepare comprehensive reports, manuscripts, and publications that translate complex research findings into meaningful insights for physicians, patients, and other stakeholders.

Collaborate with internal teams, physician workgroups, and member volunteers to support research initiatives, guideline development, and evidence-based resources.

Manage multiple project timelines, deliverables, and priorities while identifying opportunities for process improvement.

Support the development, review, and ongoing updates of ASPS Clinical Practice Guidelines and other evidence-based products.

Coordinate manuscript submissions, peer reviews, and publication processes in collaboration with internal teams and editorial staff.

Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools, to improve research efficiency while maintaining methodological rigor and quality.

Provide methodological guidance, training, and support to staff and volunteers involved in evidence synthesis projects.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

5+ years of scientific research experience, including study design, data analysis, interpretation, and scientific writing. Relevant graduate or postdoctoral research experience may count toward this requirement.

Experience planning, conducting, and managing literature reviews or structured research projects, preferably in healthcare or related fields.

Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating scientific literature, interpreting research findings, and applying established research protocols.

Proficiency in statistical analysis and experience using statistical software such as R, Stata, SAS, or SPSS.

Experience conducting literature searches and using research databases and reference management tools.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex research findings into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.

Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and deliverables.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, adaptability to new technologies, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Ability to incorporate methodological, editorial, and peer-review feedback into research products.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience conducting systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and evidence synthesis in healthcare or related disciplines.

Familiarity with evidence-based medicine methodologies and frameworks, including PRISMA, PICO, GRADE, and risk of bias assessment tools.

Knowledge of statistical methods used in evidence synthesis, including effect estimates, confidence intervals, and heterogeneity.

Experience developing advanced literature search strategies using databases such as PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, or Cochrane.

Familiarity with evidence synthesis software such as Covidence, Rayyan, DistillerSR, or RevMan.

Experience preparing and submitting scientific manuscripts to peer-reviewed journals.

Familiarity with National Academy of Medicine standards for trustworthy clinical practice guidelines.

Experience working with healthcare or medical associations is a plus.

SALARY & BENEFITS

Employment Type:Exempt

Annual Salary:$85,000-$95,000

Eligible for Overtime:No

Hours per Week:Full Time/37.5 hrs per week

  • Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, AD&D, Critical Illness, Pet
  • Pre-Tax Spending Accounts: Health (HSA), Flexible (FSA), Child/Dependent Care
