jobs.title: Merchant Adoption & Retention Manager
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we understand that helping a customer launch is only the beginning. Long-term success comes from helping businesses adopt the platform, understand its capabilities, and continue getting value as their operations evolve. We value people who take initiative, understand how online businesses work, build strong relationships, and identify practical ways to improve customer retention.

About the Role

We're looking for a Merchant Adoption & Retention Manager to help e-commerce businesses successfully adopt Bask Health's telehealth platform, maintain consistent engagement, and continue seeing value from the software.

This is a hands-on post-sale customer success position with a specialized focus on merchant activation, adoption, retention, and reducing preventable customer churn.

You'll work with entrepreneurs, online merchants, and growing businesses to understand how they use Bask Health, where they encounter challenges, and what support they need to remain successful.

You'll help identify the factors that contribute to strong customer engagement and the warning signs that a merchant may be struggling or considering leaving.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a strong understanding of the merchant-facing platform experience and the steps involved in successfully adopting supported capabilities.

You'll work with merchants at different stages of their customer lifecycle.

You'll help recently onboarded merchants transition from initial setup into active platform usage.

You'll identify situations where customers have completed onboarding but are not consistently using the platform.

You'll help merchants understand the next practical steps they can take to improve adoption.

You'll work with Customer Success Managers and other internal teams to identify obstacles that may be limiting customer engagement.

You'll help develop structured adoption plans based on each merchant's business goals and current platform usage.

You'll provide approved guidance on platform capabilities that may be relevant to a merchant's needs.

You'll recognize that different merchants have different business models, operating experience, and growth priorities.

You'll adapt your communication and support approach based on the customer's level of experience and business needs.

You'll build relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, and business owners.

You'll take time to understand what each merchant is trying to accomplish with Bask Health.

You'll identify whether a merchant's challenges relate to product understanding, operational processes, technical issues, or unmet expectations.

You'll work with the appropriate teams to address those challenges.

You'll proactively engage merchants who appear to be struggling with activation or ongoing adoption.

You'll help customers understand how supported platform workflows fit into their business operations.

You'll coordinate with onboarding and customer success teams to improve transitions between customer lifecycle stages.

You'll identify recurring onboarding issues that may lead to long-term disengagement.

You'll share practical recommendations for improving the merchant onboarding experience.

You'll help develop follow-up strategies for merchants who have not reached expected activation milestones.

You'll monitor available customer engagement indicators to identify adoption trends.

You'll review relevant account activity, platform usage, and support history when authorized.

You'll recognize when declining engagement may indicate an increased risk of churn.

You'll help develop proactive retention plans for merchants showing signs of disengagement.

You'll reach out to at-risk merchants through approved communication channels.

You'll ask questions to understand the underlying reasons for reduced usage or dissatisfaction.

You'll work with customers to identify realistic next steps for addressing their concerns.

You'll coordinate with Customer Success Managers when an account requires broader relationship management or renewal planning.

You'll help ensure merchants receive consistent communication during retention-related discussions.

You'll track retention risks, customer concerns, and follow-up commitments in approved systems.

You'll help maintain clear records of adoption progress and retention activities.

You'll participate in discussions about customers who may be considering cancellation or non-renewal.

You'll contribute relevant information about customer engagement, unresolved issues, and possible retention opportunities.

You'll support renewal readiness by helping merchants recognize the value they receive from the platform.

You'll avoid making unauthorized commitments about pricing, contract terms, credits, refunds, or product functionality.

You'll coordinate commercial requests with authorized leadership or sales representatives.

You'll help identify customers who could benefit from adopting additional existing platform capabilities.

You'll recommend relevant adoption opportunities based on actual merchant needs.

You'll focus on sustainable customer engagement rather than unnecessary upselling.

You'll work with product and engineering teams to communicate recurring adoption barriers.

You'll identify platform features or workflows that customers frequently misunderstand.

You'll help document technical issues that prevent merchants from completing expected tasks.

You'll coordinate with technical support or customer success engineering when specialized troubleshooting is required.

You'll communicate approved updates to merchants while issues are being investigated.

You'll help ensure unresolved technical problems are considered when assessing account health and retention risk.

You'll identify patterns in customer feedback that may indicate opportunities for product improvements.

You'll contribute to customer education resources that make it easier for merchants to use supported platform features.

You'll help improve onboarding guides, adoption checklists, and merchant-facing instructional materials.

You'll participate in developing repeatable engagement and retention playbooks.

You'll help identify effective communication strategies for merchants at different stages of their lifecycle.

You'll contribute ideas for re-engaging inactive or low-engagement customers.

You'll help distinguish between customers who need additional education and those experiencing broader product or business challenges.

You'll work with customer success leadership to prioritize retention initiatives.

You'll help identify opportunities to improve customer lifecycle processes.

You'll contribute to the development of practical customer health indicators.

You'll help track metrics such as activation progress, feature adoption, customer engagement, churn risk, and retention.

You'll use available customer data to identify patterns and recommend appropriate actions.

You'll help prepare summaries of adoption trends and recurring retention concerns.

You'll contribute to discussions about customer churn reasons and opportunities to prevent avoidable cancellations.

You'll help improve how the team documents and categorizes customer disengagement.

You'll participate in customer business reviews when adoption or retention concerns require additional attention.

You'll communicate clearly with merchants about their goals, challenges, and available platform capabilities.

You'll work with founders and business owners who expect practical answers and timely follow-through.

You'll manage multiple merchant relationships or initiatives while maintaining accurate records.

You'll prioritize work based on customer needs, engagement risks, and approved team objectives.

You'll take ownership of assigned adoption and retention activities.

You'll follow through on commitments and communicate proactively when additional support is needed.

You'll collaborate with sales, onboarding, customer success, technical support, product, and engineering teams.

You'll help ensure customer feedback reaches the teams best positioned to address it.

You'll recognize when a merchant request involves clinical, pharmacy, or compliance matters.

You'll direct those requests to the appropriate licensed or authorized teams.

You'll never provide medical advice, make clinical decisions, or promise prescription-related outcomes.

You'll follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll maintain professional and constructive communication when working with dissatisfied customers.

You'll be comfortable having direct conversations about why a merchant is not using the platform as expected.

You'll approach retention challenges with curiosity and problem-solving rather than relying on generic sales tactics.

You'll understand that long-term customer retention depends on delivering meaningful value and maintaining trust.

You'll help improve the consistency of merchant engagement across the customer lifecycle.

You'll contribute to a team environment that values ownership, initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for someone with at least two full years of genuine post-sale Customer Success experience and recent, substantive e-commerce experience.

You should understand how online merchants operate and have experience helping customers adopt software, remain engaged, and overcome challenges that affect retention.

Experience with customer health monitoring, churn prevention, renewal support, or retention initiatives would be particularly valuable.

Success in this role means improving merchant activation and adoption, identifying retention risks early, strengthening customer engagement, and helping Bask Health build long-term relationships with the businesses using its platform.

What You'll Do

  • Support merchant activation and ongoing platform adoption.
  • Help merchants transition from onboarding into consistent platform usage.
  • Identify customers who are struggling to adopt supported capabilities.
  • Develop practical adoption plans based on merchant goals and needs.
  • Build relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, and business owners.
  • Understand merchant business models and common e-commerce challenges.
  • Monitor available customer engagement and adoption indicators.
  • Identify declining platform usage and potential churn risks.
  • Proactively engage merchants who may be struggling or disengaging.
  • Investigate reasons for reduced adoption or customer dissatisfaction.
  • Develop appropriate follow-up plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Coordinate retention initiatives with Customer Success Managers and leadership.
  • Support renewal readiness and ongoing customer engagement.
  • Maintain accurate records of adoption progress and retention risks.
  • Document merchant concerns, follow-up commitments, and next steps.
  • Help customers understand relevant existing platform capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities for increased adoption based on merchant needs.
  • Coordinate technical issues with customer success engineering and support teams.
  • Follow through on escalations that affect adoption or retention.
  • Share recurring merchant feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Identify onboarding challenges that contribute to later disengagement.
  • Contribute to merchant onboarding and adoption resources.
  • Help develop customer engagement and retention playbooks.
  • Support re-engagement efforts for inactive or low-engagement merchants.
  • Track relevant adoption, engagement, churn risk, and retention indicators.
  • Help analyze recurring reasons for customer disengagement.
  • Participate in customer business reviews and account planning discussions.
  • Collaborate with sales, onboarding, customer success, and technical teams.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.
  • Manage multiple merchant relationships or initiatives with strong organization.
  • Take ownership of assigned adoption and retention activities and follow through consistently.

Benefits

  • At least 2 full years of genuine post-sale Customer Success experience with direct responsibility for customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer onboarding, adoption, ongoing engagement, retention, or renewals.
  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce merchants, online stores, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce operations and direct-to-consumer business models.
  • Experience helping customers adopt and consistently use SaaS products.
  • Ability to identify customer engagement challenges and potential retention risks.
  • Experience building relationships with entrepreneurs, founders, or business owners.
  • Strong customer communication and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to understand customer business goals and connect them to supported product capabilities.
  • Experience developing customer follow-up plans or adoption strategies.
  • Ability to investigate reasons for customer dissatisfaction or declining engagement.
  • Experience managing customer concerns and coordinating appropriate solutions.
  • Familiarity with customer retention, renewal support, or churn prevention processes.
  • Experience collaborating with technical support, product, or engineering teams.
  • Ability to explain software workflows clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Experience maintaining accurate customer records, account notes, and follow-up commitments.
  • Familiarity with CRM or customer success management tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple merchant relationships or customer success initiatives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to take initiative.
  • Ability to recognize when customer requests require specialized assistance.
  • Experience working collaboratively with sales, onboarding, or other customer-facing teams.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Comfortable working in a growing software company with evolving processes and priorities.
  • Strong accountability for customer engagement and assigned retention initiatives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience as a Customer Success Manager at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Experience supporting Shopify merchants or direct-to-consumer brands.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, Yotpo, or similar commerce platforms.
  • Personal experience owning or operating an e-commerce business.
  • Experience developing customer adoption or activation programs.
  • Experience identifying and reducing customer churn.
  • Experience creating retention strategies for SaaS customers.
  • Experience managing at-risk accounts or customer re-engagement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with customer health scoring and engagement monitoring.
  • Experience supporting customer renewals or cancellation prevention.
  • Experience working with gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, or churn metrics.
  • Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar tools.
  • Experience analyzing product adoption or customer usage data.
  • Experience developing customer lifecycle communication programs.
  • Experience conducting customer business reviews.
  • Experience improving onboarding processes and adoption resources.
  • Experience collaborating with customer success engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with online storefronts, checkout, subscriptions, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology or telehealth businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders or senior business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Product Researcher
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Researcher to help Bask Health better understand how people use our software, what challenges they experience, and where opportunities exist to build better products.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools.

As a Product Researcher, you'll investigate the needs, behaviors, and expectations of the people who interact with these products. Your findings will help inform product strategy, feature development, workflow improvements, and design decisions.

This is a hands-on research role combining qualitative and quantitative methods, product discovery, usability evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll help teams understand both what users are doing and why they behave the way they do.

Your work will span multiple areas of Bask Health's platform. You may research how merchants configure their businesses, how patients navigate onboarding, how users interact with complex workflows, or how new product concepts address existing problems.

You'll conduct user interviews, surveys, usability studies, concept evaluations, and other research activities to identify unmet needs and evaluate product experiences.

You'll also help connect research findings with available product analytics, customer feedback, and operational observations. By combining different sources of evidence, you'll help teams distinguish isolated complaints from recurring problems and meaningful product opportunities.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers to define research questions, prioritize studies, and identify where additional evidence is needed before making product decisions.

You'll work with product designers and content designers to evaluate prototypes, improve usability, and validate whether proposed solutions address actual user needs.

You'll also partner with engineers and customer-facing teams to understand technical constraints, recurring support issues, and the operational context behind product behavior.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, research must be conducted with appropriate attention to privacy, participant consent, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help document research findings, organize insights, and make recommendations accessible to teams across the company.

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable working with different types of users, and able to turn research evidence into practical recommendations that help teams build better software.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct product research across Bask Health's merchant-facing, patient-facing, and operational software experiences.
  • Partner with product managers to identify research questions and product discovery priorities.
  • Develop research plans that align with product goals and user needs.
  • Conduct user interviews to understand behaviors, motivations, and challenges.
  • Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.
  • Design surveys and structured feedback activities.
  • Evaluate new product concepts before development.
  • Test prototypes to identify usability problems and opportunities for improvement.
  • Research how merchants interact with storefront configuration and business management tools.
  • Investigate user experiences across onboarding, questionnaires, and other multi-step workflows.
  • Study how users navigate complex settings, forms, and administrative interfaces.
  • Identify recurring friction points and unmet user needs.
  • Analyze qualitative research findings to identify themes and patterns.
  • Incorporate quantitative product data where appropriate.
  • Review customer feedback and operational observations to identify research opportunities.
  • Help distinguish user preferences from underlying product problems.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve proposed solutions.
  • Work with content designers to evaluate terminology, instructions, and comprehension.
  • Partner with engineers to understand technical constraints affecting user experiences.
  • Develop interview guides, usability tasks, and research discussion materials.
  • Recruit and screen research participants through approved processes.
  • Create research summaries, journey maps, and actionable recommendations.
  • Present findings clearly to product, design, engineering, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Support research during product discovery, development, and post-launch evaluation.
  • Track recurring user problems and help teams understand changes over time.
  • Maintain organized research documentation and reusable findings.
  • Follow appropriate privacy, consent, and data-handling practices.
  • Independently manage assigned research projects from planning through analysis and presentation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in product research, UX research, user research, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating research work and product impact.
  • Experience planning and conducting research for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative research methods.
  • Experience conducting user interviews and usability testing.
  • Familiarity with quantitative research methods and survey design.
  • Ability to develop clear research questions and study objectives.
  • Experience selecting research methods appropriate to different product problems.
  • Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience identifying user behaviors, pain points, and unmet needs.
  • Familiarity with user-centered design and product development processes.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and product designers.
  • Ability to communicate research findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating interview guides, usability tasks, and research materials.
  • Familiarity with participant recruitment and screening.
  • Understanding of research ethics and informed participation.
  • Ability to evaluate complex digital workflows and user journeys.
  • Experience organizing and documenting research findings.
  • Familiarity with product analytics or behavioral data.
  • Ability to combine multiple sources of evidence to support product decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and research quality.
  • Ability to balance research rigor with product development timelines.
  • Ability to independently manage research projects and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience conducting research for SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with B2B software and merchant-facing applications.
  • Experience researching e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience researching complex administrative workflows.
  • Familiarity with storefront configuration, subscriptions, or commerce operations.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience conducting research involving sensitive information.
  • Familiarity with tools such as UserTesting, Maze, Dovetail, Lookback, or comparable research platforms.
  • Experience evaluating interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Understanding of mixed-methods research approaches.
  • Experience combining qualitative findings with product analytics.
  • Familiarity with journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Experience researching white-label or multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of accessibility research and inclusive study practices.
  • Experience conducting longitudinal research or diary studies.
  • Familiarity with customer feedback analysis and support trend research.
  • Experience researching AI-assisted product experiences.
  • Understanding of research operations and insight repositories.
  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.

The Clinical Opportunity Development department leads Banner Health’s clinical registry abstraction utilizing an AI-assisted Platform. The department manages the full lifecycle of registry reporting — abstraction, QA validation, inter-rater reliability, and submission — across 16+ registries including NSQIP, CathPCI, GWTG Stroke, and Cancer COC, ensuring Banner maintains its hospital certifications and mandatory state and federal reporting obligations. Beyond compliance, the department returns national benchmark performance data to care teams, physician leaders, and nursing leadership to drive clinical quality improvement across the system. It also oversees national rankings strategy (U.S. News, Leapfrog, CMS Stars) and outcomes intelligence to position Banner’s clinical performance against peer institutions.


The Clinical Registry Reporting Specialist responsibilities include turning raw clinical documentation into reportable data that puts Banner Health’s outcomes on the national stage- then watching the same data flow back to the surgeons, cardiologists, and nurses who can act on it to improve patient care.


The ideal candidate will have RN experience for abstraction, NCDR LAAO and STS Congenital and STS General Thoracic registry experience.


Monday to Friday 8am - 4:30pm


This is a fully remote position and available if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NH, NC, ND, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for abstracting clinical data from the Cerner electronic health record into national and state clinical registries (e.g., ACC/NCDR, STS, AHA Get with The Guidelines, ACS NSQIP, and other state-mandated registries), ensuring data accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with registry specifications. This role also performs quality assurance validation and inter-rater reliability (IRR) testing, maintains current knowledge of evolving registry and clinical guideline requirements, and translates registry benchmark data into actionable performance comparisons of Banner Health against national and peer-system outcomes.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Data Abstraction: Abstracts clinical, procedural, and outcomes data from the Cerner patient chart into assigned clinical registries per each registry's data dictionary and specifications.


2. Quality Assurance: Performs routine QA validation on abstracted records to ensure data integrity, completeness, and accuracy prior to registry submission.


3. Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR): Participates in and supports IRR testing/audits to maintain abstraction consistency across the team and meet registry-required reliability thresholds.


4. Registry Submission: Submits validated data within registry deadlines to ACC/NCDR, STS, AHA GWTG, ACS NSQIP, and other assigned registries.


5. Guideline Currency: Maintains up-to-date knowledge of registry specification changes, clinical guideline updates, and abstraction rule changes; complete required registry certifications/training.


6. Benchmarking & Reporting: Retrieves registry performance reports and translate results into clear benchmark comparisons of Banner Health performance against national and peer-system data for clinical and executive stakeholders.


7. Cross-Functional Coverage: Works flexibly across multiple registries and service lines as assigned, supporting a consistent, system-wide abstraction and benchmarking function.


8. Collaboration: Partners with physicians, service line leaders, quality teams, and registry coordinators to resolve data questions and support performance improvement initiatives.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelors degree in Nursing, Physician Assistant Studies, Medicine (MBBS, MD, DO), or equivalent working knowledge in other related clinical healthcare fields.

Requires 2 to 4 years of clinical experience in an acute care hospital setting.

Strong understanding of medical terminology, chart review, and clinical documentation, high attention to detail with demonstrated data accuracy and quality focus, Proficiency with EHR systems (Cerner Strongly Preferred).


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Certifications in SCR (Surgical Clinical Reviewer), ODS (Oncology Data Specialist)

Prior experience with clinical registry abstraction (ACC/NCDR, STS, NSQIP, AHA GWTG, Cancer/COC or state registries), Certified clinical data abstractor credential (e.g., CCDS, RHIA/RHIT, or registry-specific certification), Experience with performance benchmarking, dashboards, or quality reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).

Working for a leading video relay service company, you will be providing access and inclusion for the Deaf community by interpreting telephone calls and interpreting remotely. Using a custom-built platform, you will connect Deaf people to organisations, colleagues, friends and family.

In this role it is expected that you will process calls from Deaf people wishing to contact partner organisations, as well as calls from and to Deaf customers who are registered with the service. You may be asked to translate written documents from and into English or to act as a remote interpreter for pre booked appointments and meetings. A nominated Shift Lead will be available to support you throughout your shift.

There is a large degree of autonomy within this role, and you are expected to use your professional judgement whilst on calls including managing the length of time you are on a call before you transfer to a colleague and managing your need for micro breaks between scheduled break times.

Duties & Responsibilities

  1. Within defined boundaries, to maintain the confidentiality of all participants in the interpreted calls.
  2. To be aware of, and to alert Interpreter Team Leads/hearing call participants as appropriate if you hear or see anything that may raise a safeguarding concern.
  3. To follow agreed policies and procedures whilst processing calls
  4. To interpret telephone calls to partner organisations.
  5. To provide remote interpreting to partner organisations who have agreed this service
  6. To interpret telephone calls from and to individual Deaf customers who are registered with us
  7. To translate brief written documents from English into Sign Language as required by individual Deaf customers
  8. To translate brief signed documents from Sign Language into English as required by individual Deaf customers
  9. To report any concerns or difficulties to the Team Lead/Shift Lead
  10. To remain in contact with interpreter colleagues and keep them informed of breaks using the means provided.
  11. To demonstrate flexibility in supporting the various video services that we provide to meet business needs as directed by the shift lead.

Person Specification

Essential:

  • Registered with the NRCPD, RBSLI, or SRLPDC as a Registered Sign Language Interpreter.
  • Three years post qualification and experience in a range of domains.
  • Suitable home working space
  • Fast, reliable broadband connected via an ethernet cable

Desirable:

  • Experience in video interpreting (though training will be provided)
  • Technology comfortable
  • Flexibility in your approach to work
  • Other Sign Language skills an advantage

What We Offer

role in a fast-paced environment

Job Title: Website Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Website Designer to create modern, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that blend strong visual design with usability and performance. This role requires both creative design expertise and hands-on CMS implementation skills.

The Website Designer will develop wireframes, create high-fidelity mockups, build pages within CMS platforms, customize styling with HTML/CSS, and ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, accessibility, and user experience.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong visual storytelling with technical execution and enjoys building websites that are both beautiful and high-performing.

Responsibilities

Website Design & User Experience

  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity website designs in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
    • Translate brand direction and business goals into responsive, user-friendly website layouts
    • Design websites optimized for usability, engagement, and conversion performance
    • Maintain visual consistency across pages, landing pages, and digital assets

CMS Development & Customization

  • Build, update, and maintain websites using platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify
    • Customize templates and themes using HTML, CSS, and light JavaScript
    • Manage plugins, integrations, widgets, forms, and third-party tools
    • Ensure websites remain scalable, organized, and easy to maintain

Website Optimization & SEO

  • Optimize websites for speed, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO best practices
    • Implement proper metadata, heading structures, alt text, schema markup, and internal linking
    • Run performance audits using Google PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar tools
    • Improve Core Web Vitals and mobile responsiveness across devices

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Test websites across browsers, screen sizes, and devices to ensure flawless functionality
    • Troubleshoot formatting issues, plugin conflicts, responsiveness problems, and broken functionality
    • Ensure websites maintain high performance and visual consistency post-launch

Collaboration & Feedback

  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to align websites with campaigns and business objectives
    • Incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining strong design integrity and usability standards
    • Communicate design decisions clearly and professionally across teams

File Management & Website Maintenance

  • Keep website files, assets, and design systems organized and up to date
    • Ensure CMS platforms, plugins, and integrations remain updated and secure
    • Maintain backups, revisions, and organized documentation for future updates

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong design eye paired with technical website implementation skills
    • Able to balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and SEO
    • Organized, detail-oriented, and methodical in testing and revisions
    • Collaborative communicator comfortable working across marketing, design, and development teams
    • Passionate about creating visually engaging and high-performing digital experiences

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional website design experience
    • Proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar design tools
    • Experience building and customizing websites on WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify

• Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and modern UX/UI standards
    • Experience optimizing websites for SEO, speed, and mobile responsiveness

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience designing for e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce)
    • Basic JavaScript or front-end development knowledge
    • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and SEO optimization workflows
    • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, marketing agencies, or e-commerce brands
    • Understanding of conversion-focused landing page design and user behavior optimization

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Website Designer’s day revolves around turning design concepts into functional, optimized digital experiences. You will:

  • Design layouts, prototypes, and landing pages aligned with brand and user experience goals
    • Build and customize websites within CMS platforms using HTML/CSS enhancements
    • Run performance, responsiveness, and SEO audits to improve speed and visibility
    • Test websites across browsers and devices to ensure flawless experiences
    • Collaborate with marketing and content teams on campaigns, landing pages, and site updates
    • Maintain website security, plugins, and ongoing design consistency

In essence: you ensure websites are visually engaging, responsive, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of website builds, revisions, and updates
    • Page load speeds optimized to <3 seconds
    • Mobile responsiveness and accessibility scores ≥90% (Lighthouse)
    • Positive stakeholder feedback on design quality and usability
    • SEO improvements including traffic growth, rankings, and reduced bounce rates
    • Reduced website bugs, formatting issues, and responsiveness problems

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Portfolio Review + Practical Task (e.g., design and implement a landing page in WordPress or Webflow)
    • Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification

jobs.title: Medical Billing Account Manager
jobs.description:
Medical Billing Account Manager – Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Standard U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Medical Billing Account Manager to support day-to-day Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations and ensure accurate, timely reimbursement across assigned client accounts.

This is an execution-focused role for a highly organized medical billing professional who can independently manage claim submissions, denial resolution, insurance follow-ups, collections, EOB/ERA review, and account management.

You’ll work within established billing workflows, manage high volumes of claims, communicate with insurance carriers and clients, and help ensure outstanding balances are resolved efficiently.

If you have hands-on medical billing and RCM experience and can independently take ownership of claims from submission through payment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs) to identify:
    • Payment discrepancies
    • Claim denials
    • Rejections
    • Underpayments
    • Non-payment reasons
  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve claim denials and rejections
  • Review claims for proper diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Apply appropriate billing modifiers to support accurate claim adjudication
  • Perform claims scrubbing and quality assurance before submission
  • Submit:
    • Initial claims
    • Corrected claims
    • Secondary claims
  • Follow payer-specific submission requirements
  • Manage claim queues and prioritize follow-up activities
  • Maintain accurate billing records, claim notes, and account documentation
  • Follow up promptly on unpaid, rejected, or underpaid claims

Denial Management & Claims Follow-Up

  • Investigate the root causes of denied and rejected claims
  • Determine appropriate next steps for claim resolution
  • Correct billing or claim information where required
  • Track unresolved claims through final resolution
  • Follow up consistently with insurance carriers
  • Monitor claim status and reimbursement timelines
  • Help reduce preventable denials and delayed payments
  • Maintain clear documentation of all follow-up activities

Account Management & Insurance Follow-Up

  • Research payer portals and insurance websites to resolve claim issues
  • Obtain claim status and payment updates from insurance carriers
  • Communicate with payers regarding billing and reimbursement inquiries
  • Support client account management and respond to billing-related questions
  • Monitor aging accounts and support collections activities
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure outstanding billing issues are followed through to resolution

Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain accuracy and compliance with payer guidelines and billing requirements
  • Meet established:
    • Productivity targets
    • Quality standards
    • Turnaround-time expectations
  • Maintain accurate and complete billing documentation
  • Identify recurring billing trends and potential process issues
  • Recommend practical improvements where appropriate
  • Work independently while maintaining a high level of accountability and accuracy

Requirements

  • Previous professional experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Hands-on medical billing experience in a production environment
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Claim submission
    • Denial management
    • Claims follow-up
    • Collections
  • Ability to read and interpret EOBs and ERAs
  • Experience reviewing diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Knowledge of billing modifiers and claims scrubbing processes
  • Experience working with insurance payer portals and medical billing systems
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage billing responsibilities with minimal supervision
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while managing a high volume of claims
  • Previous remote work experience preferred
  • Availability during standard U.S. business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-volume medical billing environments
  • Experience supporting Texas-based medical practices
  • Experience with insurance verification
  • Experience managing client billing accounts
  • Strong background in denial resolution and collections
  • Experience working directly with insurance carriers and payer portals

EHR & Practice Management Systems

Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:

  • eClinicalWorks
  • Aprima
  • Medisoft
  • Veradigm
  • Nextech
  • CureMD
  • Office Practicum
  • NextGen

Tools & Technology

eClinicalWorks | Aprima | Medisoft | Veradigm | Nextech | CureMD | Office Practicum | NextGen | Insurance Payer Portals | EHR Systems | Practice Management Systems | Medical Billing Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience with medical billing and RCM workflows
  • Can independently resolve claim denials and payment issues
  • Understand the full process from claim submission through reimbursement
  • Are comfortable interpreting EOBs, ERAs, codes, and payer responses
  • Know how to prioritize aging and outstanding claims
  • Can manage a high volume of claims without sacrificing accuracy
  • Follow up persistently until billing issues are resolved
  • Communicate effectively with clients, insurance providers, and internal teams
  • Take ownership without requiring constant supervision
  • Thrive in a remote environment and consistently meet productivity expectations

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing claim queues, EOBs, ERAs, and aging accounts to identify claims requiring immediate attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll submit and review claims, resolve denials, follow up with insurance carriers, research payer requirements, update billing documentation, and monitor outstanding balances across assigned accounts.

You may also communicate with clients regarding billing questions, investigate underpayments, update claim notes, and identify recurring issues that could be affecting reimbursement.

In short: you keep the revenue cycle moving by ensuring claims are accurate, denials are resolved, outstanding balances are followed up on, and payments are collected efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Clean and accurate claim submissions
  • Reduced claim denial and rejection rates
  • Timely resolution of denied claims
  • Improved claims turnaround time
  • Consistent follow-up on unpaid and underpaid claims
  • Aging accounts actively managed
  • Improved collections and reimbursement
  • Accurate account and claim documentation
  • Achievement of productivity and quality targets
  • Strong client account management
  • Reduced outstanding claim backlog
  • Consistent compliance with payer requirements

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership across the medical billing and RCM lifecycle
  • Direct impact on reimbursement and revenue performance
  • Exposure to multiple payer portals and billing systems
  • Opportunity to manage client accounts independently
  • Work across claims, denials, collections, and insurance follow-up
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Medical Billing Account Manager
    • Senior RCM Specialist
    • RCM Team Lead
    • Medical Billing Manager
    • Revenue Cycle Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application and completing the required Spark Hire video interview, our recruitment team will review your experience and qualifications.

Candidates whose backgrounds closely match the role may be asked about their experience with medical billing, RCM, denial management, claims follow-up, collections, payer communications, and EHR/Practice Management systems.

Candidates with experience supporting high-volume medical billing operations, particularly Texas-based practices, will receive strong consideration.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience in Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and know how to manage claims, resolve denials, follow up with payers, and improve reimbursement, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced medical billing professional who can combine accuracy, persistence, account management, and operational ownership in a remote environment.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Founding ML Engineer — Computer Vision (Object Detection)
On behalf of an AI commerce tech startup · Remote in North America · Full-time

The build:Our client is an early-stage commerce tech company building production computer vision for precise item identification and pricing. As founding ML engineer, you'll own the identification architecture, data strategy, evaluation standards, and production serving path — end to end, from foundation models fine-tuned toward a specific catalog.

The problem is fine-grained: brand, model, edition, variant. "Close" isn't good enough.

What you'll do

  • Design and own the CV architecture for fine-grained item identification — starting from foundation vision models, fine-tuning toward the company's catalog.
  • Define what "accurate enough" means per category; build calibrated confidence scoring so the product says "we're not sure" instead of guessing.
  • Build the feedback loop between model errors and what gets labeled next, with the labeling lead.
  • Decide where to invest: broader category coverage vs. deeper accuracy on today's categories.
  • Own the serving path from research to production — latency, cost, reliability at scale.
  • Represent the model's capabilities and limits company-wide — including with investors and customers.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years applied CV, with at least one system shipped to production at meaningful scale.
  • Hands-on fine-grained / instance-level classification — a problem where "close" isn't good enough.
  • Fluency in PyTorch or TensorFlow; fine-tuning and deploying vision transformers or CNNs in production.
  • Evaluation frameworks for vision models — you know when a model isactuallygetting better.
  • Comfortable being the most senior technical voice on an open-ended problem with no playbook.
  • Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have:resale/marketplace (StockX, GOAT, Vinted, Rebag, The RealReal) or visual search (Pinterest Lens, Google Lens, Syte); active learning / human-in-the-loop pipelines; low-latency API serving at scale; first-ML-hire startup experience.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote (UK hours)

About the Company

Our client is an established UK-based business specialising in the supply and installation of premium stone worktops and bespoke surfaces for residential and commercial projects.

Operating within the manufacturing, construction and home improvement sectors, the company is looking for an experienced Financial Controller to take full ownership of its accounting operations, financial reporting and compliance.

Job Summary

We are looking for a fully qualified, experienced Financial Controller to independently manage the complete finance function of a UK-based business.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong expertise in UK accounting, financial reporting, VAT, payroll, credit control, cost accounting and reconciliations.

Fluent spoken and written English is essential, as this is a client-facing position involving direct communication with UK customers, suppliers, company directors and HMRC.

The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented and confident managing financial operations independently from day one, without requiring foundational training.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Prepare accurate monthly management accounts, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.
  • Deliver monthly financial reports to company directors by the 10th working day of the following month.
  • Manage month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring accurate reporting and reconciliations.
  • Prepare year-end financial packs for external accountants.
  • Maintain and update a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast weekly.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decisions.

UK Tax, Payroll & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit UK VAT returns under Making Tax Digital (MTD).
  • Manage PAYE payroll, RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions and statutory payments.
  • Handle CIS submissions and construction VAT domestic reverse charge requirements where applicable.
  • Maintain compliance with HMRC regulations and statutory reporting deadlines.
  • Liaise directly with HMRC and external accountants regarding tax and compliance matters.

Accounts Receivable & Credit Control

  • Oversee invoicing, collections and debtor management.
  • Communicate directly with UK customers via phone and email to resolve payment issues and recover outstanding debts.
  • Prepare and distribute weekly aged-debtor reports.
  • Maintain debtor days below 45 days and minimise overdue balances.

Accounts Payable & Reconciliations

  • Manage supplier invoices, payment schedules and purchase ledger accuracy.
  • Perform regular bank, credit card and ledger reconciliations.
  • Reconcile VAT, payroll and other control accounts monthly.
  • Ensure supplier payments are processed accurately and within agreed terms.

Cost Accounting & Operational Finance

  • Monitor job-level profitability, project costs and site-level financial performance.
  • Track material costs, stock usage and wastage, including stone slabs, glass and other manufacturing materials.
  • Analyse project margins and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
  • Support financial management of company vehicles, fleet costs and financing arrangements.
  • Work with banks, lenders and external financial partners when required.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate financial records using Xero or comparable cloud accounting software.
  • Improve accounting processes, internal controls and reporting efficiency.
  • Support accounting software migrations, CRM integrations and automation of routine financial tasks.

Requirements

  • Qualified Accountant: Fully qualified ACCA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent recognised accounting qualification.
  • UK Accounting Experience: Ideally 3+ years of hands-on experience managing the full accounts function of a UK limited company.
  • Financial Reporting: Proven ability to independently prepare accurate P&L statements, balance sheets, management accounts and year-end figures.
  • UK VAT & Payroll: Strong practical experience with Making Tax Digital (MTD), PAYE, RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions and statutory payments.
  • Credit Control: Confident chasing outstanding payments and communicating directly with UK customers via phone and email.
  • Account Reconciliation: Strong experience with bank, ledger and control account reconciliations.
  • Cost Accounting: Experience tracking costs, monitoring profitability and managing financial data.
  • Accounting Software: Proficiency in Xero, Sage or QuickBooks, with strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Fluent English (Mandatory): Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently with UK stakeholders.
  • Independent Working: Able to take full ownership of the finance function from day one with minimal supervision and no foundational training.
  • Remote Setup: Reliable computer, fast internet connection and a quiet, secure workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in construction, manufacturing, real estate or the kitchen and bathroom industry.
  • Knowledge of CIS and the UK construction VAT domestic reverse charge.
  • Experience with job costing, inventory management and material wastage tracking.
  • Familiarity with CRM integrations, accounting software migrations and process automation.
  • Experience handling HMRC enquiries and corporation tax matters.
  • Knowledge of vehicle financing, fleet costs and banking relationships.
  • Previous experience working remotely with UK-based companies.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

🌍 Fully remote position working with an established UK business.

📈 Long-term career growth and professional development opportunities.

🚀 Opportunity to take ownership of the finance function and improve financial operations.

🎯 High-impact role working directly with company directors.

💻 Remote working environment with a UK-based team.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Head of European Partner Engagement and Research
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

The Partnership on AI (PAI) is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.

We are a nonprofit that invites diverse voices into the process of technical governance, design, and deployment of AI technologies. Our diverse Partners work together across industry, academia, and civil society to form responsible AI solutions so that AI empowers humanity -- contributing to a more just, equitable, and prosperous world.

WHY EUROPE, WHY NOW

Europe is an essential contributor to PAI's mission, home to a number of critical organisations and institutions leading the way on safe and responsible AI. PAI already counts more than 20 partner organisations across the UK and Europe — spanning private sector partners in and outside the tech industry, civil society, media, and academic institutions, alongside close collaboration with policy bodies. Joining our team here means working at the centre of that network.

Candidates should expect to travel to the selected city for monthly in-person meetups.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Head of Europe will join PAI's international department to lead the organization's engagement and research within the European AI ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, International this role will set and lead PAI's engagement and research strategy in Europe by deepening relationships with existing partners and stakeholders, identifying and cultivating new partnerships, and leading convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key stakeholders across industry, civil society, and academia. The role will lead the development of guidance and research outputs that align PAI's global programmatic priorities with issues of direct relevance and resonance in the region.

Beyond its European focus, the role also carries a broader international component. The Head of Europe will partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new PAI hubs in new regions and engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnership Development(Est. time: 30%)

  • Serve as PAI’s primary point of contact and relationship-builder in Europe, reinforcing the organization’s role as a bridge between sectors and geographies.
  • Deepen and sustain relationships with PAI’s existing partners and stakeholders across Europe, including industry, civil society, academia, and government, in collaboration with the Programs & Research and Policy teams.
  • Identify new strategic and meaningful partners in Europe, that expands PAI reach and multistakeholder community.
  • In cooperation with the Partnership Development team, identify, cultivate, and engage new strategic partners in Europe who expand PAI’s reach and multistakeholder community and advance its mission in the region.
  • Working with the Director of Development, identify and pursue European funding opportunities (including foundations, philanthropic organizations, corporate partners), and contribute to proposals and strategic fundraising tied to PAI’s European events and initiatives.

Convenings & Coordination(Est. time: 20%)

  • Drive activities to convene and support PAI’s European Steering Committee (including preparation of position papers and agendas).
  • Contribute to other relevant related committees in Europe, such as the Policy Steering Committee, by participating in their convenings and virtual events, and by providing feedback and suggestions on their composition and outputs, ensuring complementarity and cross-pollination.
  • Design, organize, and host convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key partners and stakeholders.
  • Oversee logistics and substantive content for European events, ensuring they reflect PAI's multi-stakeholder approach and mission.
  • Represent PAI at relevant European conferences, working groups, and policy forums.

Research & Guidance Development(Est. time: 30%)

  • Identify and scope emerging, high-impact, and time-sensitive topics for PAI’s research in Europe.
  • Lead the development of guidance and research outputs aligned with PAI's global programmatic priorities, with direct relevance and resonance for the European region. Work closely with members of the Programs & Research as well as Policy teams to deliver this goal.
  • Working with the Communications team, author and co-author research papers, blogs, and op-eds in collaboration with PAI staff and Partners that build visibility around PAI research and engagement in Europe.
  • Contribute European perspectives and expertise to PAI's global research agenda.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Broader International Strategy (Est. time: 20%)

  • Work closely with internal PAI departments to ensure European insights inform global programmatic and research priorities.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new regional hubs.
  • Support engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South, and represent PAI at international convenings.

Other

  • This role requires flexibility to work extended or later hours one to two days per week to accommodate meetings with colleagues in U.S. time zones, ensuring overlap with Eastern and Pacific working hours.
  • The position also involves travel of approximately 20% of the time, both within Europe and internationally, including to North America and Africa.
  • The list of responsibilities set out are not exhaustive It may be necessary to adapt tasks within the scope of the role as needed.

WHO YOU ARE / WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Masters degree or higher in related discipline or equivalent (7-10 years) workexperience required.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, international team.
  • A strong team player, who is able to work across the organization, and coordinate between teams when designing/delivering work.
  • Significant professional experience in AI policy, governance, technology partnerships, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of the European AI ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders across industry, civil society, academia, and/or government.
  • Experience designing and leading convenings, working groups, or multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-stakeholder input into clear guidance and research outputs.
  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe as needed for convenings and stakeholder meetings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to navigate a small yet complex institution
  • Willingness to participate constructively on organizational priorities beyond the immediate focus of their work
  • Existing network of relationships with European AI policymakers, civil society organizations, and industry leaders.
  • Familiarity with PAI's mission, programmatic work, and multi-stakeholder model.
  • Experience contributing to or authoring research or guidance documents on AI governance topics.
  • Comfort with institutional change and periods of ambiguity

QUALITIES THAT ARE IMPORTANT TO US:

  • Justice: Notices and addresses inequities, includes diverse perspectives, and acts fairly in decisions and collaboration.
  • Trust: Communicates openly, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates reliability and integrity.
  • Respect: Listens fully, values others’ time and contributions, and collaborates thoughtfully.
  • Compassion: Shows empathy, patience, and care, especially when supporting colleagues or navigating challenges.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. What matters most is your commitment to PAI’s mission and the potential you bring. We are actively interested in building a diverse pool of candidates and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Compensation

PAI’s compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to fairness and equity across our distributed team. Compensation is based on role level, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.

The compensation range for this role depends on where you are based:

  • London, UK: £88,166 – £96,985 GBP
  • Brussels, Belgium: €109,574 – €120,534 EUR
  • Amsterdam, Netherlands: €103,764 – €120,333 EUR

In Belgium, the required 13th-month pay and double holiday pay are paid on top of this base salary range. In the Netherlands, the statutory 8% holiday allowance is paid on top of this base salary range.

Benefits

PAI offers a generous paid leave and benefits package. Time off, health, and retirement benefits are tailored to each country, with the aim of being comparable to our US package. Our benefits currently include:

  • Generous paid vacation, local public holidays, three personal reflection days, and sick and family leave in line with or above local requirements
  • Health and retirement benefits tailored to each country
  • Monthly cell phone reimbursement
  • Annual funds to support professional development
  • Monthly allowance for co-working space access
  • Regular team lunches and focused work days
  • Opportunities to attend AI-related conferences and collaborate with our partners across industry, academia, and civil society

Please refer to our careers page for an updated list of benefits.

Location and Work Authorization

  • PAI is a remote-first organization with a global membership base and scope. This role is eligible for remote work in London (UK), Brussels (Belgium), or Amsterdam (Netherlands).
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they will be based. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Partnership on AI (PAI) is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and organizational needs, without discrimination. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, professional development, advancement, compensation, and benefits.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Candidates who require reasonable adjustments or accommodations during the hiring process are encouraged to let us know.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume.

Our hiring process typically includes an initial HR screen, one or more interviews with the hiring team, and a final conversation with senior leadership. We aim to keep candidates informed at each stage and will communicate expected timelines at the outset.

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Denmark. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.
