jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability & Telemetry Data
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Observability Engineering owns the breadth and depth of observability and telemetry at Smartsheet. We build and operate the shared platform every engineering team depends on to understand how their software behaves in production (metrics, logs, distributed traces, RUM, synthetics, and AI/agentic telemetry) across a global, multi-region, commercial and government footprint. We are consolidating ownership of all of it into a single correlated platform, and treating telemetry as what it actually is: one of the largest and most valuable datasets at the company. It's a broad mandate with real scope to shape, and we hold this internal platform to the same rigor, reliability, and product standards as customer-facing software.

As a Principal Software Engineer (Observability & Telemetry Data), you will set the technical direction for how Smartsheet collects, models, stores, and derives value from telemetry data. This is an architect role: you will define the telemetry data platform and the standards that govern it, carry that architecture across engineering org boundaries, partner with our Data and AI Platform teams on Databricks and MLflow integration, and act as the company's definitive technical voice on observability. You will influence roadmaps you do not own, resolve the hard design trade-offs between fidelity and cost, and raise the technical bar for every engineer instrumenting a service.

This full-time position reports to the Team Lead, Observability Engineering and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will

  • Architect the Telemetry Data Platform: Own the end-to-end design for how telemetry is landed, modeled, and queried, including open table formats, partitioning and schema evolution strategy, separation of storage and compute, tiered retention, and the query interfaces engineers actually use. Make telemetry a durable, portable, Smartsheet-owned dataset rather than a vendor-locked byproduct.
  • Own the Telemetry Data Model: Define the semantic conventions, shared business identifiers (user, org, plan, tenant), and schema standards that let any signal be correlated with any other, and drive their adoption across every service team at Smartsheet.
  • Set OpenTelemetry Direction: Lead the migration to OTel-based instrumentation, defining collector architecture, context propagation, and sampling strategy (including tail-based sampling) so that engineers can move from a log line to a trace to a metric without losing the thread.
  • Integrate AI and Agentic Telemetry with Databricks: Own the architecture connecting our observability platform to Databricks and MLflow, so that agentic and model telemetry (prompt, completion, tool and MCP calls, evaluation results) is captured un-sampled, stays useful under the input/output redaction our governance requires, and reconciles cleanly with the traces and metrics in our primary observability stack.
  • Instrument the Data Platform Itself: Bring first-class observability to our data estate, including Databricks jobs, pipelines, and warehouses, with meaningful signals for freshness, data quality, lineage, and cost, so data reliability is measured with the same discipline as service reliability.
  • Build the Analytics Layer on Telemetry: Turn telemetry into decision-grade analytics, covering reliability and incident metrics, telemetry cost and chargeback models, and adoption and coverage reporting that leadership can act on.
  • Engineer Collection and Routing at Scale: Architect the high-volume collection and routing tier (FluentBit, Kinesis, and OTel collectors) that moves telemetry from every service to its destination across US, EU, AU, and GovCloud regions, and own the migration of these pipelines as we consolidate onto a unified backend.
  • Own Telemetry Economics: Set the cost architecture for observability data, including ingest governance, cardinality control, and storage tiering, so that teams get the fidelity they need to debug without the spend pressure that causes them to under-instrument.
  • Carry Architecture Across Org Boundaries: Partner with the Data Platform, AI Platform, and infrastructure organizations to align telemetry architecture with theirs, influence roadmaps you do not own, and represent observability in company-level platform and vendor decisions.
  • Raise the Technical Bar: Lead design and code reviews, author the architecture decisions and standards others build against, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on instrumentation, telemetry data modeling, and cost-aware design.
  • Participate in a production support and on-call rotation, taking ownership of the most complex issue resolution and driving root-cause analysis that improves system resiliency.

You Have

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, data platforms, or observability infrastructure, including time at Principal or Staff level.
  • Deep Observability Expertise: Hands-on production ownership of metrics, logs, and distributed tracing at scale, including at least one major backend (Datadog, or comparable) and a working understanding of cardinality and cost mechanics.
  • Telemetry Data Engineering: Demonstrated depth in large-scale data architecture, including open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg), Spark or comparable distributed processing, streaming ingestion, partitioning and schema evolution, and query performance and cost tuning over very large datasets.
  • Databricks Depth: Practical experience with the Databricks platform (jobs, clusters, Unity Catalog, Delta) and with MLflow for model and agent telemetry.
  • OpenTelemetry Depth: Practical experience with OTel collectors, semantic conventions, context propagation, and sampling strategy, including tail-based sampling.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Experience with high-volume log and telemetry pipelines, including FluentBit or Fluentd, streaming transport such as Kinesis or Kafka, and search backend index and mapping design.
  • Advanced AWS & Kubernetes Expertise: EKS, ECS Fargate, EC2, Lambda, and CloudWatch in production.
  • 10+ years of programming experience with modern languages such as Go, Java, Python, or Scala, and strong SQL.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, and GitOps workflows such as Flux or ArgoCD.
  • Architectural Influence at Scale: A track record of setting technical direction that multiple teams and organizations adopted, including the written artifacts (architecture decisions, standards, RFCs) that made it durable after you moved on.
  • Strong incident response instincts, with experience improving mean-time-to-resolution through better instrumentation and better data rather than more heroics.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Nice to Have

  • Experience instrumenting LLM or agentic systems, including OTel GenAI semantic conventions and tracing agent tool-call workflows.
  • Data reliability engineering practice: freshness, quality, and lineage SLOs for production data pipelines
  • Telemetry cost engineering or FinOps at scale.
  • Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, GovCloud) and designing telemetry that remains useful under redaction.
  • Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
  • Snowflake, or experience operating across more than one lakehouse or warehouse platform.
  • Service catalog or internal developer platform work (Backstage or similar).

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

AI is reshaping what product security can accomplish, both as a target and as a tool. We're looking for a Principal Security Engineer to own the highest-leverage application security work at Smartsheet: leading threat modeling and product security reviews across a modern SaaS platform used by millions of customers, serving as the team's technical authority on AI security risk, and setting the technical standard for application security practice across the engineering organization.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on the Application Security team. The expectation is not just depth: it is reach. You will engage product and engineering leadership directly, drive security requirements rather than advisory recommendations, and build team capability over time. If you are a security engineer who thinks upstream, builds threat models that generate concrete test scenarios and can translate technical findings into architecture decisions and business outcomes, this role is built for you.

This role reports to the Manager, Application Security and can be based in our Bellevue, WA office or remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

  • Lead Threat Modeling and Product Security Reviews: Own threat modeling and product security review as the team's primary upstream capability: build models from architecture and data-flow artifacts, derive concrete abuse cases and test scenarios, and drive security requirements into designs before they ship. Define and lead the product security review service (set the service model, triage criteria, and enforcement posture) and personally execute reviews for high-risk features with documented findings and remediation timelines. Engage product and engineering directly to establish security requirements at the design phase, with the technical credibility to influence architecture decisions.
  • Define AI Security Methodology and Drive It Across the Practice: Define how AI security risk is assessed, monitored, and mitigated across product, engineering, and third-party AI integrations, with recognized depth on the current threat landscape: LLM workflows, agentic pipelines, MCP-based integrations, and attack classes including prompt injection, indirect injection, and tool-calling authorization gaps. Own and evolve the AI-assisted security review capability: evaluate detection value, assess build-vs-buy tradeoffs, and shape toolchain coverage as Smartsheet's AI-integrated product surface scales.
  • Shape AppSec Technical Direction and SDLC Controls: Serve as the technical authority for the AppSec program's SDLC control surface (secure coding guidelines, CI/CD pipeline security strategy, and toolchain direction across SAST, SCA, secrets, and IaC scanning) with the depth to influence tool decisions and resolve standards decisions that span teams without primary operational ownership. Build runbooks, standards, and documentation that create consistency and reduce single-point-of-failure risk as the team scales.
  • Elevate Team Capability and Engineering Organization Influence: Mentor AppSec team members on threat modeling tradecraft and security review design, and serve as the trusted technical voice with product and engineering leadership, framing risk in terms that move architecture decisions. Your judgment shapes how the team prioritizes and how the broader organization understands and invests in application security.

You Have:

  • 10+ years in application security with a track record of sustained technical leadership in product security or AppSec engineering, including direct ownership of threat modeling programs and security review services at scale.
  • Ability to own threat modeling as a systematic practice (STRIDE, data-flow and architecture diagram driven), producing concrete, actionable test scenarios and abuse cases, embedded into agile design cycles as a repeatable, lightweight practice.
  • Hands-on experience securing AI-integrated applications (LLM workflows, agentic systems, model APIs, MCP-based integrations) with fluency in the OWASP LLM Top 10 and current AI attack classes, plus experience using AI tooling to scale security review coverage.
  • Experience doing architecture review and targeted manual code review for complex SaaS features, with a track record of driving remediation requirements through to implementation with enough technical credibility to influence design decisions at the engineering leadership level.
  • Experience mentoring engineers into threat modeling ownership and attacker-mindset review design; demonstrated track record of establishing security requirements as design-phase gates and sustaining engagement with engineering teams to drive implementation.
  • Sufficient depth in SAST, SCA, secrets, and IaC scanning in modern CI/CD pipelines to credibly influence toolchain direction, resolve standards decisions that span teams, and shape secure coding standards without primary operational ownership; cloud security fundamentals sufficient to tie application controls to the infrastructure they run on.
  • Fluent in one or more modern languages (Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or equivalent); comfortable reading production codebases to surface issues tooling misses and writing or extending automation others can maintain.
  • Expertise communicating risk and security requirements (written and verbal) clearly across audiences from engineering ICs through executive leadership; recognized as a trusted technical voice by partner teams.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships across engineering, product, and security organizations; earns influence through technical credibility and sustained engagement.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

Nice to Have:

  • GitLab CI/CD experience, including security policy pipeline configuration and scanning job integration.
  • Experience building AI-assisted security tooling or LLM-integrated review workflows that scale security review coverage.
  • Penetration testing depth including exploit writing or vulnerability chaining to validate exploitability and prove real-world impact.
  • Public-facing security contributions: conference speaking, CVE credits, published research, or industry community recognition that reflects the technical authority expected at principal level.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$205,000—$257,500 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

jobs.title: Safety Analysis Engineer
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Safety Analysis Engineer to join our team.

Position Description:

We are seeking a skilled Safety Analysis Engineer to support the development of the safety basis for a first-of-a-kind used nuclear fuel recycling facility. You will support the identification and evaluation of hazards/accidents, the designation of Items Relied On For Safety (IROFS), and the development of management measures. Additionally, you will support radiological, subcriticality, chemical, and fire safety programs.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Develop and maintain safety basis documents according to applicable Nuclear Regulatory Commission regulation and guidance
  • Support Integrated Safety Analysis (ISA), Criticality Safety Evaluations, Fire Hazard Analysis (FHA), and Natural Phenomena Hazard (NPH) analysis
  • Identify and evaluate radiological, criticality, chemical, fire, and natural phenomena hazards
  • Identify and evaluate accident sequences using both inductive and deductive methods
  • Perform deterministic consequence severity calculations for radiological/chemical source term and dose
  • Perform likelihood calculations using qualitative and semi-quantitative (e.g., layers of protection analysis)
  • Designate items relied on for safety (IROFS) for the prevention and mitigation of accidents
  • Develop management measures to ensure adequate availability and reliability of IROFS

Competencies:

We are looking for a Safety Analysis Engineer that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • An optimist at heart
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, nuclear engineering, or related discipline; a master's or Ph.D. is highly desirable
  • 3-5 years of experience in experience in nuclear safety, process safety, or similar high-hazard environments.
  • Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) and Failure Modes and Effects (FMEA) PHA methods

Bonus Qualifications:

  • NRC licensed fuel cycle facility safety basis development
  • Consequence severity analysis using RADTRAD, MELCOR/MACCS, ARCON and PAVAN
  • Event tree and fault tree analysis
  • NUREG-1513, NUREG-1520, NUREG-1718 and relevant regulatory frameworks

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Even excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $85,000-$165,000 annually

Oklo offers flexible time off, bonuses, equity, competitive pay, 401k, health insurance, FSA, flexible work hours, and other benefits.

We are looking to fill this position immediately!

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Secondary: Identity and clean-room measurement

  • Assist in applying privacy-preserving analytical techniques to deliver aggregate insights without exposing individual-level data
  • Build and maintain scoring, segmentation, and propensity models as part of the broader identity graph analytics stack

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Economics, or a related field, plus 5+ years of experience in applied data science or analytics.
  • Working knowledge of statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, and causal inference concepts
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R and SQL
  • Exposure to marketing measurement concepts (incrementality, attribution, MMM) and media metrics (impressions, reach/frequency, attribution windows), or demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Comfort working with large, complex, multi-source datasets on cloud/data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS)

Preferred

  • Internship or prior work experience in AdTech/MarTech or a data-driven product environment
  • Exposure to identity resolution, graph-based data structures, or clean room environments
  • Familiarity with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI)

  • Coursework or project experience in causal inference or experimental design
  • Exposure to LLMs, RAG, MCP, and AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analysis and documentation, with sound practices for validating AI-generated code and agentic or AI-assisted workflows

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer, Enterprise Deployments
jobs.description:
About Quilter

At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

  1. Curiosity

  2. Conviction

  3. Rigor

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Platform Engineer to lead customer-facing deployments and integrations of Quilter in enterprise environments.

Quilter uses AI to automate printed circuit board placement and routing. Our Platform team builds the infrastructure that runs these compute-intensive workloads and supports our cloud service and customer-managed deployments. You’ll own systems from design through operation and help shape a growing team’s technical direction.

You’ll work directly with customer engineering and IT teams and our go-to-market team, carrying deployments from discovery through validation and handoff. Customer conversations, identity integration, and hands-on troubleshooting are central to the role. You’ll also build automation and diagnostic tools with the engineers who own our shared deployment platform, so each engagement improves how we serve the next customer.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead customer deployment planning. Understand the customer’s environment, goals, and constraints; identify dependencies; agree on success criteria; and create a clear path to a working deployment.

  • Deploy and integrate Quilter. Work with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networking, storage, identity providers, and access controls across customer-managed and dedicated environments.

  • Own enterprise identity integrations. Configure and debug OpenID Connect (OIDC) SSO with customer IT teams, including application registration, login flows, claims, and access mapping. Maintain integrations through credential and policy changes, and turn repeated fixes into setup guides and automated validation.

  • Own troubleshooting through resolution. Investigate failures across application and infrastructure boundaries, work effectively with limited access, and keep customers and internal teams informed about findings and next steps.

  • Make installations and upgrades repeatable. Partner with Platform engineers on deployment automation, preflight checks, configuration validation, upgrade and rollback procedures, and useful diagnostics.

  • Help customers integrate Quilter into their workflows. Build practical scripts and integrations around supported interfaces, coordinate with product and engineering teams, and recognize patterns that should become shared capabilities.

  • Make customer handoffs clear. Validate the deployment and identity integration, teach customer teams how to use and support their environment, and document the operating responsibilities and escalation paths shared between Quilter and the customer.

  • Connect customer needs to engineering priorities. Explain tradeoffs, distinguish confirmed capabilities from proposed work, manage scope, and coordinate commitments with engineering and go-to-market partners.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience delivering and supporting production software in cloud or customer-managed environments, with ownership through deployment and operation.

  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with external customers or partners on technical implementation, integration, or troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience implementing and debugging OIDC-based SSO with enterprise identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta. You understand OAuth 2.0 fundamentals, tokens, claims, and application access, and can resolve integration issues with customer IT.

  • Practical Kubernetes and container fluency: you can inspect and debug workloads, understand deployment configuration, and investigate failures involving networking, storage, or permissions.

  • Solid cloud infrastructure fundamentals, including compute, networking, IAM, and storage. AWS experience is particularly useful; experience in other clouds transfers well.

  • Experience using infrastructure as code and building maintainable automation. You can read application code, follow logs and traces, and write tools or integrations in a language such as Python or Go.

  • Clear verbal and written communication across technical audiences. You ask useful discovery questions, explain uncertainty, teach effectively, and leave people with a concrete action plan.

  • Strong ownership and judgment: you follow through, escalate when needed, make sensible scope tradeoffs, and work with teammates to turn one-off fixes into lasting improvements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building reusable installers, upgrade checks, or diagnostic tooling for customer-managed deployments.

  • Experience with Helm, Terraform, and deployments across AWS, Azure, or customer-managed Kubernetes.

  • Experience with on-premises, restricted-network, offline, hybrid, or bring-your-own-cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with observability and support tooling for environments where direct production access is limited.

  • Experience supporting security-sensitive enterprise customers or working with their IT and security review processes.

  • Familiarity with compute-intensive workloads, GPUs, or engineering software.

What Success Looks Like

Customers reach a validated deployment, can sign in through their identity provider with the intended access, and have clear operating responsibilities and support paths. Installations and upgrades become easier to repeat, and recurring deployment and identity issues are resolved through shared tooling and product improvements.

Please note: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Quality & Evaluation
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer, AI Quality & Evaluation to build the engineering systems that help Bask Health test, evaluate, and improve AI-powered applications throughout their development and production lifecycles.

Bask Health supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses through a platform that connects patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools. As we introduce more AI-powered capabilities across these areas, we need reliable software infrastructure that makes it easy for engineering teams to understand how those systems behave.

You'll help develop the internal tools, backend services, testing frameworks, and automation that support AI quality assurance across the platform.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building reusable systems rather than evaluating individual models in isolation. You'll work with APIs, databases, automated testing infrastructure, model integrations, and developer tools to make AI evaluation more efficient, consistent, and accessible.

Your work may include evaluation execution services, test dataset management tools, automated regression pipelines, result comparison systems, and interfaces that help engineers investigate AI failures.

You'll collaborate with applied AI engineers, machine learning engineers, AI evaluation specialists, and backend engineers to understand their testing needs and translate those requirements into dependable software capabilities.

You'll also help integrate AI evaluation into normal engineering workflows. This includes making it easier to run tests during development, compare model or prompt changes, inspect failures, and identify regressions before production releases.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll help ensure evaluation systems handle sensitive information appropriately, respect access permissions, and support testing for privacy, safety, and approved operational boundaries.

This position emphasizes strong software engineering fundamentals, developer experience, and production reliability. You'll contribute to technical architecture, write maintainable code, improve infrastructure performance, and own services that other engineering teams rely on.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys building tools for other developers, understands the challenges of testing nondeterministic AI systems, and wants to create reliable infrastructure that improves software quality across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain software infrastructure that supports AI quality and evaluation across Bask Health.
  • Develop backend services that execute and manage automated AI evaluations.
  • Build reusable testing tools for large language model applications.
  • Create APIs that allow engineering teams to submit evaluation jobs and retrieve results.
  • Develop systems for managing evaluation datasets, test cases, and expected outcomes.
  • Build automated workflows for comparing prompts, models, and application configurations.
  • Implement regression testing infrastructure for AI-powered features.
  • Integrate AI evaluation checks into continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • Develop services that record and organize evaluation results over time.
  • Build tools that help engineers inspect AI responses, failures, and test histories.
  • Implement structured result storage and comparison capabilities.
  • Develop internal dashboards or interfaces for reviewing evaluation outcomes.
  • Create reusable software libraries that simplify AI testing across multiple applications.
  • Build systems that support both deterministic checks and model-based evaluations.
  • Implement automated testing for tool-calling behavior and structured model outputs.
  • Develop infrastructure for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation applications.
  • Build asynchronous processing systems for large evaluation workloads.
  • Implement job scheduling, retries, timeouts, and error handling for evaluation services.
  • Develop monitoring and logging for evaluation infrastructure.
  • Optimize evaluation execution speed, reliability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Work with AI evaluation engineers to translate testing requirements into reusable software tools.
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers to support model and prompt comparison workflows.
  • Implement appropriate access controls and secure handling of evaluation data.
  • Ensure evaluation infrastructure respects tenant boundaries and data privacy requirements.
  • Investigate infrastructure failures and resolve issues affecting evaluation reliability.
  • Improve developer documentation and internal tooling for AI testing.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and architecture discussions.
  • Own assigned AI quality engineering projects from design through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling roles.
  • Experience building and maintaining production backend services.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Experience designing and developing APIs and service integrations.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and software quality practices.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and deployment workflows.
  • Experience building reusable software components or internal engineering tools.
  • Familiarity with large language models and modern AI application development.
  • Understanding of the challenges involved in testing nondeterministic AI systems.
  • Experience working with relational databases and structured application data.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous processing and background job systems.
  • Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals and service reliability.
  • Experience developing automated testing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure service communication.
  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, and production diagnostics.
  • Ability to troubleshoot backend services and infrastructure issues.
  • Familiarity with configuration management and software release processes.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Understanding of API error handling, retries, and failure recovery.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into reusable engineering systems.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, AI engineers, and machine learning specialists.
  • Ability to independently own engineering projects from technical design through deployment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building infrastructure for AI evaluation or machine learning testing.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Experience with LangSmith, DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, or comparable evaluation tools.
  • Familiarity with LLM-as-a-judge evaluation approaches.
  • Experience building evaluation execution services or automated benchmark systems.
  • Familiarity with AI regression testing and prompt comparison workflows.
  • Experience developing internal developer platforms or SDKs.
  • Experience building testing infrastructure for distributed applications.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js backend development.
  • Experience with React or Next.js for internal tooling interfaces.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, Drizzle, or comparable development tools.
  • Experience working with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or related cloud services.
  • Familiarity with serverless infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Experience with SST or comparable application deployment frameworks.
  • Experience building scalable asynchronous job processing systems.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Experience implementing model observability or AI request tracing.
  • Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architecture and data isolation.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

jobs.description:
The Patient Journey Director CEERJ enables journey from first symptom to diagnosis, referral and appropriate care outcomes faster, clearer and fairer for people living with C3G/IC-MPGN and severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) across CEERJ.

The role is driven by a genuine passion for improving the patient journey. It identifies where patients are delayed, missed or lost, partners with country medical and commercial teams to understand why, and turns those barriers into practical, compliant and measurable initiatives. This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

The role operates in a fast-moving, changing environment. The holder works in an agile way: sets few clear priorities, adapts quickly as launches, access and evidence evolve, and turns insight into executive-ready plans that are communicated clearly to the Brand Teams, Leadership Teams and Core Medical Team.

Main responsibilities:

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

Partner with countries to map and clear barriers & opportunities. Work alongside country leaders and field teams to map country-specific barriers (awareness, testing access, laboratory and biopsy pathways, referral fragmentation, expert centre availability, non-pharmaceutical therapy optimization opportunities)

Build & resource executive plans. Develop concise, prioritized patient journey improvement projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and KPIs. Resource and adjust them rapidly as conditions change. Report progress to senior leadership in Core Medical Team, CEERJ LT and Brand Team forums.

Lead projects and matrix teams: drive relevant Patient Journey projects and allocated matrix teams from kick off to close out ensuring clear planning, budgeting, delivery and reporting on time and within budget

Lead integration of medical devices and enabling platforms. Lead integration of Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics and pipeline tools into patient journey frameworks across CEERJ. Ensure stakeholder value, country readiness and compliant use. Track adoption, escalate barriers and propose solutions.

Generate and act on patient journey insights. Interact with external community to enable systematic collection and synthesis of insights from HCPs, KOLs, diagnostic initiatives, patient organisations and country teams. Turn them into clear recommendations that change plans and decisions.

Mastery of the landscape. Keep current knowledge of C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG science, diagnostic pathways, competitive and customer landscape, Tier 1 KOLs and patient advocacy groups, and related areas such as PNH and haemophilia.

  • University degree such as M.D., Pharm. D., or PhD preferably with biological sciences background.
  • Academic, clinical or industry experience in therapeutic areas such as nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology or immunology
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in commercial field role or medical affairs at a local level from larger country, with recognized success internally and externally. Experience in Patient Access, Community Engagement or Diagnostics will be a plus
  • Strong business acumen and presentation / communication skills across all levels of organization within and outside country
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver results on time and within budget
  • Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point and other Microsoft Office programmes
  • Working knowledge of EFPIA regulations and compliance requirements with demonstration of highest ethical standards
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Highly motivated and self-driven with ability to think innovatively & strategically, skillfully plan, manage and prioritize multiple projects independently; demonstrates resilience and flexibility
  • Ability to work independently, while still maintaining a team and corporate approach to the function
  • Proactive, open minded, experienced leader, able to identify and carry out strategic initiatives with high patient impact in launches and life-cycle management
  • Strong business and scientific acumen, leadership skills, project management and scientific communication skills.

Additional requirement

  • Frequent regional and international travel is required, approximately 40% of working time.
  • Availability for external meetings, congresses and internal meetings outside standard hours with advance notice.
  • Valid driver's license may be required depending on local role set-up.
  • The role may be home-based or hybrid depending on country, local employment set-up and business requirements.
  • All activities must comply with applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, internal SOPs and Sobi policies.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day.

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of rare disease patients and our edge comes from our team of people.

Sobi offers the opportunity to work at an international pharmaceutical company focused on specialty pharmaceuticals meeting the high medical needs of rare disease patients and providing treatment and services to them. Our employees come from a variety of backgrounds within research, healthcare, industry and the academic sphere.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Norway

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Norway. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

jobs.title: Senior Windows Systems Engineer - Endpoint Deployment & PKI
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Senior Windows Systems Engineer makes sure our Windows software gets onto enterprise machines and stays there: signed, trusted, packaged, and deployable at scale.

You will own the path from a built binary to a running agent on thousands of managed devices. That covers kernel driver signing with Microsoft, Intune packaging and deployment, and the full lifecycle of every certificate the product depends on. When a certificate is about to expire, you knew about it 90 days ago. When an enterprise IT team asks how to deploy us, you hand them a package that just works.

This is a hands-on, detail-obsessed role. We are hiring someone who has been through Microsoft’s driver signing process, has packaged software for Intune in production, and treats certificate management as a discipline, not an afterthought.

Job Description:

  • Own kernel driver signing: You run the end-to-end signing process for our Windows kernel drivers, including EV code signing, Microsoft Partner Center attestation, and HLK/WHQL submissions where needed. You keep the pipeline compliant with Microsoft’s driver signing requirements as they change.
  • Package for the enterprise: You build and maintain MSI, MSIX, and Win32 (.intunewin) packages for Intune deployment. You define install and uninstall logic, detection rules, dependencies, silent installs, and upgrade paths that IT teams can roll out to thousands of devices without a single support ticket.
  • Manage the certificate lifecycle: You own every certificate the product relies on: code signing, driver signing, root and intermediate certificates for TLS inspection, and device and service certificates. You handle issuance, secure storage in HSMs or key vaults, distribution, rotation, renewal, and revocation, with zero surprise expiries.
  • Automate signing and release: You integrate signing and packaging into CI/CD so every release is signed, versioned, and reproducible. No manual steps on someone’s laptop and no private keys in places they should not be.
  • Enable customer deployments: You write the deployment guides, Intune configuration profiles, and certificate trust policies that customer IT teams follow. You join calls with their endpoint teams to troubleshoot rollouts when needed.
  • Own reliability in the field: You track deployment success rates, failed installs, and signing or trust errors across the install base, and you fix root causes, not symptoms.

Requirements

  • Seasoned Windows systems engineer: 5+ years of experience in Windows systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or build and release for Windows software. You know the Windows installer stack, services, the registry, and the certificate stores inside out.

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

The Security Operations Engineer is the operational backbone of the Security Operations Centre (SOC). It is a fully remote, hands-on, technical role that owns three tightly integrated domains: security alert design, triaging, and automated response; cloud security posture management across EKS and AWS environments; and posture tracking and reporting.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Product & Infrastructure Security, the engineer works alongside a mature Application Security team and collaborates closely with DevOps, Engineering, and Security GRC functions. The role sits within the First Line of Defense and is expected to progressively drive down manual effort through detection-as-code and SOAR automation.

This is not a perimeter-security or scan-and-report role. The right candidate must be comfortable writing detection logic, triaging cloud misconfigurations at the infrastructure level, and owning end-to-end vulnerability remediation cycles in containerised environments.

What You'll Do

1. Security Operations

The engineer owns the full lifecycle of security detection and response inside the SOC, from signal design through to automated containment. This is the primary domain of the role.

Alert design and coverage

  • Design and maintain SIEM detection rules covering cloud, container, identity, and application layers, using both signature-based and behavioural logic
  • Map detection coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework and identify gaps relevant to the organisation's AWS and EKS attack surface
  • Integrate threat intelligence feeds to refresh rule logic for emerging threats and TTPs
  • Maintain a detection backlog, prioritised by risk, with defined review cadences

Alert triage

  • Daily SIEM alert triage following defined response timing standard
  • Classify, investigate, and resolve security signals;
  • Reduce false-positive rates through structured tuning cycles, with documented rationale for rule changes
  • Maintain triage runbooks for key production detection rules

Automated response workflows (SOAR)

  • Build and maintain SOAR playbooks for common alert types including IAM anomalies, misconfiguration alerts, exposed secrets, and container runtime events
  • Automate enrichment steps (asset lookup, threat intel correlation, ownership resolution) to reduce analyst time-to-context
  • Document automation logic and maintain version control for all playbooks
  • Measure and report automation coverage rate as a standing KRI

2. Cloud Security Posture Management

Cloud posture management is the infrastructure-facing domain of the role, covering vulnerability management, identity governance, and configuration and change control. AWS EKS and Serverless resources are the primary environments.

Vulnerability management

  • Own the end-to-end vulnerability triage process for cloud and container environments, prioritising findings by business impact using CVSS scoring, asset criticality, and exploitability context
  • Manage EKS-specific vulnerability coverage: base image currency, workload scanning results, pod security standards compliance, and node group patching cadence
  • Coordinate remediation with engineering teams by opening well-scoped tickets, tracking progress, and escalating SLA breaches
  • Maintain MTTR and SLA compliance data by severity tier
  • Oversee CSPM posture score targets; triage new Critical findings within defined SLA windows

Identity and access governance

  • Review and approve IAM policy changes, enforcing least-privilege and flagging over-permissioned roles or service accounts
  • Execute scheduled IAM hygiene reviews: unused credentials, stale access keys, overly broad policies, and cross-account trust boundaries
  • Govern workload identity configurations in EKS, ensuring service accounts carry only the permissions required
  • Support the secrets rotation program and enforce zero hardcoded credentials across the estate

Configuration and change management

  • Review and approve cloud network security changes: security group modifications, network ACL changes, and routing updates
  • Own container image security: base image update cadence, scanning results review, and image ownership classification
  • Investigate and remediate misconfiguration alerts surfaced by CSPM tooling within defined SLA windows
  • Maintain a configuration baseline for critical cloud resources and flag drift

3. Posture Tracking and Reporting

The engineer is the primary data owner for security posture metrics across both SOC and cloud domains. Reporting outputs feed executive dashboards, GRC compliance evidence, and quarterly risk reviews.

KRI data collection

  • Collect and maintain Key Risk Indicator data across all three KRA domains on defined cadences
  • SOC KRIs: MTTA (Mean Time to Acknowledge), MTTR, false-positive rate, automation coverage rate, detection coverage score
  • VM KRIs: Critical/High finding counts, SLA compliance rate by severity, MTTR by tier, overdue remediation count
  • Posture KRIs: CSPM score, under-protected asset count, misconfiguration closure rate, IAM hygiene score, log source coverage

Recurring control reviews

  • Execute infrastructure security control checks on weekly (CSPM critical findings), monthly (IAM hygiene, secrets rotation status), and quarterly (posture benchmark, detection coverage review) cadences
  • Produce structured findings reports for each review cycle, flagging control failures for escalation

Reporting

  • Provide SOC and cloud posture metrics, including trends, at the required reporting cycles
  • Support external audit and due diligence processes by providing evidence artefacts

4. Others

  • Co-own the shared vulnerability backlog (infrastructure side) with the Application Security team, ensuring consistent prioritisation methodology across domains
  • Serve as the infrastructure and identity SME for the AppSec team during application security assessments and architecture reviews
  • Own infrastructure containment during incidents that span application and infrastructure layers, working alongside AppSec for root cause analysis
  • Provide infrastructure, identity, and network security review for new third-party integrations prior to deployment
  • Collaborate with the Security GRC function on control evidence and compliance mapping, particularly for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and across different time zones
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in security operations, cloud security, or infrastructure security engineering
  • Hands-on AWS security experience: IAM policy design, virtual network architecture, cloud-native security services, CloudTrail, GuardDuty
  • Kubernetes and EKS security experience: pod security standards, network policy enforcement, workload identity, image scanning
  • SIEM operations: alert triage, detection rule authoring (signature-based and behavioural), log analysis and correlation
  • Vulnerability management: CSPM tooling, risk-based prioritisation, CVSS scoring, SLA framework operation
  • IaC security: ability to read and review Terraform or CloudFormation for misconfigurations
  • Incident response: investigation, containment, and post-incident reporting
  • Experience in a regulated environment (FinTech, payments, banking, or crypto preferred)
  • Ability to author and tune detection rules without relying on vendor-supplied defaults
  • Structured written communication for triage reports, post-incident write-ups, and stakeholder metrics
  • Ability to coordinate remediation across engineering teams without direct authority
  • Comfort operating in a lean team where domain boundaries are broader than in large enterprise security functions
  • Professional certifications: AWS Security Specialty (highly valued)
  • Experience with CSPM and SIEM platforms: Datadog, Wiz, Orca Security
  • Experience with secrets management platforms: AWS Secrets Manager
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DORA
  • Scripting ability in Python or Bash for detection-as-code and operational automation
  • Experience with SOAR or workflow automation platforms
  • Understanding of cryptocurrency or blockchain security considerations
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
  • AI tooling familiarity and interest in applying AI to operational workflows

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Regulated, multi-geography environment with real-world impact on financial inclusion
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Ownership of the SOC and cloud security posture function from day one, in a high-growth FinTech environment
  • Broad domain exposure: detection engineering, cloud security, container security, incident response, and compliance
  • Collaborative team culture with a mature AppSec function and strong leadership support

Ready to Join Us?

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let's innovate, disrupt, and lead together!

jobs.title: Head of Incident Response
jobs.description:
“I am hugely excited about my future and the future of CyberOne. I have enjoyed my time here immensely and have learnt a huge amount in a short space of time, year-for-year I've learnt more here than I have at Microsoft and PwC.” - CyberOne Consultant

About CyberOne

CyberOne is a pure-play Microsoft security partner dedicated to helping enterprises realise the full value of the Microsoft Security portfolio—across Defender XDR, Sentinel, Entra, Purview, Intune, Copilot for Security and more. We combine deep technical expertise with outcome-driven services that accelerate secure cloud adoption, modernise threat protection and simplify compliance.

Job Title:Head of Incident Response

Location:Remote

Employment Type:Full time

Role purpose

The Head of Incident Response is accountable for the management, quality and continual improvement of CyberOne’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) Cyber Incident Response (CIR) Standard Level service.

The role ensures that Cyber Incident Response Leads have the direction, tools, processes and support needed to deliver effective retained customer onboarding, incident response engagements and preparedness activities.

Alongside service leadership, the Head of Incident Response retains an active operational capability, supporting concurrent engagements and contributing directly where incidents require additional leadership, technical expertise or response capacity.

Responsibilities

Service ownership and quality

  • Own the operational delivery of the NCSC CREST accredited CIR service, ensuring clear standards for customer onboarding, incident management, investigation, reporting and post-incident review.
  • Oversee CIR Lead performance during engagements, providing direction and support to ensure delivery meets agreed scope, service commitments and client expectations.
  • Ensure the team has appropriate tools, documentation, playbooks and processes to deliver the service effectively.
  • Oversee the quality assurance of investigation reports and client deliverables, ensuring conclusions are supported by evidence, limitations are clearly explained and recommendations are practical and prioritised.
  • Use engagement feedback, lessons learned and changes in the threat landscape to identify and implement service improvements.
  • Report service performance, capacity constraints, delivery risks and improvement priorities to the Operations Director.

Operational leadership and client engagement

  • Maintain oversight of active engagements, identifying incidents that require additional support, management intervention or escalation.
  • Participate directly in complex incidents and support concurrent engagements, providing incident leadership and technical assistance as required.
  • Support CIR Leads with difficult response decisions, executive communications and sensitive client situations.
  • Take ownership of IR client technical escalations and seek resolutions with the best interests of both parties.
  • Assist with scoping IR engagements, clarifying client needs, delivery requirements, dependencies and service limitations.
  • Meet newly signed clients with the assigned CIR lead to introduce the service, establish expectations and support an effective transition into onboarding.
  • Ensure retained customer onboarding is completed to an appropriate standard and that the team can identify and communicate gaps affecting response readiness.

People and resource management

  • Directly manage, support and develop the CIR Leads, promoting consistent delivery, effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Assess current and anticipated demand against team capacity, identifying gaps in coverage, capability and resilience.
  • Prepare business cases for additional hiring and support interviews and candidate assessment following approval.
  • Work with the SecOps Manager to coordinate additional SecOps support, ensuring resource allocation considers the continued delivery of the MXDR service.
  • Support the development of SecOps team members who contribute to incident response, agreeing training and participation with their management.
  • Monitor workload and support effective cover and handovers during prolonged or concurrent engagements.

Essential professional requirements

  • Demonstrable experience leading significant cyber security incidents, including complex investigations, multidisciplinary response teams and senior stakeholder communications.
  • Experience managing or overseeing a client-facing incident response capability, with responsibility for delivery quality and service improvement.
  • Ability to communicate confidently with executive and board-level stakeholders, translating technical findings into business impact, response options and decisions.
  • Strong client management skills, including resolving escalations and maintaining constructive relationships during disruptive or sensitive incidents.
  • Ability to lead and develop experienced responders while providing appropriate challenge, support and direction.
  • Strong judgement when prioritising competing engagements and balancing incident response requirements against wider operational commitments.
  • Experience assessing resource requirements and presenting clear, evidence-based business cases to senior management.
  • Excellent written communication and quality assurance skills, including reviewing incident reports, executive summaries and remediation recommendations.
  • Professional discretion and sound judgement when handling sensitive information, investigation evidence and uncertain findings.

Essential technical requirements

  • Strong practical experience responding to incidents such as ransomware, business email compromise, identity compromise, malware infections and suspected data exfiltration.
  • Ability to contribute directly to investigations and response activities, alongside providing technical oversight and incident leadership.
  • Ability to assess and challenge investigative findings, identify evidence gaps and direct analysis to establish incident scope, attack progression and business impact.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise environments, including Windows, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, cloud services and common network technologies.
  • Experience using SIEM, EDR and identity telemetry to investigate and correlate activity across endpoints, accounts and cloud services.
  • Understanding of attacker techniques involving credential theft, session compromise, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement and command-and-control communications.
  • Ability to assess containment, eradication and recovery options, considering business dependencies, operational consequences, evidence preservation and client approval requirements.
  • Understanding of secure evidence handling and chain-of-custody principles, including recognising when specialist forensic support is required.
  • Ability to assess how telemetry coverage, retention and licensing limitations affect response readiness, investigative confidence and conclusions.
  • Practical understanding of incident response guidance and threat frameworks, particularly NIST SP 800-61 and MITRE ATT&CK.

Desirable experience and qualifications

  • Experience managing incident response delivery within a consultancy or managed security service provider.
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR and KQL, alongside familiarity with other enterprise security platforms.
  • Experience developing incident response services, delivery processes, playbooks and quality standards.
  • Experience delivering preparedness workshops, tabletop exercises and incident response plan reviews.
  • Experience coordinating with legal advisers, cyber insurers, specialist forensic providers and crisis communications teams.
  • Awareness of data protection and regulatory considerations, including recognising when clients require specialist legal or privacy advice.
  • Relevant qualifications such as GCIH, GCFA, CISSP or CISM. Equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
  • ITIL 4 knowledge or certification, particularly in relation to incident, problem and change management.

Accountability and authority

The Head of Incident Response owns the operational management, delivery standards and continual improvement of the IR service. CIR Leads remain responsible for leading their assigned engagements, supported by the Head where additional oversight or operational assistance is required.
