About TCP Software

For more than 30 years, TCP has helped organizations engage their people by providing flexible, mobile timekeeping and workforce management solutions. Trusted by tens of thousands of customers and millions of users, TCP delivers best-in-class technology and personalized support to organizations of all sizes in the public and private sectors to meet their complex timekeeping, employee scheduling, leave management, and other workforce needs. Growth is happening, and our vision for a successful future is clear — we'd love for you to join us on this journey!

For more information on TCP Software, visit www.tcpsoftware.com or follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook.

About the Role

The Senior Product Marketing Manager for Humanity Schedule will serve as the strategic marketing lead for TCP’s dynamic employee scheduling solution. You will develop a deep understanding of our customers, buyers, market, and competitive landscape and translate those insights into clear positioning, differentiated messaging, effective go-to-market strategies, and compelling sales enablement.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. You will influence product strategy, lead major launches, strengthen our market position, and help our commercial teams communicate the business value of Humanity Schedule. The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, comfortable shaping the narrative, creating the tools, and driving the execution required to accelerate pipeline, win competitive opportunities, and increase customer adoption.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager for our Humanity Schedule product, you'll be responsible for:

  • Market Intelligence – Become an expert on our buyers, who they are, and how they buy our software. You’ll build an understanding of the buyer journey and its relationship to our sales process to help the company make intelligent, market/buyer-centric decisions.
  • Product Messaging – Work together with product management to construct messages that clearly articulate the value our Humanity Schedule provides, the challenges it solves, and why customers should deploy our solution now.
  • Content Creation – Work collaboratively with our content team to develop content for sales and partner enablement, partner engagements, and external marketing/demand generation campaigns and communications.
  • GTM Strategy – Assist in executing our GTM strategy, including identification of target market/customer, buyer persona interviews, core use cases, and the customer journey.
  • Sales and Partner Enablement - Establish competitive battlecards and work closely with Sales and Partner Enablement to conduct trainings that ensure internal and extended sales forces are fully educated on product features and new releases. Help conduct win/loss analysis on a quarterly basis.
  • Product Packaging – Work across multiple departments, including marketing, finance, operations, product management, and sales to define product structure, including naming, packaging, licensing, and pricing to simplify the sales/acquisition process and encourage customer adoption.
  • Product Launch & Excitement - Own and coordinate product launches to maximize awareness. Drive product excitement into key segments to maximize adoption and usage.
  • Campaign Planning & Execution – Work with senior marketing leaders to craft program plans and define inbound and outbound marketing channels. Work with Demand Gen to define and build email nurture/drip programs and relevant target segments across owned and paid media.
  • Measurement and Analytics – Work with marketing operations, product marketing, and marketing leadership to define campaign targets and build reports and dashboards to report on program performance and ROI.
  • Competitive Intelligence - Study and monitor the key players in our industry (i.e., potential alternatives to our product), help define how we are different, and why our differentiators are important to our target audience.
  • Spokesperson – Serve as a primary company spokesperson and advocate for Humanity Schedule while engaging with analysts, press, customers, and investors.

How You’ll be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Strengthen market positioning – Establish clear, differentiated positioning and messaging across priority markets, industries, and buyer personas.
  • Deliver effective launches – Lead coordinated launches that drive awareness, sales readiness, pipeline, and customer adoption.
  • Improve commercial performance – Equip Sales and partners with the training, competitive intelligence, and content needed to improve buyer engagement and win rates.
  • Generate actionable insight – Build a strong understanding of buyer needs, market trends, the customer journey, and competitive dynamics.
  • Influence strategy – Translate market insights into recommendations for product priorities, packaging, pricing, segmentation, and go-to-market.
  • Drive measurable impact – Demonstrate contribution to pipeline, revenue, adoption, and retention.
  • Build cross-functional alignment – Create clarity, accountability, and momentum across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (preferred)
  • 5-7 years of experience in product marketing; preferably at least 1-2 years in a senior position
  • An understanding of and experience in the B2B/SaaS technology – previous experience with time-tracking, scheduling, or workforce management solutions is a bonus but not a requirement
  • Familiarity with frontline employee scheduling in the healthcare, retail & hospitality, construction, and/or manufacturing industries is preferred, but not required
  • Ability to write about technology clearly with the ability to distill complex business and technology concepts into easily understood value statements.
  • Adaptive personality, highly organized and self-motivated, takes ownership and delivering results in a fast-paced environment - should be comfortable with high ambiguity.
  • Ability to understand technology at its core functions and articulate the benefits of the technology at a business level.
  • Demonstrated success in analyzing market opportunities, defining market requirements, and managing go-to-market for software and service products in a B2B environment.
  • Quantitative, creative, and exceptional communications skills

Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap, built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

Microsoft 365 is where work happens. It keeps getting bigger, busier and harder to keep under control. ShareGate helps more than 100,000 IT pros move, understand and govern their Microsoft 365 environments with confidence. AI now lets us build faster than ever, so the real question is whether we're building the right things. We're looking for a Software Development Manager to bridge the two: someone who moves fast with every tool available and keeps the team focused on what makes a difference for customers.

Your impact:

  • Drive customer value by making sure what the team ships improves the customer experience, and challenge work that doesn't.
  • Use AI to build faster, raise the quality of what we deliver and simplify maintenance, while keeping every squad focused on the right priorities.
  • Build squads that fully own their part of the product, from design to production.
  • Keep the roadmap ahead of the team by working with Product and Design, so delivery speed turns into customer value.
  • Raise the bar on engineering practices and on the people behind them, from coaching to hiring developers who make the team stronger.

Your team

AI is changing how we build software. Our developers already use agents to design, build, test and maintain the product, and we ship faster than ever. The next challenge isn't going faster. It's making sure that speed turns into more value for customers: better experiences, sharper insights and problems solved before they become problems. Under the hood, a data ingestion platform continuously reads Microsoft 365 environments so customers always see what's really going on.

You'll lead 12 developers organized in 3 squads, each owning its part of the product. We work closely with Product and Design, decide fast and fix course even faster. We're remote-first, with access to our Montreal office.

What you'll bring

  • Experience managing a software team of 5+ developers, from hiring to coaching, with the managerial courage to have the hard performance conversations, give direct feedback and keep standards high so the people around you grow;
  • A strong product mindset: you start from the customer problem and you're comfortable saying no to work that doesn't solve it;
  • Solid knowledge of modern software development practices and architecture, enough to challenge technical decisions;
  • A track record of improving how a team works with AI and automation, and measuring the impact;
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with making fast, reversible decisions.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $155 000 to $185 000.This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale.Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

Job summary

The Event Operations Specialist - Registration is our Cvent specialist for external events and campaigns. You own the Cvent registration experience from start to finish: building registration sites, managing invitations and attendee data, supporting check-in at live events when necessary, setting up registration for events run by other team members, and making sure every, campaign, registration, and attendance record flows cleanly (and accurately) into Salesforce. You also manage your own portfolio of virtual events, and you act as the department’s project manager, keeping work organized and helping streamline how the team operates. You work closely with the email marketing team, the content team (copywriters, designers, and others), local offices, and event specialists to make registering for a Mercer Advisors event convenient, polished, and on brand.

Essential job functions

Cvent registration site build and administration

  • Build and launch Cvent registration websites, forms, and confirmation pages for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, using reusable templates that reflect Mercer Advisors branding.
  • Partner with the content team (copywriters, designers, and others) on registration site copy, imagery, branding, and request, review, and approve assets so every site is polished and on brand.
  • Partner with the email marketing team to align registration sites with invitation, reminder, and follow-up emails, coordinating timing, messaging, links, and registration tracking before each send.
  • Configure Cvent registration paths with conditional logic, multiple attendee types (such as clients, prospects, guests, and team members), capacity limits, waitlists, and approval workflows.
  • Test every Cvent registration site end to end before launch, proofing content, logic, confirmation emails, and reporting for accuracy.
  • Serve as the Cvent power user for local events, maintaining account standards, templates, user access, and data integrity, and documenting the build process so others can follow it.
  • Confirm registration pages and communications meet accessibility, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Attendee management and communications

  • Manage the attendee experience from invitation through post-event follow-up, using Cvent for invite sends, RSVP tracking, confirmations, reminders, and waitlist management.
  • Establish and maintain invitation lists in partnership with local offices and the email marketing team, and provide registration data and segments that support targeted sends.
  • Serve as the point of contact for registration questions, and resolve attendee issues quickly and courteously.
  • Administer post-event surveys in Cvent, monitor results, and share feedback with the event team to improve future events.

Virtual event portfolio

  • Own a portfolio of virtual events from planning through post-event follow-up, including timelines, run of show, speaker and presenter coordination, and attendee communications.
  • Build and manage the registration and virtual event setup in Cvent or a comparable virtual event platform, and run technical rehearsals and day-of support.
  • Track attendance and engagement, send post-event surveys and follow-ups, and report results and leads to local offices and marketing leadership.
  • Set up registration for events managed by other team members, balancing your own virtual event schedule with those requests.

Data, reporting, and Salesforce

  • Create and manage Salesforce campaigns for each local event, and keep Cvent registration and attendance data aligned with Salesforce.
  • Reconcile registration, check-in, and no-show data across sources so attendance is accurate and ROI can be tracked.
  • Build Cvent reports on registration pace, attendance, and results for local offices and marketing leadership.
  • Make sure all leads from an event are systematically documented and tracked.

Department project management and process improvement

  • Act as the department project manager, tracking event timelines, deliverables, task ownership, and approvals so every project stays visible and on schedule.
  • Manage intake of event and registration requests from local offices and the marketing team, and prioritize work against deadlines and capacity.
  • Identify ways to streamline department processes, then document and implement improved workflows, registration standards, and reusable templates and best practices.
  • Keep department documentation, checklists, and training materials current so team members can follow consistent processes.
  • Build strong working relationships with the email marketing team, content team, local offices, and event specialists, sharing clear timelines, event briefs, and deadlines.
  • Support broader event logistics as capacity allows, including vendor coordination, budget tracking, and collateral.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Minimum two years of hands-on Cvent experience, including building complete registration websites, configuring conditional logic and attendee types, managing invitations and attendee data, and running Cvent reports.
  • Minimum three years of experience in event registration, event technology, or event planning.
  • Experience managing virtual events from planning through execution, and managing multiple projects at once.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM system.
  • Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and mail merges.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and proofreading skills.
  • Clear, friendly written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with email marketing, copywriters, designers, local offices, and vendors.
  • Ability to manage multiple events and deadlines, and to make sound judgment calls in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to support events in multiple markets from a remote position.

  • Working knowledge of HTML or CSS.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Product Manager


About Computrition


Computrition, Inc. is a leading provider of enterprise foodservice, nutrition management, and retail technology, trusted by hundreds of organizations across North America, including healthcare systems, military installations, correctional facilities, and higher education institutions. For more than 44 years, we’ve built technology in partnership with our customers, helping them improve operational efficiency, strengthen financial performance, and deliver better nutritional care.


We’re investing in the future of our platform by adopting modern technologies and working closely with customers to solve complex operational challenges. Our solutions have real-world impact by driving performance enhancement and show up directly in how hospitals, military installations, and other institutions operate every day.


Computrition offers the stability of an established industry leader and the momentum of a company accelerating growth through innovation. We invest in our people and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and professional growth where employees can make a meaningful impact. You’ll join experienced professionals who are passionate about solving meaningful problems and delivering measurable outcomes for customers.


With team members across the U.S. and Canada, and as part of a growing portfolio of technology companies owned by Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU.TO), we are well-positioned to continue advancing the future of foodservice and nutrition technology.


If you’re looking to build technology that makes a meaningful impact while growing your career with a stable, innovative company, we’d like to hear from you.


About the Role


Computrition is seeking a Product Manager who combines product management expertise with strong commercial and strategic acumen. You will be primarily focused on Computrition’s next-generation, cloud-native food and nutrition management platform while also supporting our established customer base through ongoing enhancements and strategic product initiatives as business needs require.


As the Product Manager, you will report to the Director of Product and work closely with the EVP of Product. You will help shape product strategy and turn it into results. You take healthcare customer and prospect needs, competitive insight, and financial analysis and build them into differentiated products, strong business cases, and measurable growth.

You will work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Design, and Engineering through the full product lifecycle: discovery, roadmap planning, delivery, launch, and adoption. You support ensuring product outcomes. That means supporting development of clear goals and success measures, making evidence-based prioritized trade-offs, and balancing customer value, usability, feasibility, and commercial return.

  • Directionally, you’ll split your time between:
    ~40% Discovery & Delivery: Customer conversations, requirements, backlog management, collaboration with Design & Engineering
  • ~30% Strategy & Business Cases: Market and competitive analysis, financial models, roadmap and executive materials
  • ~30% Commercialization: Positioning, pricing, packaging, launches & sales enablement

Of course, the time allocated to this and other responsibilities will be determined by business needs and priorities and may change from time to time.


Key Responsibilities


  • Strategy support: Partner with the Director of Product with product vision, strategy, and portfolio priorities. Prepare analysis, recommendations, and executive-ready materials for leadership reviews and investment decisions.
  • Market and customer insight: Talk with customers and prospects to confirm unmet needs, workflows, buying criteria, and willingness to pay. Analyze competitors and win/loss results to find where Computrition can stand apart and grow.
  • Roadmap and prioritization: Evaluate market opportunities and rank investments by validating demand, strategic fit, customer value, financial impact, and feasibility. Keep the roadmap current and clearly communicated.
  • Business cases: Build advanced Excel financial models covering revenue, pricing, costs, margin, ROI, and payback. Use scenario and sensitivity analysis to recommend investments and explain trade-offs.
  • Commercialization: Lead or contribute to positioning, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market plans. Support launches and give Sales clear value propositions, competitive guidance, demo narratives, and customer ROI tools.
  • Product delivery: Turn market needs into clear requirements, user stories, and prioritized backlog. Work with Design and Engineering in an Agile environment to deliver and validate customer value.
  • Performance Track adoption, retention, revenue, win rates, and profitability, and use the results to adjust strategy and the roadmap.
  • AI: Use AI responsibly to speed up research and product work. Evaluate AI-enabled product opportunities with attention to accuracy, privacy, and security.

Qualifications


Required

  • 4+ years in product management, management consulting, or strategy experience, with a record of SaaS product and commercial impact
  • Healthcare industry experience, including knowledge of clinical or operational workflows, purchasing processes, and privacy and regulatory requirements such as HIPAA
  • Strong strategic thinking and skill in market and competitive analysis
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling, including business cases, forecasts, ROI analyses, and scenario models
  • Excellent written communication and executive presentation skills, plus the ability to influence across teams without direct authority
  • Familiarity with Pragmatic Institute (formerly Pragmatic Marketing) or similar frameworks, , and product planning tools such as Jira, Aha!, and ClickUp
  • Bachelor's degree in any field; Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, and Healthcare Administration are all relevant

Preferred

  • Management consulting background (for example PwC, Deloitte, Accenture, or a comparable firm)
  • MBA or a related graduate degree
  • Experience with healthcare software, foodservice technology, clinical nutrition, or diet office operations
  • Experience moving customers from a legacy platform to SaaS or cloud
  • Experience working in an AI-driven development lifecycle, where requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria are written so that both people and AI tools can act on them, and comfort adapting your practices as those methods evolve

What Success Looks like


First 90 Days

Develop a deep understanding of our customers, market dynamics, food and nutrition workflows, and platform capabilities. Build strong working relationships across Sales, Customer Success, Design, Engineering, Operations, and your Product Management colleagues. Conduct customer discovery interviews, market research, competitive analysis, and conversations with advisory board members to identify unmet needs, market trends, and growth opportunities. Become the owner of a defined product area, including its roadmap, backlog, key performance metrics, and strategic priorities. Begin evaluating potential product investments through preliminary business cases and commercial assessments.


First 6 Months

Deliver a prioritized product roadmap for your area, grounded in validated customer demand, market research, competitive insights, and business objectives. Develop and present at least one comprehensive business case, including market opportunity analysis, financial modeling, ROI projections, strategic rationale, and implementation recommendations. Partner with cross-functional teams to successfully launch a feature or product enhancement with clearly defined success metrics, adoption targets, and go-to-market support materials for Sales and Customer Success. Establish a regular cadence for gathering market intelligence and customer feedback to continuously inform product strategy and investment decisions.


Work Environment


This is a full-time remote position with about 25% travel for customer visits, team onsite meetings, conferences, and other work-related needs. We offer a flexible schedule, growth opportunities, comprehensive benefits, and pay based on experience.

Computrition

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

The Network Engineer is a core member of the Network Operations team responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing HealthEdge’s enterprise network infrastructure across on-premises data centers, cloud environments, and remote access platforms. This role operates within a team-driven model emphasizing 24/7 availability, ITIL-aligned processes, automation, and measurable operational outcomes in support of our healthcare SaaS platform.

Essential Responsibilities:

Technical Execution & Operations

  • Design, configure, and maintain LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, firewall, and load-balancing infrastructure across multi-site and multi-cloud environments
  • Monitor network performance (SolarWinds, Datadog, ThousandEyes) and proactively resolve issues before they impact service delivery and SLA targets
  • Implement network security controls including firewall rule sets, IDS/IPS, segmentation, NAC, and zero-trust architecture principles
  • Design and manage AWS network infrastructure — VPCs, subnets, route tables, IGW, NAT Gateways, and ELBs — for scalable, highly available architectures
  • Configure AWS Transit Gateway and VPC peering for secure, low-latency connectivity across accounts, regions, and on-premises environments
  • Implement AWS Direct Connect and Site-to-Site VPN for hybrid connectivity between HealthEdge data centers and AWS
  • Administer AWS Route 53 including private hosted zones, resolver rules, and health-check-based routing policies
  • Manage AWS Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and AWS Shield for least-privilege access and DDoS protection
  • Leverage AWS CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, and AWS Network Manager for observability, traffic analysis, and anomaly detection
  • Support Azure or GCP networking as required — VNets/VPCs, peering, and hybrid connectivity

Incident Response & Change Management

  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation, triaging and resolving network incidents per SLA targets; contribute to post-incident reviews to drive MTTR reduction
  • Execute network changes through established change management processes; serve as Tier 3 escalation resource for complex issues

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop automation scripts and IaC (Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python) to improve monitoring, alerting, and network deployment workflows
  • Build and maintain IaC for AWS network resources enabling repeatable, auditable deployments; surface optimization opportunities across the team’s roadmap

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain topology diagrams, runbooks, IPAM, and change records; support DR testing, vendor coordination, and legacy environment consolidation
  • Collaborate across Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Application teams; mentor junior team members

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Network Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering or network operations experience
  • Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP)
  • Experience with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD)
  • Demonstrated AWS networking expertise: VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall
  • Proficiency with network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Datadog, PRTG, or similar)
  • Experience with SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, or equivalent)
  • Solid understanding of DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SSL/TLS, and PKI
  • Hands-on experience with IaC and automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python)
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management processes
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE, NSE, or AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
  • Experience in healthcare SaaS or regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2)
  • Experience with large-scale infrastructure integrations or M&A network consolidation
  • Familiarity with HealthEdge products (HealthRules® Payer, HealthEdge Source™, GuidingCare®, Wellframe™)
  • Network automation experience at scale in a 24/7 operations environment

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Experiments & Integration (Mid/Senior/Principal)
jobs.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip-to-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

As a Systems Engineer on our Experiments & Integration team, you will be the engineer who answers the urgent questions. Hardware, software, and customer teams bring the simulation team a steady stream of unplanned requests: run this model on the emulator, measure that bottleneck, help this team integrate. You will work across all of those teams, on both simulation and hardware emulation, to turn each request into a fast, measured answer.

The work is varied and hands-on: standing up a new model on the emulator, profiling where time goes, or trying a configuration a stakeholder wants to see. You will own this queue so the engineers building the roadmap can stay focused on it, and you will leave each investigation behind as a reusable model, test, or script.

Key Responsibilities

Rapid Response and Experiments

  • Serve as the first responder for simulation and emulation requests from hardware, software, and customer teams, partnering with the existing experiments and integration engineers so urgent asks get answered while roadmap work stays protected.
  • Run quick experiments and demos, such as getting a new LLM running on the emulator, profiling where time goes, or trying a configuration a stakeholder wants to see.

Performance Measurement

  • Measure and explain performance using counters, traces, and end-to-end timing, reported along with their limits and their drivers.

Integration and Reusable Assets

  • Help other teams build on the simulators and the emulation setup when they need integration support.
  • Convert each investigation into a reusable asset, such as a calibrated model, a repeatable experiment, or a regression test.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience as a hands-on systems or performance engineer.
  • Demonstrated experience running LLM inference workloads end to end and finding where time goes, including weight loading, memory bandwidth, and host-device synchronization.
  • A strong understanding of performance measurement, including counters, execution traces, profiling, and reporting results with their limits.
  • Hands-on experience with host-side driver and runtime code, and comfort working close to hardware.
  • Ability to move fast on loosely specified requests, make assumptions explicit, and finish by making the result repeatable.
  • Strong Rust skills, or expert-level C/C++ skills and a willingness to work in Rust day to day, along with proficiency in Python and fluency with Linux, shell scripting, containers, and CI.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to give stakeholders a direct answer, what it rests on, and what to do next.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hardware emulators such as Cadence Palladium or Synopsys ZeBu, or with FPGA boards.
  • A track record of bringing up new workloads on early or unstable hardware.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • You will see the whole stack, from emulated silicon to customer models, and be the person teams across the company rely on for fast, trustworthy answers.
  • Every investigation you run becomes lasting infrastructure that makes the next answer faster for everyone.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is Mid: $160,000-$220,000, Senior: $220,000–$270,000, Principal: $270,000-$350,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Patient Care Operations Associate
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, reliable operations are an important part of delivering a consistent software experience. We value people who stay organized, take initiative, communicate clearly, and pay attention to the details that keep complex workflows moving. We believe strong operational coordination helps teams work more effectively and makes it easier to identify and resolve problems before they grow.

About the Role

We're looking for a Patient Care Operations Associate to support the administrative and operational processes connected to patient-facing workflows within Bask Health's telehealth platform.

This role focuses on non-clinical coordination, workflow monitoring, accurate documentation, and making sure operational issues reach the appropriate teams.

You'll help maintain organized processes that support patient-facing experiences without performing clinical work or making healthcare decisions.

You'll work with internal teams and authorized partners to help ensure assigned operational requests are tracked, documented, and appropriately resolved.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and online merchants to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a working understanding of the platform's operational workflows and how different teams interact with them.

You'll help monitor assigned administrative queues and identify requests that require follow-up.

You'll track non-clinical operational tasks from initial identification through completion or appropriate handoff.

You'll maintain accurate records of request status, ownership, and outstanding actions.

You'll identify situations where an assigned workflow appears incomplete, delayed, or blocked.

You'll follow established procedures to determine whether an issue can be resolved administratively or requires escalation.

You'll coordinate with the appropriate internal team when additional information or action is needed.

You'll help ensure operational requests are not overlooked or left without clear ownership.

You'll maintain organized documentation that allows other team members to understand the status of an issue.

You'll support administrative coordination between approved customer support, technical, clinical operations, and pharmacy-related contacts.

You'll recognize that different organizations and authorized professionals may own different parts of a patient's experience.

You'll follow established responsibility boundaries rather than assuming Bask Health controls every step.

You'll help track operational exceptions that affect supported platform workflows.

You'll document the relevant facts, affected workflow, current status, and responsible team.

You'll communicate operational concerns to the appropriate stakeholders using approved channels.

You'll follow up on unresolved administrative requests according to established procedures.

You'll help identify recurring delays, incomplete handoffs, and unclear operational responsibilities.

You'll recommend practical improvements to reduce unnecessary back-and-forth between teams.

You'll assist with organizing internal procedures, task lists, and workflow documentation.

You'll help maintain accurate internal knowledge resources for recurring operational situations.

You'll support routine administrative reviews of assigned workflows.

You'll help identify missing information or incomplete documentation when authorized to do so.

You'll request clarification through approved channels when information is insufficient.

You'll avoid interpreting clinical information or determining whether a patient qualifies for treatment.

You'll never approve or deny clinical services, prescribe medication, or make treatment recommendations.

You'll recognize when a request requires review by a licensed healthcare professional.

You'll refer those matters to the appropriate authorized clinical team.

You'll recognize when a request concerns medication preparation, dispensing, prescription fulfillment, or pharmacy-specific decisions.

You'll route those matters to the appropriate pharmacy or authorized contact.

You'll avoid making promises about treatment approval, prescription availability, or medication fulfillment outcomes.

You'll follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll access only the information necessary and authorized for your assigned responsibilities.

You'll use approved systems when documenting or communicating information related to patient-facing workflows.

You'll follow established identity verification and access control procedures when applicable.

You'll recognize and report suspected privacy or security concerns.

You'll collaborate with customer support teams to identify administrative issues affecting patient-facing experiences.

You'll coordinate with merchant success teams when an operational problem involves merchant-controlled settings or workflows.

You'll provide clear descriptions of operational problems so technical teams can investigate efficiently.

You'll help track technical escalations and maintain appropriate follow-up records.

You'll communicate approved status updates to relevant internal stakeholders.

You'll help identify patterns in recurring operational problems.

You'll contribute to reports or summaries showing outstanding requests, common issues, and workflow delays.

You'll help maintain accurate operational trackers and internal task management systems.

You'll use spreadsheets, ticketing platforms, or other approved tools to organize assigned work.

You'll support improvements to task categorization, ownership, and escalation procedures.

You'll help establish consistent documentation standards for recurring operational activities.

You'll participate in team discussions about process improvements and operational challenges.

You'll assist with reviewing existing procedures to identify unnecessary steps or confusing handoffs.

You'll contribute to clearer instructions and better internal coordination.

You'll support training and knowledge sharing when procedures are updated.

You'll learn new platform workflows and operational tools as responsibilities evolve.

You'll manage multiple assigned tasks while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

You'll prioritize work according to established procedures and approved urgency guidelines.

You'll communicate proactively when a task is blocked or additional assistance is required.

You'll avoid guessing when a situation involves unclear responsibilities or sensitive information.

You'll ask the appropriate team for guidance when a request falls outside your authority.

You'll maintain a professional and organized approach to daily operational work.

You'll take responsibility for completing assigned tasks and documenting the outcome.

jobs.title: Content Designer
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Content Designer to help create clear, intuitive, and consistent content across Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

As a Content Designer, you'll help shape how people understand and interact with these experiences through thoughtful interface language, clear instructions, and well-structured information.

This is a hands-on product content role that combines UX writing, content design, information architecture, and collaboration with product and engineering teams. You'll work throughout the product development process, from understanding user needs and defining content requirements to writing, testing, and improving content in production.

Your work will span different areas of the platform, including merchant dashboards, patient onboarding, questionnaires, account settings, checkout, and operational workflows. You'll help ensure that users understand what actions they can take, what information they need to provide, and what happens next.

You'll write and improve interface copy such as navigation labels, buttons, form instructions, helper text, error messages, confirmation screens, empty states, and system notifications.

You'll also help organize information so complex product experiences are easier to navigate. This includes reviewing user journeys, identifying confusing terminology, and collaborating with designers to improve how content is presented within interfaces.

You'll work closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, researchers, and operational stakeholders to ensure content reflects actual product functionality and supports user needs.

As Bask continues expanding its platform, you'll contribute to reusable content patterns, terminology standards, and writing guidelines that help maintain consistency across different applications and merchant experiences.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to approach sensitive information carefully. You'll collaborate with appropriate subject matter experts when content involves clinical, pharmacy, or regulated workflows, ensuring that language reflects approved processes and does not create misleading expectations.

You'll use usability research, product feedback, and available performance data to identify content problems and make improvements over time.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving communication problems through product design, can simplify complicated information, and understands how thoughtful content helps people use software successfully.

What You'll Do

  • Create clear, concise, and user-friendly content across Bask Health's digital products.
  • Write interface copy for merchant-facing, patient-facing, and internal platform experiences.
  • Develop navigation labels, buttons, form instructions, helper text, and confirmation messages.
  • Improve error messages and recovery instructions so users understand how to resolve problems.
  • Design content for onboarding and account setup experiences.
  • Create clear instructions for multi-step workflows and configuration processes.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve the usability of complex interfaces.
  • Work with product managers to understand product requirements and user needs.
  • Develop content for dashboards, settings pages, and administrative tools.
  • Improve content within questionnaires and form-based experiences.
  • Create clear empty states, loading messages, and system notifications.
  • Help users understand product features, available actions, and next steps.
  • Review existing interfaces to identify confusing or inconsistent terminology.
  • Develop reusable content patterns for common product interactions.
  • Contribute to Bask Health's content guidelines and design system.
  • Maintain consistent terminology across different areas of the platform.
  • Support information architecture improvements and content organization.
  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure content is implemented correctly.
  • Participate in product discovery and design discussions.
  • Review prototypes and provide content recommendations early in development.
  • Work with UX researchers to evaluate content comprehension and usability.
  • Use user feedback and research findings to improve interface language.
  • Apply accessibility and plain-language principles to product content.
  • Support content consistency across configurable merchant experiences.
  • Collaborate with clinical and pharmacy stakeholders when specialized terminology requires review.
  • Document content decisions, terminology guidelines, and reusable writing patterns.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide feedback on content quality.
  • Own assigned content design projects from initial requirements through implementation and iteration.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in content design, UX writing, product content strategy, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating content design for digital products.
  • Strong writing, editing, and information organization skills.
  • Understanding of user-centered content design principles.
  • Experience writing interface content for web or mobile applications.
  • Ability to simplify complex information into clear, actionable language.
  • Experience creating labels, instructions, helper text, error messages, and confirmation copy.
  • Understanding of information architecture and content hierarchy.
  • Familiarity with plain-language writing principles.
  • Experience collaborating with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers during product implementation.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative design tools.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive content practices.
  • Experience working with design systems or content guidelines.
  • Ability to maintain consistent terminology across multiple product experiences.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and user research methods.
  • Ability to incorporate user feedback into content improvements.
  • Experience reviewing existing interfaces and identifying content usability problems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to explain content decisions and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams.
  • Ability to balance user needs, product requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage assigned content design projects.
  • Interest in improving how people understand and interact with software.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing content for SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with B2B software and merchant-facing applications.
  • Experience writing for e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience writing content for onboarding and multi-step questionnaires.
  • Familiarity with subscription management or checkout workflows.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy and accessibility considerations.
  • Experience contributing to content design systems or terminology libraries.
  • Familiarity with white-label or multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Experience writing for configurable workflows and administrative tools.
  • Understanding of localization and internationalization considerations.
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility guidelines.
  • Experience collaborating with UX researchers on comprehension testing.
  • Experience using product analytics to evaluate content effectiveness.
  • Familiarity with content management systems or structured content models.
  • Experience developing voice and tone guidelines for digital products.
  • Experience designing content for AI-powered interfaces or assistants.
  • Understanding of responsible AI communication and clear user expectations.
  • Familiarity with React or modern frontend development concepts.
  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Clinical & Pharmacy Platform
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Clinical & Pharmacy Platform to lead product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for the clinical and pharmacy capabilities within Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll help customers understand how Bask Health supports the operational workflows required to run a telehealth business.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, pharmacy operations teams, customer success, sales, and company leadership to communicate complex platform capabilities in a way that is clear, accurate, and commercially relevant.

This role requires someone who can understand technical product functionality, ask detailed questions, and explain how software supports real operational processes.

You'll develop positioning and messaging for capabilities related to patient intake, clinical workflows, electronic medical records, provider review processes, pharmacy integrations, prescription routing, fulfillment visibility, and related platform functionality.

You'll help prospective customers understand how these capabilities work together within Bask Health's broader telehealth infrastructure.

You'll also support the positioning of new features and improvements across clinical and pharmacy workflows.

A major part of this role will involve translating operational complexity into understandable product benefits without oversimplifying important technical or healthcare-related details.

You'll conduct customer and market research to understand how healthcare businesses evaluate software infrastructure, which operational challenges influence purchasing decisions, and what customers need to know before adopting a platform.

You'll collaborate with internal subject matter experts to validate technical explanations and ensure product messaging accurately reflects supported functionality.

You'll partner with product teams to understand upcoming releases, identify the audiences they serve, and develop launch strategies.

You'll create messaging frameworks, product overviews, launch materials, sales enablement resources, and educational content that help customers understand the platform.

You'll also support customer success teams by developing materials that explain new capabilities and encourage successful product adoption.

Because this role operates in healthcare-related environments, accuracy is especially important. You'll need to distinguish software functionality from clinical decision-making and ensure relevant claims receive appropriate internal review.

You'll help build a consistent narrative around how Bask Health connects patient-facing experiences with the operational systems that support clinical and pharmacy workflows.

You'll also research relevant competitors and market alternatives to identify opportunities for stronger differentiation.

You'll evaluate product marketing effectiveness through launch outcomes, customer feedback, adoption trends, and the usefulness of enablement materials.

We're looking for someone who combines strong product marketing judgment with curiosity about healthcare technology, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively across technical and operational teams.

What You'll Do

  • Own product marketing strategy for Bask Health's clinical and pharmacy platform capabilities.
  • Develop positioning and messaging for clinical workflow software.
  • Create product narratives explaining how Bask supports telehealth operations.
  • Translate complex technical workflows into clear customer-facing explanations.
  • Develop messaging for patient intake and questionnaire capabilities.
  • Support positioning for electronic medical record and clinical workflow features.
  • Create materials explaining provider review and administrative workflows.
  • Develop messaging for pharmacy integration and prescription-routing capabilities.
  • Support product communications related to fulfillment visibility and operational workflows.
  • Build and maintain product messaging frameworks and value propositions.
  • Lead go-to-market planning for relevant clinical and pharmacy product launches.
  • Collaborate with product managers to understand roadmaps and release priorities.
  • Work with engineers to understand platform architecture and supported functionality.
  • Partner with pharmacy operations stakeholders to understand operational requirements.
  • Coordinate with appropriate clinical and compliance reviewers on sensitive product claims.
  • Conduct customer research to identify healthcare software purchasing considerations.
  • Research competing telehealth infrastructure and healthcare technology platforms.
  • Develop competitive positioning and differentiation materials.
  • Create product launch briefs, presentations, and feature overviews.
  • Build sales enablement materials for technical and operational product conversations.
  • Help sales teams explain clinical and pharmacy platform capabilities accurately.
  • Develop educational materials that support customer onboarding and adoption.
  • Collaborate with customer success teams to identify common product questions.
  • Create content that addresses operational objections and implementation concerns.
  • Support website and product page messaging for clinical and pharmacy capabilities.
  • Establish consistent terminology across product marketing materials.
  • Define launch objectives and evaluate product marketing performance.
  • Present product marketing strategies, research findings, and recommendations to leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional product marketing experience, preferably within B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, or another technical software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing product positioning and messaging.
  • Experience leading go-to-market strategies for software products.
  • Proven ability to plan and execute cross-functional product launches.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS business models and buying processes.
  • Ability to understand complex software functionality and explain it clearly.
  • Experience translating technical product capabilities into customer benefits.
  • Strong written communication, editing, and presentation skills.
  • Experience conducting customer, market, and competitive research.
  • Ability to develop messaging frameworks and differentiated value propositions.
  • Experience creating sales enablement and product education materials.
  • Strong collaboration skills with product managers and engineers.
  • Experience working with sales and customer success teams.
  • Ability to work with subject matter experts to validate product information.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in customer-facing communications.
  • Ability to understand operational workflows and identify their commercial value.
  • Experience managing multiple product marketing initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to develop messaging for different customer audiences.
  • Familiarity with product launch measurement and adoption metrics.
  • Ability to incorporate customer feedback into positioning and launch strategies.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working in a rapidly evolving software environment.
  • Ability to take ownership of projects from research through execution.
  • Sound judgment when communicating technical, sensitive, or regulated product capabilities.

Nice to Have

  • Product marketing experience in healthcare technology or digital health.
  • Familiarity with telehealth platforms and healthcare infrastructure.
  • Experience marketing electronic medical record or electronic health record software.
  • Understanding of patient intake and clinical workflow systems.
  • Familiarity with pharmacy operations and prescription fulfillment workflows.
  • Experience positioning healthcare integrations or operational software.
  • Understanding of healthcare software procurement and implementation considerations.
  • Experience marketing platforms used by healthcare businesses.
  • Familiarity with healthcare-related regulatory and compliance considerations.
  • Experience working with clinical, pharmacy, or healthcare operations teams.
  • Understanding of direct-to-consumer telehealth business models.
  • Experience marketing white-label or embedded software platforms.
  • Familiarity with API integrations and technical product documentation.
  • Experience creating messaging for complex multi-product SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of healthcare workflow automation.
  • Experience developing technical sales enablement materials.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding and product adoption initiatives.
  • Experience building competitive intelligence for healthcare technology products.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled healthcare software, including appropriate limitations and review requirements.
  • Experience developing product marketing processes in a growing technology company.

Are you a highly motivated logistics professional with experience in specialized freight? We are looking for a solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join an established, family-owned freight brokerage with a clear path to becoming a commission-earning Account Manager!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: Bilingual Logistics Coordinator

  • Job ID: FRAPAM2R

  • Industry: Freight Brokerage and Logistics

  • Location: LATAM

  • Job Status: Full Time

  • Work Schedule: Thursday - Monday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (EST) (Tuesday & Wednesday off)

  • Salary: $1500 per month

  • Target Start Date: ASAP

🏢 About the Client

Our client is an established, family-owned logistics service provider and freight brokerage dedicated to empowering commerce through efficient and innovative supply chain solutions. Built on a foundation of integrity, sustainability, and long-term relationships, they operate as a deeply trusted partner for businesses across multiple sectors.

They pride themselves on a culture of constant communication and total transparency, providing 24/7 round-the-clock service to ensure time-sensitive freight is delivered seamlessly. By blending industry experience with personalized care, they provide an agile, fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to grow and directly contribute to the success of global trade.

💼 About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will start with a strong focus on tracking, tracing, and operational execution, with a clear trajectory to advance into a commission-earning Account Manager role.

The ideal candidate possesses exceptional customer service, problem-solving abilities, and a basic foundation in logistics operations. Rather than general freight, this role prioritizes experience in specialized freight sectors, specifically Produce and Open Deck (Oversize, Overweight, and Overwidth) cargo.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • Track & Trace: Provide high-level track and trace coverage, ensuring real-time shipment visibility and accurate system updates.

  • Issue Resolution: Proactively problem-solve operational hurdles during weekend and peak-season shifts to prevent delivery delays.

  • Carrier Coordination: Maintain accurate communication with carriers regarding load specifics, pickup/delivery addresses, and schedule adherence.

  • Market Pricing: Learn and adapt to market pricing platforms to effectively quote and negotiate competitive rates with open-deck and produce carriers.

  • Role Advancement: Smoothly transition from an internal operations support position to a client-facing account management role based on performance.

📈 Tiered Career Path

  • Tier C (Entry / Track & Trace): Focuses heavily on track and trace, answering driver calls, verifying pickup details, and providing proactive client updates.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, within 6 hours of Central Europe Time

About SPUN

SPUN is an environmental nonprofit with a mission to map and protect the mycorrhizal networks that regulate Earth's climate and ecosystems. Since our founding in 2021, we have built a global data platform for these living underground networks, which move approximately 13 billion tons of CO2 into soils every year.

Through our Underground Explorers programme and a network of over 400 Science Associates across 80+ countries, we generate high-resolution datasets and mapping tools using machine learning, remote sensing and field-based sequencing. We turn that data into strategies for conservation, restoration, climate mitigation and sustainable land management.

We are a team of roughly 20 people at an inflection point: the science has matured, the policy landscape is moving, and the opportunity to embed mycorrhizal networks into global conservation, restoration, biodiversity and climate frameworks is real and time sensitive.

About the Role

The Project Manager is the operational partner to our Director of Global Policy & Impact. The Director is building the coalitions, policy relationships and cross-sector alliances that turn mycorrhizal data into above-ground decisions. You will make that work run: turning strategy into plans, keeping many parallel workstreams moving, and making sure SPUN shows up prepared, on time and credibly in the rooms where decisions are made.

Our theory of change runs from science and data, to translation for key decision-makers through coalitions and partnerships, driving tangible policy and practice adoption, which leads to improved decision-making outcomes and eventually long-term ecosystem impact and transformational shift in systems, mindsets and power. You will help ensure each link in that chain is planned, tracked and evidenced.

This is a hands-on role in a young, entrepreneurial organisation. You will manage projects, but also coordinate meetings and people across time zones, support funder reporting and help build the systems that let a startup NGO scale with integrity.

You will be the operational link across SPUN's policy and impact work, supporting two colleagues in particular. You will work with the International Policy Strategist / Advisor, who leads our engagement on the EU Soil Monitoring Law and the UNCCD, to keep their calendar, submissions and deliverables on track. And you will work with the Advocacy Lead, Mongolia, and the local team there (policy expert, Underground Explorers representative), whose workplan, risks and reporting feed into the portfolio you maintain.

What You'll Do

Strategy and planning

Support the Director in

  • Translating the global impact strategy and roadmap into workplans with clear objectives, priority geographies, owners, milestones and deadlines.
  • Maintaining an integrated view of all policy, coalition and advocacy workstreams, flagging risks, dependencies and decisions needed.
  • Helping keep policy and advocacy efforts aligned with SPUN's programmatic work by coordinating with the science, data, restoration, Underground Explorers and communications teams.
  • Maintain one integrated workplan and tracker covering the global, EU/UNCCD and Mongolia workstreams, and run a regular check-in rhythm across the Director, the International Policy Strategist / Advisor and the Advocacy Lead, Mongolia.

Stakeholder and coalition coordination

  • Maintain a stakeholder map and relationship tracker covering policymakers, NGOs and grassroots movements, practitioners, Indigenous and local communities, funders and scientists, with next steps and owners.
  • Plan and run logistics and follow-up for convenings and collaborative processes, including agendas, briefing packs, participant coordination and action tracking.
  • Support coalition and alliance activity across conservation, restoration, and biodiversity and climate networks, keeping commitments visible and moving.
  • Coordinate with partners and consultants in different regions and cultural contexts, with respect for community-driven and Indigenous-led approaches.

Policy and advocacy delivery

  • Maintain a calendar of multilateral, regional and standard-setting processes (for example the CBD, UNFCCC and EU legislation), with deadlines for submissions, side events and consultations.
  • Manage the production cycle for policy briefings, position papers and impact narratives, from drafting and scientific review to design and publication.
  • Help track impact of the Underground Explorers and Advocates network and turn data and stories the into materials for policymakers, practitioners and funders, working with the science and communications teams.
  • Support the Director for senior-level representation at international forums with briefings, speaking materials and follow-up actions.
  • Track how mycorrhizal science is being adopted into practitioner protocols, standards and decision-making tools.

Learning, impact and funding

  • Help define indicators and maintain a simple framework for tracking progress against the theory of change, from outputs through to policy and practice change.
  • Gather and synthesise insights from stakeholders, programme outcomes and SPUN's data to support learning and strategy adjustments.
  • Coordinate inputs for grant proposals and reports to funders, the board and public audiences, keeping deadlines and requirements on track.
  • Help maintain a pipeline of funding opportunities aligned with SPUN's science-to-policy and practice mission.
  • Track project budgets with our finance support and flag issues early.

Organisation and systems

  • Set up and improve lightweight project tools, templates and processes that fit a small team.
  • Keep documentation, trackers and shared files organised and easy to find.
  • Contribute to organisational culture, and support the executive team on projects when needed.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of project or programme management experience, ideally in an environmental, conservation, policy, advocacy or international development setting.
  • Experience coordinating multi-stakeholder work across countries, such as coalitions, multi-partner projects or international convenings.
  • Comfort working with senior leaders, and the judgement to prepare briefings and anticipate what they will need.
  • Excellent organisation and the ability to manage many workstreams at once without losing detail.
  • Clear, concise writing, including editing and project-managing technical or policy documents.
  • Comfort with data and with turning programme information into credible reporting for funders and partners.
  • Experience in a small, entrepreneurial organisation where building systems from scratch is energising rather than uncomfortable.
  • Self-directed and autonomous, while collaborative and a strong team player.
  • Strong cultural competency and diplomatic skills, with respect for and awareness of Indigenous rights and community-driven conservation models.
  • Excellent oral and written English; other languages are a significant plus.
  • Confident with collaboration and project tools (such as Google Workspace and a task tool like Notion or Asana).

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with international biodiversity, climate or restoration policy processes.
  • Experience with grant management, funder reporting or monitoring, evaluation and learning.
  • Background in or genuine curiosity about ecology, soil science or fungi.
  • A project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile), though practical experience matters more

What Makes This Role Distinctive

Mycorrhizal networks underpin nearly every terrestrial ecosystem on Earth, yet they remain almost entirely absent from the conservation, restoration and climate frameworks meant to protect them. SPUN has built the science to change that. As the person who keeps the policy and impact work organised and moving, you will be central to helping write a new chapter in how the world understands and acts on underground ecosystems.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You understand SPUN's science, theory of change and priorities. You have mapped all live policy and impact workstreams, set up a simple planning and reporting rhythm the team uses, and built working relationships across the team and with key partners.
  • First 12 months: The Director has clear visibility of progress, risks and upcoming opportunities. Convenings, briefings and policy moments are delivered on time and to a high standard, and funders and the board receive timely, credible impact reporting.
  • Longer term: The coordination behind SPUN's policy and advocacy work is up to speed so that the Director can focus on relationships and influence, helping SPUN's data become indispensable to decision-makers and visible in changes in practice on the ground.

Why Join SPUN

At SPUN, we know that taking care of our team means empowering people to do their best work. Our benefits support health, well-being, growth, and balance. They are tailored to local laws so that everyone across our globally distributed team receives the same high standard of support.

We believe work should be both impactful and sustainable, and our benefits are designed to help you thrive in your role and beyond.

At SPUN, we embrace diversity as a fundamental pillar of our mission to protect underground ecosystems. Our commitment to decolonizing science depends on the diversity of knowledge and experience on our team and among our partners across the globe. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or background, feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We highly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented or marginalized groups, including but not limited to women, LGBTQIA+ people, individuals from the Global South, and individuals with Indigenous heritage, to apply to join our team at SPUN.

To learn more about our organization and culture, please visit our website .
