jobs.description:
About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.

Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience; enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.

There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation as it has a clear and demonstrable ROI to our customers.

The Opportunity

    Every patient who receives a medical bill has questions: what is this charge, will my insurance cover it, can I pay it in parts, why is it different from last time. How those questions get answered decides whether the patient pays, calls back, or gives up.

    Collectly's AI agent, Billie, answers those questions today across chat, SMS, and voice for hundreds of medical practices nationwide. We are looking for a Product Manager to own the patient experience around it: what Billie handles, how she interacts with clinic staff, how we reach patients proactively, and how we prove to our customers that it works.

    This is a hands-on product ownership role at a small, fast-moving product team. Some of the work is taking a product area from 1 to 10, where the problem is still being discovered with customers. Some of it is taking an area from 10 to 100, where something that works for one customer has to work for every customer without being rebuilt each time. You will work directly with founders, customers, engineering, data, and the implementation teams, and you will see what you decide in production within weeks.

Key Responsibilities

    - Lead product discovery with customers — billing leaders, support managers, front-desk staff — and turn what you learn into a prioritized roadmap for patient experience.

    - Own the patient experience end to end: define the set of patient situations that decide whether the experience is good — the questions patients ask, the hand-offs to staff, the dead ends — and work with engineering to make the product handle each one well.

    - Design proactive patient outreach — who is contacted, on which channel, when, with what message — and measure the effect on patient satisfaction and on revenue collected.

    - Define and own the metrics for the patient-facing product — escalation rate, self-service rate, patient satisfaction, payment outcomes — and use them to decide what gets built next.

    - Analyze product performance directly: query the data warehouse, read real patient conversations, find where the agent falls short and why.

    - Prototype with AI tools before specifying: build the mock, the script, or the analysis that settles the question.

    - Partner with engineering on agent behavior, prompts, EHR and practice-management integrations, and where human-in-the-loop belongs.

    - Scale what works across the customer base: turn one-off configurations into features every practice gets, instead of rebuilding per customer.

    - Lead technical customer projects: launch new customers and new capabilities with implementation and customer success, and own the first weeks after go-live.

    - Keep the customer-facing material current for pre-service and patient support: case studies with real numbers, working demos, and sales playbooks.

What Success Looks Like

    Within the first 6 months, you will:

    - Define a set of cases that determine a great patient experience and work with engineering teams to optimize the product to fit those cases
    - Design proactive patient outreach flows and evaluate how they impact patient satisfaction and patient revenue
    - Decide how to increase resolution rates for Collectly patient support and which products to build to resolve those requests
    - Update case studies, demos and sales playbooks for Collectly pre-service and patient support products

Qualifications

    Required

    - Experience in US healthcare (must-have!): RCM, eligibility, claims, payments, payer-provider workflows
    - 3+ years of product management experience in technical B2B products, with full ownership of what gets built and why

    - A track record of quantified business outcomes: revenue, cost reduction, conversion, automation rate, or efficiency

    - Direct customer-facing experience with B2B customers; enterprise experience preferred

    - Experience launching new products, not only features within existing ones

    - Hands-on with AI tools: able to build prototypes and run analyses with Claude or similar

    - Strong analytical skills; comfortable writing code and SQL with AI while doing your own analysis

    - Ability to fly to San Francisco for an onsite interview with the team (at our costs)

    Core Competencies

    - Customer discovery

    - Product ownership and decision-making

    - Data-driven decision making

    - Analytical depth and curiosity
    - Leading technical customer projects

    - Hands-on mindset

    Preferred

    - A previous role in engineering, data science, or analytics
    - Startup or small-product-team background; founder or early-stage experience

    - Experience working on AI/ML products

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Unlimited PTO: We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to recharge when you need it.

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents, because your well-being matters to us.

  • Equity Opportunities: Share in our success with stock options - your hard work will drive our growth.

  • Retirement Planning Made Easy: Enjoy a 401(k) with a generous company match to secure your future.

  • Student Loan Support: We help lighten the load with contributions toward your student loans.

  • Compensation Range: 160-210k/year

Collectly is a tech-enabled patient billing platform that works as an add-on for your EHR/PM. Collectly accelerates and increases patient cash flow, streamlines post-service billing operations, and provides the best patient experience that works for all demographics.

Job Description: English Language Expert – Australia & New Zealand

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (Australia or New Zealand)

About the Role

We are seeking English Language Experts from Australia and New Zealand to support an AI training project focused on improving speech recognition and language understanding. You will use your knowledge of regional accents, dialects, vocabulary, and language variations to review audio recordings and improve transcription accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Listen to multi-speaker audio recordings and identify speaker and audio metadata, including dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.
  • Review and correct first-pass ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts using Australian and New Zealand English conventions.
  • Identify and categorize regional accents, including General, Broad, and Cultivated Australian English, Aboriginal English, Māori English, and Pasifika-influenced English.
  • Recognize community and regional language variations, including those influenced by Italian, Greek, Vietnamese, and Lebanese heritage communities.
  • Distinguish Australian and New Zealand speakers using pronunciation and linguistic features, including the New Zealand short-front vowel shift.
  • Apply knowledge of local vocabulary, idioms, slang, Māori expressions, code-switching, and spelling conventions.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent language annotation according to project guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluent proficiency in Australian and/or New Zealand English, with familiarity across regional accents and dialects.
  • Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to distinguish subtle differences in Australian and New Zealand pronunciation, vocabulary, and usage.
  • Experience with audio annotation, metadata tagging, or transcription is an advantage.
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Interest in linguistic technology, AI training, or language data projects is a plus.

August Synergy Group (ASG), an 8(a)-eligible joint venture affiliated with CETECHS, is seeking experienced Mortality Coders, ICD-10 Cause-of-Death Coding Specialists, and Nosologists to support an anticipated federal contract with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS).

We are particularly interested in individuals with previous or current experience supporting CDC mortality coding programs, including incumbent personnel interested in continuing their work under a new contractor.

This position involves reviewing, interpreting, and assigning ICD-10 codes to causes of death reported on death certificates and fetal death records. Successful candidates will support the accuracy, consistency, and quality of national mortality statistics.

This position requires specialized mortality coding experience. Traditional ICD-10-CM medical billing and reimbursement coding experience alone may not meet the qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and assign ICD-10 cause-of-death codes to mortality and fetal death records.

  • Perform manual coding of records that cannot be processed through automated coding systems.

  • Apply applicable ICD-10 mortality coding conventions, rules, and procedures.

  • Review and resolve complex or ambiguous cause-of-death statements.

  • Support quality assurance, quality control, and coding accuracy initiatives.

  • Identify and correct coding discrepancies.

  • Participate in recoding and validation activities as assigned.

  • Maintain coding accuracy consistent with CDC performance standards.

  • Meet established productivity, turnaround, and quality requirements.

  • Participate in required training and maintain proficiency with updated coding guidance.

  • Protect confidential government information and comply with applicable security requirements.

  • Collaborate with project leadership and other coding specialists to meet contract deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience with ICD-10 mortality cause-of-death coding, preferably supporting CDC, NCHS, state vital records programs, or similar public health mortality coding operations.

  • Knowledge of mortality coding rules, conventions, and procedures.

  • Ability to interpret medical terminology and causes of death documented on death certificates.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to consistently produce accurate coding results.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.

  • Ability to complete required federal background screening and obtain necessary government system access.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current or previous experience supporting the CDC/NCHS mortality coding contract.

  • Experience as a mortality nosologist.

  • Experience coding both mortality and fetal death records.

  • Familiarity with automated mortality coding systems and manual coding exception processes.

  • Experience performing mortality coding quality control, recoding, or system validation.

  • Experience working on federal public health contracts.

  • Prior experience meeting government coding accuracy and production requirements.

Work Environment

jobs.title: Contracts Administrator
jobs.description:
Contracts Administrator (Legal Operations, CLM & Contract Lifecycle Management) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Contracts Administrator to manage the complete contract lifecycle—from intake and drafting through execution, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a highly detail-oriented, process-driven role responsible for ensuring contracts move efficiently, accurately, and compliantly across Legal, Sales, Procurement, Finance, Security, and Executive teams. You’ll oversee contract workflows, coordinate approvals, maintain CLM systems, track renewals, and support audit readiness while helping build scalable legal operations.

If you thrive in structured, high-volume environments and enjoy creating organized, efficient systems, this role offers excellent ownership and long-term growth.

Responsibilities

Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contracts from intake through drafting, review, approval, execution, storage, renewals, and reporting.
  • Ensure agreements are accurate, compliant, fully executed, searchable, and audit-ready.
  • Maintain contract repositories and ensure complete documentation throughout the contract lifecycle.

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft, review, and manage agreements including:
    • NDAs
    • DPAs
    • Statements of Work (SOWs)
    • Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
    • Vendor Agreements
    • Order Forms
    • Partner and Reseller Agreements
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes.
  • Escalate non-standard legal terms involving indemnification, limitation of liability, intellectual property, data privacy, termination clauses, and service level agreements.
  • Maintain deviation logs, approval records, and contract history.

Approvals & Governance

  • Coordinate contract approvals across Legal, Finance, Procurement, Security, Information Security, Sales, and Executive teams.
  • Verify commercial terms align with pricing and business requirements.
  • Ensure vendor onboarding documentation is complete, including:
    • W-9 forms
    • Certificates of Insurance (COIs)
    • Banking information
    • Compliance documentation

Contract Execution & Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using DocuSign or Adobe Sign.
  • Verify signer authority, signature blocks, and execution completeness.
  • Maintain agreements within CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Icertis, Agiloft, ContractWorks, Conga, SharePoint, or similar systems.
  • Ensure metadata remains accurate, including contract value, effective dates, renewal terms, jurisdiction, and privacy addenda.

Renewals, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Track contract renewals, notice periods, pricing changes, deliverables, and contractual obligations.
  • Send proactive renewal reminders to internal stakeholders.
  • Support compliance with GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and approval records.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Prepare reports covering:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA performance
    • Renewal pipeline
    • Contract deviations
    • Standard versus non-standard agreements
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, approval workflows, and CLM processes.
  • Help scale legal operations through workflow automation and documentation improvements.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Process-driven and comfortable managing high-volume contract workflows.
  • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across multiple departments.
  • Able to identify contractual risks, inconsistencies, and missing information quickly.
  • Passionate about building efficient, scalable operational systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Contracts Administration, Legal Operations, or Contract Coordination.
  • Hands-on experience with CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Icertis, Agiloft, ContractWorks, Conga, SharePoint, or similar systems.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing software
  • Working knowledge of:
    • NDAs
    • DPAs
    • MSAs
    • Confidentiality agreements
    • Indemnification
    • Intellectual property clauses
    • Limitation of liability
    • Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with both buy-side and sell-side contracts.
  • Exposure to procurement, vendor onboarding, vendor risk management, or security questionnaires.
  • Experience developing clause libraries, contract templates, and legal playbooks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Contract cycle times consistently meet SLA targets.
  • Zero missed renewals, notice periods, or contractual obligations.
  • Accurate and complete contract repository with 100% metadata accuracy.
  • High percentage of agreements executed using approved standard language.
  • Audit-ready documentation maintained at all times.
  • Continuous improvements in legal operations through process optimization.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (NDA Redlining & Contract Tracking Exercise)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to assess your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Manager

JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount.

The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

  • Own deal structuring for complex new business, expansion, and renewal deals, partnering with sales leaders on creative structures that protect margin and policy.
  • Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy.
  • Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones.
  • Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff.
  • Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook.
  • Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development.
  • Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail.
  • Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds.
  • Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation.
  • Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions.
  • Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

    • 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS companies, including 3+ years owning Deal Desk operations end to end.
    • Demonstrated experience building Deal Desk processes from the ground up at an early-stage or growth-stage company, with the ability to walk through what was built, in what order, and what you would do differently.
    • Hands-on AI practitioner who has used AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce) to automate real Deal Desk or RevOps work, with an example to share.
    • Hands-on experience structuring and contracting international SaaS deals across multiple regions, currencies, and legal entities.

    • Experience implementing CPQ and CLM systems; strong modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets.
    • Proven ability to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership, including saying no to senior sellers while keeping the relationship intact.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

    • Experience launching AI, agentic, or data product SKUs, or partner and marketplace deal structures.
    • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
    • Experience in WFM, HCM, or enterprise SaaS selling to retail, hospitality, or healthcare.
    • Operates with a builder’s mindset — proactive, resourceful, and eager to create clarity from ambiguity with a high degree of independence.
    • Strong personal ownership, high integrity, and a focus on outcomes over activity.
    • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
    • Thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and embraces change with enthusiasm.
    • Flexibility to cover urgent deal approvals across time zones, especially at quarter-end.

SALARY RANGE:

Base Salary Range $100,000 - $140,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. jobs.title: Product Design Intern
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Design Intern to join Bask Health and gain hands-on experience designing intuitive, functional, and visually polished software experiences.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Product Design Intern, you'll work alongside experienced designers, product managers, and engineers to help improve how people interact with our products.

This internship is designed for students, recent graduates, and aspiring product designers who want to develop practical UX and UI design skills while contributing to real product initiatives.

You'll have opportunities to support interface design, wireframing, prototyping, user flows, and design system improvements.

Your projects may involve merchant dashboards, onboarding experiences, patient questionnaires, account settings, administrative interfaces, or other areas of the platform.

You'll learn how product teams identify user problems, evaluate possible solutions, and translate requirements into functional interface designs.

You'll use Figma to create wireframes, interface mockups, interactive prototypes, and design documentation.

You'll work with experienced designers to understand visual hierarchy, interaction patterns, responsive layouts, and accessibility considerations.

You'll also learn how design decisions connect to business requirements, user needs, and technical constraints.

A key part of this internship will be developing your design process. You'll practice exploring multiple solutions, explaining your decisions, receiving feedback, and refining your work through iteration.

You'll participate in design reviews and collaborate with product managers to understand feature requirements and priorities.

You'll also have opportunities to work with engineers and learn how design specifications are translated into working software.

You'll become familiar with Bask Health's design system and help maintain consistency across product experiences.

You'll learn how usability research, user feedback, and product observations can inform design decisions.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll also learn the importance of clarity, accessibility, privacy, and accuracy when designing patient-facing and operational experiences.

You'll receive guidance on assigned projects and have opportunities to take increasing ownership of clearly defined design tasks as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious, creative, detail-oriented, open to feedback, and excited to build practical product design experience.

What You'll Do

  • Support product design projects across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with creating user interface designs for web applications.
  • Develop wireframes for new features and workflow improvements.
  • Build interactive prototypes using Figma.
  • Help translate product requirements into interface concepts.
  • Support design improvements for merchant dashboards.
  • Assist with onboarding and account setup interface designs.
  • Contribute to patient questionnaire and multi-step form design projects.
  • Help create layouts for settings and administrative interfaces.
  • Explore different design approaches for assigned product problems.
  • Collaborate with experienced designers to refine UX and UI concepts.
  • Participate in design reviews and feedback sessions.
  • Apply feedback to improve interface usability and visual consistency.
  • Use established design system components and patterns.
  • Help organize and document reusable design components.
  • Support responsive interface design for desktop and mobile experiences.
  • Learn and apply foundational accessibility principles.
  • Assist with creating user flows and interaction diagrams.
  • Collaborate with UX researchers to understand usability findings.
  • Work with content designers to ensure interface copy and layouts are clear.
  • Participate in product discussions to understand user needs.
  • Collaborate with engineers to understand implementation requirements.
  • Help prepare design files and specifications for development handoff.
  • Support design quality assurance by reviewing implemented interfaces.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain organized Figma files and project documentation.
  • Learn how product design fits into the software development process.
  • Complete assigned design tasks with guidance and regular feedback.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in product design, UX/UI design, interaction design, human-computer interaction, graphic design, or a related field, or equivalent independent learning and project experience.
  • No prior professional product design experience required.
  • Portfolio, academic projects, or personal design work demonstrating foundational design skills.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable interface design tools.
  • Basic understanding of user experience design principles.
  • Understanding of visual design fundamentals, including typography, spacing, hierarchy, and layout.
  • Ability to create basic wireframes or interface mockups.
  • Interest in interactive prototyping and digital product design.
  • Familiarity with user-centered design concepts.
  • Willingness to learn about design systems and reusable components.
  • Basic understanding of responsive web design.
  • Interest in accessibility and inclusive design.
  • Strong attention to detail and visual consistency.
  • Ability to communicate design ideas and explain creative decisions.
  • Willingness to receive feedback and iterate on designs.
  • Ability to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Curiosity about how people interact with software.
  • Interest in solving practical usability problems.
  • Willingness to explore multiple design solutions.
  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance.
  • Strong motivation to learn new tools and design techniques.
  • Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks.
  • Enthusiasm for developing a career in product design.

Nice to Have

  • Previous internship or project experience in UX/UI design.
  • Experience designing interfaces for web or mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with SaaS platforms or administrative dashboards.
  • Experience creating onboarding flows or multi-step forms.
  • Interest in healthcare technology or telehealth products.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce or direct-to-consumer software.
  • Experience using Figma Auto Layout and components.
  • Understanding of design systems and reusable interface patterns.
  • Familiarity with user flows and journey mapping.
  • Experience conducting basic usability tests.
  • Understanding of user research methods.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG.
  • Experience designing responsive interfaces.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS.
  • Experience collaborating with developers on student or independent projects.
  • Familiarity with prototyping or AI-assisted design tools.
  • Experience participating in hackathons or design competitions.
  • Coursework involving interaction design or human-computer interaction.
  • Experience presenting design projects or case studies.
  • Interest in working on complex software products and learning from cross-functional teams.

Help Modernize the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos has an immediate opening for a Mid-Level Network Integration Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help modernize, integrate, and secure the Army's global enterprise network, supporting critical military communications worldwide.

In this remote role, you'll work with experienced network engineers and technical teams to support network integration, routing and switching, SD-WAN connectivity, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization.

We're looking for someone with strong hands-on networking experience who enjoys solving technical challenges, integrating complex network systems, and supporting mission-critical infrastructure.


What You'll Do

  • Support the engineering and integration of network services across the Army's global network.
  • Perform network device discovery, validate management connectivity, and identify migration dependencies.
  • Assist with network migration planning, implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and post-migration validation.
  • Support SD-WAN, MPLS, VPN, and enterprise LAN/WAN connectivity.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VRFs, routing tables, and network segmentation.
  • Perform network device upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity, performance, and security issues.
  • Work with engineering teams to assess legacy network environments and support modernization efforts.
  • Support DoD security requirements, including STIG implementation and network hardening.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders during network integration, testing, and migration activities.
  • Develop and maintain site integration plans, network diagrams, configuration documentation, test configurations, and migration validation records.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and cybersecurity teams to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Work independently on assigned engineering tasks while escalating advanced issues when needed.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Strong hands-on experience with enterprise routing, switching, network integration, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of LAN/WAN, BGP, TCP/UDP, IPSec, VPNs, Layer 2/Layer 3 routing, MPLS, and firewalls.
  • Experience with network device patching, upgrades, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Experience with at least one network management platform, such as:
    • Palo Alto Panorama
    • Cisco Prime
    • Cisco DNA
    • Junos Space
  • Hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco
    • Juniper
    • Palo Alto
    • Dell Networking
    • Remote Access VPN (RAVPN)
    • GlobalProtect
    • AppGate
  • Experience implementing DoD STIGs and network security hardening.
  • Familiarity with SFTP, SSH, SCP, SNMP, and NTP.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer-facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with geographically dispersed teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts to support network integration and migration activities.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent networking certification.
  • Experience with network integration, migration, modernization, or infrastructure transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco SD-WAN.
  • Experience with Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW).
  • Familiarity with virtualized network infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Basic Python scripting experience for network automation.
  • Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed networks.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements.
  • Experience creating network diagrams, configuration records, and technical documentation.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to work on a mission that directly supports the U.S. Army's ability to communicate and operate around the world.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, gain exposure to complex enterprise networking technologies, and play an important role in modernizing critical military infrastructure.


If you're a cleared Network Engineer with strong routing, switching, and network integration experience, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help build the future of the Army's global network. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

jobs.description:
About Redesign Group

The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation. Our globally diverse team members, partnerships with strategic technology manufacturers, and cybersecurity services position us to be a business partner that’s ready for what’s next.

We live by our core values of operating in the service of others, being problem solvers, and focusing on long term partnerships. You’ll excel at Redesign if you thrive in a rewarding environment that moves quickly, challenges you to grow and fosters collaboration. We seek candidates with a hands-on customer-first approach, robust interpersonal and communication skills, strong work ethic and excellent time management. While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.

Job Description

The Associate Cloud Engineer keeps our clients' cloud environments healthy day to day. You will work inside the baselines and runbooks our senior engineers have set: working monitoring alerts and tickets, applying patches and updates, executing documented changes, and learning the platforms from the engineers who own them. You will work from a ticketing system against defined service level objectives, supported by a global network operations center that handles first-line monitoring and intake.

Our clients run primarily on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, with AWS and Google Cloud in a growing minority of environments and Redesign Cloud for hosted workloads. We do not expect you to have run production cloud environments yet, but we do expect foundational knowledge of one major cloud provider, basic scripting ability, and the appetite to build depth in the rest.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work cloud and infrastructure alerts and tickets in priority order, resolving what is in scope and escalating with clear detail when it is not.
  • Perform routine operational tasks across Azure, Microsoft 365, and AWS, including patching, backup verification, access requests, and resource tagging.
  • Execute documented changes such as VM resizing, storage expansion, network security group updates, and policy adjustments through structured change management.
  • Monitor platform health, capacity, and cost dashboards and flag risks to senior engineers before they become incidents.
  • Review cloud cost and usage reports and raise rightsizing and cleanup opportunities for senior engineers to approve.
  • Assist senior engineers on cloud projects, migrations, and remediation work, taking ownership of defined tasks.
  • Support incident response by gathering evidence, building timelines, and contributing to root cause analyses.
  • Maintain and improve runbooks, knowledge base articles, and environment documentation as you learn.
  • Script small repeatable tasks in PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Give client contacts and internal teams clear status reporting on the tickets and changes you own.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Foundational knowledge of Microsoft Azure or AWS covering compute, storage, networking, and identity concepts.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux basics, Active Directory and Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Aptitude for automation using AI tooling and basic scripting (PowerShell, Bash, or Python), and the willingness to build that skill further.
  • Comfort working from a ticketing system and following documented procedures and change management precisely.
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts and the discipline to document what you did and why.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with clients and internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft AZ-900 or AZ-104, AWS Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate, or comparable cloud certifications.
  • Exposure to infrastructure as code such as Bicep or Terraform, or to monitoring tooling such as Azure Monitor or CloudWatch.
  • Internship, lab, or home-lab experience building and breaking cloud environments.

Background

  • 0 to 2 years in IT support, systems administration, or cloud operations, or a recent graduate with hands-on lab experience.
  • Exposure to supporting more than one environment at a time, ideally in a managed services or help desk setting.
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
  • Flexible time off plan
  • 15 paid holidays
  • Sick leave (amount varies by state requirements and is at least the minimum required by any state)
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life insurance
  • Paid parental leave

We’re an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates without regard to any legally protected status. This role is subject to applicable employment laws based on work location. In compliance with pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this role is included, with final pay based on experience, skills, and location. jobs.title: Finance Officer (Payments & Treasury)
jobs.candidate_required_location: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Uganda
jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role

The Finance team supports all financial activities in 10 countries, 9 of them in Africa. As part of the global finance team, you will run payment cycles across multiple countries and make them faster and more accurate. You’ll also support country finance operations, working closely with the rest of the Finance team.

You are a great candidate for this role if you have hands-on payments experience, strong numerical skills, learn new systems quickly, and already use technology and AI tools to work smarter.

Reports to: Finance Manager

Level: Officer

Location:This role is open only to candidates based in Rwanda, DRC, Malawi, Kenya or Uganda, where we can employ you directly through a GiveDirectly entity.

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel 1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or colocations

What you’ll do:

  • Payments and treasury
    • Run payment cycles in multiple countries end to end: preparing, validating and issuing payments, and resolving exceptions and failed payments quickly.
    • Reconcile payments with bank and mobile money statements, and investigate and clear any differences.
    • Support account funding, cash forecasting, and FX across multiple currencies to ensure payments are never delayed.
    • Work with banks, mobile money operators and country teams to fix payment and funding issues.
    • Improve and standardise payment processes across countries, and document them in clear SOPs.
    • Use automation and AI tools to improve payment accuracy, speed and reporting.
  • Country finance operations
    • Support country finance operations, e.g., petty cash counts, asset counts, and finance liaison with authorities on tax and statutory filings.
    • Support the wider Finance team as needed to meet department goals.
  • Risk and compliance
    • Apply strong controls in every payment process, including maker-checker, audit trails and segregation of duties.
    • Handle recipient and payment data securely, and flag fraud risks early.
    • Understand and implement compliance requirements from tax regulators and payment partners.
    • Support in-country audits and special reporting to donors and regulators on request.

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related field, or equivalent experience. A professional qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CPA or similar, completed or in progress) is a plus.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in accounting or finance, including at least 1 year running payments. For example: bulk or high-volume disbursements, bank and mobile money transfers, payment reconciliations and fixing failed payments.
  • Strong numerical skills and close attention to detail. You can reconcile large datasets accurately under deadline pressure and catch errors before they reach recipients.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (e.g. XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, data validation), and experience with finance and payments software (e.g. Intacct, Tipalti, Emburse, QuickBooks, online banking platforms).
  • You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) every day to work faster and better, for example to analyse data, draft procedures or investigate exceptions. You check AI output carefully and handle sensitive data responsibly.
  • You learn quickly and do well in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where priorities and processes change often.
  • Fluent English. Working knowledge of French or Portuguese is an advantage.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

The compensation for this role across the various locations is as shown below:

Kenya:

Base Salary: $16,030

Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Rwanda:

Base Salary: $13,810

Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Uganda:

Base Salary: $14,840

Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

  • A supportive team that works hard and cares hard
  • A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)
  • Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take
  • Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE‑ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. Our mission is to help GM deliver trusted automated‑driving products. As the central authority for automated driving system (ADS) safety, SAFE‑ADS brings together experts from across the company to develop and maintain a comprehensive safety case including safety performance indicators for GM’s automated‑driving technologies.

GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion—and autonomous vehicle safety is essential to achieving that vision.

As Staff AV Behavior and AI Safety Engineer, you will lead the strategy and support execution for how GM defines, measures, and validates the safety of SAE Level 3 – 4 Automated Driving Systems powered by machine‑learned models. You will report into the AV Safety Strategy and Assurance organization and directly influence launch decisions for GM’s next generation of automated driving products.

If you are passionate about safety, have deep experience in autonomous vehicle development and validation, and are a proven technical leader in AI/ML‑driven systems, this role is an opportunity to shape how millions of people experience safe automated driving.

The Role

The AV Safety Strategy and Assurance team is seeking a hands‑on Principal engineer with extensive experience in the end‑to‑end development lifecycle of autonomous vehicle behaviors, from ADS Architecture, ODD and behavior definition through simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road validation.

If you’re excited to lead in autonomous driving safety, we’d love to hear from you!

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • Impact at Scale: Your work will directly influence how GM brings safe automated driving systems to millions of customers.
  • End‑to‑End Ownership: You will own the strategy, framework, and evidence assessment for AV behavior and AI safety.
  • Cross‑Functional Reach: You will collaborate across AI, software, validation, simulation, metrics operations and vehicle program teams, shaping the direction of GM’s automated driving roadmap.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):

  • Own AI and AV behavior safety strategy for next generation ADS architectures
  • Design and implement AI Safety strategies for cutting-edge AI Models like Imitation Learning and Reinforcement learning.
  • Own the behavior‑focused portion of the ADS Safety Case, including key claims, sufficiency criteria, and recommended evidence for AV behavior safety performance.
  • Collaborate with Software Validation, Embodied AI, Simulation, and Safety Metrics teams to define the end‑to‑end AV behavior validation and AI safety methodology for AI‑driven systems.
  • Collaborate on evaluation metrics, human benchmarks, and safety launch targets for AV behaviors, AI Safety, and overall system performance.
  • Innovate and co-develop safety performance indicators (SPIs) for AV behaviors.
  • Innovate and co-develop metrics for all stages of ML model development lifecycle
  • Reference and interpret standards such as ISO/PAS 8800 (AI Safety), ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO 5083, and AVSC best practices to define GM’s strategy for safe autonomous system development, validation and deployment
  • Assess AV performance across safety and reliability dimensions using simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road data and provide clear, prioritized feedback to engineering teams
  • Define and run an assurance process to verify the sufficiency criteria and safety targets to support launch readiness

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in machine learning, engineering, data science, or a related field
  • 7+ years in autonomous vehicle or robotics development or related field
  • Demonstrated experience working on production‑intent AV programs
  • Track record providing technical safety leadership in AV development (e.g., defining safety strategies, risk assessments, validation methodologies, safety case contributions).
  • Deep understanding of AV behavior development: defining ODDs, behaviors, and evaluation criteria; analyzing simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road test data; and generating prioritized, actionable recommendations for developers.
  • Experience with ML model evaluation methodologies and ML model development Lifecyle
  • Experience applying AV safety standards and best practices, such as ISO/PAS 8800, ISO 5083, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and AVSC practices
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs to executives and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence cross‑functional teams (Software, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, Product, Program Management, Operations) without direct authority.
  • Strong problem‑solving mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and a proactive attitude toward learning and continuous improvement.

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred qualifications):

  • Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
  • Machine Learning & AI: Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Deep learning, Imitation Learning, Reinforcement Learning,
  • Cloud & Big Data Platforms: Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow)
  • Deployment & MLOps: MLflow, Model Monitoring & Versioning, GitHub, Jira

Full-Time Professional Online Tutor – SAT/ACT English & Reading

Remote | Full-Time W-2 | $25/hr Starting Pay | Paid Training & Prep | Benefits

Make a Difference. Build a Career. Tutor from Home.

Make a meaningful impact on students’ academic journeys—all from the comfort of your home. Join Revolution Prep as a full-time tutor and enjoy the stability, benefits, and support of being a full-time W-2 employee—not an independent contractor.

We provide a dynamic, in-house curriculum and a wealth of teaching resources, so you can spend less time creating lesson plans and searching for materials and more time doing what you do best: helping students learn and succeed.

You’ll also receive paid training and prep time, along with a supportive community of fellow tutors who are passionate about education. Whether you’re helping a student master a challenging concept, build confidence, or reach an important academic goal, your work makes a real difference.

Schedule Requirements

This role requires a consistent weekly schedule and a minimum of 38 hours of availability, including evenings and weekends.

  • The goal is 30+ hours of tutoring per week, though actual hours may vary based on student demand and your subject expertise.
  • At least 8 hours of weekend availability required
  • Availability must remain consistent from week to week
  • Schedules are posted in 2-6 hour blocks and extend 9+ months into the future
  • Time-off requests should generally be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance
  • Minimum one-year employment commitment

Prime-time availability:

  • Monday–Thursday: 3–11 PM ET
  • Friday: 3–7 PM ET
  • Saturday: 9 AM–7 PM ET
  • Sunday: 9 AM–10 PM ET

What You'll Teach

  • SAT and ACT English and Reading test preparation
  • Middle and high school English
  • Executive function skills, including organization, planning, time management, and study strategies
  • Additional academic subjects based on your expertise and Revolution Prep’s needs

What You'll Do

  • Lead engaging online tutoring sessions using Revolution Prep's curriculum and resources
  • Help students understand challenging concepts and develop effective learning strategies
  • Prepare for sessions using company-provided materials
  • Communicate with students and families about academic progress
  • Build supportive relationships that motivate students to reach their goals
  • Participate in paid training and ongoing professional development
  • Collaborate with Faculty Leaders and fellow tutors to continuously improve your teaching

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • At least 1 year of professional teaching or tutoring experience
  • Comfortable teaching Middle School through High School Level English
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to explain challenging concepts clearly and patiently
  • SAT/ACT tutoring or test-preparation experience is a plus
  • AP subject expertise is a plus
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. and currently residing in the U.S.

Why Join Revolution Prep?

  • Full-time W-2 employment
  • $25/hour starting rate for tutoring
  • Opportunity to earn up to $29/hour after the 90-day review, based on performance and subject coverage
  • Paid prep and training time
  • Health insurance
  • 401(k) options
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Paid onboarding and ongoing professional development
  • Proven curriculum and subject-specific materials provided
  • No need to compete for tutoring hours; hours are allocated based on availability and subject expertise
  • Support from experienced Faculty Leaders
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on students' academic and personal development

Technology Requirements

You'll need:

  • A Mac or PC desktop/laptop
  • Reliable high-speed internet with an Ethernet connection
  • At least 4GB available RAM
  • A quiet, professional workspace suitable for online instruction

Revolution Prep can provide a technology kit for tutors who need one, including a webcam, headset, ring light, green screen and annotation tablet.

Our Hiring Process

After submitting your application, candidates will receive a link to a required approximately 15-minute assessment. The assessment helps Revolution Prep evaluate subject knowledge and overall fit for the Professional Tutor role.

Candidates who advance in the process will also complete a comprehensive background check.

Q&A

Q: Are there additional responsibilities?

A: In addition to tutoring, you'll communicate with families about student progress and prepare for sessions using company-provided materials. Both collectively make up around 10% of your workload and are paid time. We also offer ongoing professional development which is paid.

Q: How flexible is the time-off policy?

A: Requests for time off must be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance. We understand emergencies happen, so we have systems in place for coverage in those events.

Q: Is ongoing training part of the role?

A: Yes, ongoing professional development is required – we offer 24 hours of paid training per year after the initial onboarding.

Company Website, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Product Marketing Intern to support technical product messaging, research, launches, and customer education across Bask Health's software platform.

This internship is designed for someone interested in the intersection of technology, software development, business, and marketing.

You'll gain hands-on experience learning how technical software capabilities are positioned, explained, and introduced to customers.

Bask Health brings together merchant tools, website creation, clinical and pharmacy workflows, AI-enabled features, analytics, and monetization capabilities.

As a Technical Product Marketing Intern, you'll help communicate how these capabilities work and what problems they solve for customers.

You'll work with product marketing and collaborate with product managers, software engineers, AI engineers, data stakeholders, sales, and customer success.

A major part of this internship will involve researching technical product functionality and translating what you learn into accurate, understandable customer-facing materials.

You'll help develop messaging for AI-enabled features, analytics tools, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, and other technical platform capabilities.

You'll learn how to distinguish between a product's technical functionality, its supported use cases, and the benefits customers can reasonably expect.

You'll assist with creating technical feature descriptions, product overviews, demonstrations, educational materials, and launch communications.

You'll work with product managers and engineers to understand new features and gather information about their functionality.

You'll help organize technical details into documents that sales, customer success, and marketing teams can use.

You'll research competing AI, analytics, automation, and technical SaaS platforms.

You'll compare how competing products communicate technical capabilities, explain use cases, and differentiate themselves.

You'll help prepare technical product launch materials, track deliverables, and coordinate feedback from relevant stakeholders.

You'll assist with customer education resources that explain how technical features can be used in practical business workflows.

You'll also help develop materials addressing common technical questions from prospective and existing customers.

You'll gain experience working with technical product documentation and learning how software integrations and data-related features are communicated.

You'll help maintain technical messaging libraries, competitive research, launch documents, and educational resources.

You'll support the review of product claims to ensure materials accurately describe available functionality.

This is especially important when communicating AI capabilities, where customers need clear explanations of system limitations, reliability, and appropriate human oversight.

Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll also learn the importance of careful communication around clinical, pharmacy, and patient-related workflows.

You'll help analyze customer feedback and product adoption information to identify opportunities for clearer technical messaging.

You'll have opportunities to contribute ideas for improving product demonstrations, feature explanations, and educational materials.

This internship provides exposure to both product marketing and technical product development without requiring you to work as a software engineer.

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how software works, asking thoughtful technical questions, and explaining complicated concepts clearly.

You should be curious, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning from engineers and other technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager: Enterprise AI Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment—whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge—with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About Trase:

Trase is AI, Uncomplicated. Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase is an end-to-end platform for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise—bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption to drive efficiency and significant cost savings.

We’re in production at Duke Health, where our agents save over 5,490 hours of clinical labor annually in a single department. We’ve raised $10.5M from Red Cell Partners and top the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. Now we’re scaling.

Senior Product Manager, Origin: Enterprise AI Platform

You'll own the product experience for the people who deploy, administer, and govern AI agents across an organization. Your job is to make it easy for customers to put agents into production, understand how they're operating, understand and accept risk, and maintain the controls and trust their business requires.

You’ll be the product manager for Trase Origin, our platform for deploying and governing AI agents. You’ll work with customers, sales and presales, GRC, and our federal team to gather requirements, then write the PRDs engineering builds from. You'll own strategy, discovery, priorities, delivery, and results.

What You Will Do

  • Understand the customer: Work directly with administrators, platform teams, and governance stakeholders. Learn how they operate, where adoption gets stuck, and which problems matter enough to solve.
  • Set direction and ship: Define the outcomes, choose what to build, and work with engineering and design to deliver it. Make clear tradeoffs, keep the scope useful, and follow through after launch.

jobs.description:
We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels heard and respected, and extending our culture of care so that every individual can reach their full potential. We want you to have a sense of belonging and feel valued for your contributions and the perspectives you bring.

Summary:

The Estimator - BESS prepares cost estimates for renewable energy and utility-owned battery energy storage systems (BESS). This role is responsible for creating accurate, cost-competitive, and timely preparation of forecasts for the Company’s Development and T&D construction businesses, to be budgeted or bid, incorporating knowledge of construction means and methods, costs, and industry principles.

Requirements:

  • Reviews and understands the content of all Request for Proposals (RFP) documents to determine the scope of work and required pricing elements for inclusion within the estimate.
  • Contributes to a team of project estimators for respective statements of work (SOWs) to prepare accurate, competitive, and timely estimates for Bid-Build and EPC (Engineer-Procure-Construct) construction Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
  • Collaborates with Opportunity Lead Estimator for additional project information, engineering support services, and deliverables as the estimate basis.
  • Receives, prioritizes, and distributes quote requests to vendors and subcontractors; analyzes responses for accuracy, completeness, and efficacy per request and project schedule milestones.
  • Uses standardized tools and processes to prepare accurate, competitive, and timely project cost and schedule estimates.
  • Completes quantity take-offs to calculate estimate quantities and units of work for Balance of Plant (BOP) and EPC self-perform utility-size BESS construction scopes of work.
  • Quantifies resources and production rates for utility-size BESS system construction.
  • Determines impacts to estimates based on local labor requirements, current commodity pricing, and client’s project specifications.
  • Identifies project risks.
  • Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
  • Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct, and Company Policies & Procedures.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.

  • Ability to complete quantity take-offs from construction plans.
  • Ability to compile indicative budgets in the absence of engineered documents.

Ability to apply varying levels of detail for both indicative and complex bid proposals.
  • Strong communication skills in subcontractor interface and negotiation.

  • Advanced communication skills with the ability to clearly describe the advantages and disadvantages of the cost related to various design options.

  • Understanding of construction industry concepts, practices, and procedures.
