jobs.title: Technical Fashion Designer
jobs.description:
Help Build the Next Chapter of Product Development at Fresh Prints

Hi, I’m Andy, the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.

Before Fresh Prints, I spent five years with a national fashion retail group in the Philippines, working my way from graphic designer to creative lead. When I joined Fresh Prints as a graphic designer in September 2024, I wanted to focus on designing again. Building a department wasn’t exactly the plan.

I was thrown into it pretty quickly. I’d expected to be designing email newsletters. Within my first month, I was in China meeting manufacturers and sourcing fabrics. Soon after, I became the first dedicated person in Product Development, figuring out how to build the function from the ground up.

Fresh Prints already had successful garments, but there was no established playbook for the department. I worked across Creative and Logistics, built our tech pack template, mapped development timelines, and brought in technical support. Together with the wider team, we expanded beyond a single supplier and launched products like our mock neck, which has sold over 40,000 units in less than two years.

I also had to learn what American college students wanted. Through our Fashion Council conversations, I learned to push past “that’s cute.” Was it the fit, fabric, or color? Would they actually buy it? Those answers shaped our products. Clear specs, careful sample reviews, and consistent follow-through helped bring them to life.

That’s what I value about working here. You can question a process, propose something better, and take responsibility for making it happen. My role grew because there was room to contribute beyond what I was hired to do.

Now, we’re looking for a Technical Fashion Designer who enjoys the technical side of bringing garments to life. Someone who cares about the details, catches inconsistencies, and thinks about how their work affects the next person in the process:

  • Can a supplier follow these specs without guessing?
  • Do the sample, tech pack, art proof, and website information agree?
  • What needs to be resolved before this moves into production?

If you enjoy solving problems, getting the details right, and seeing your work become something people wear, I’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll work closely with our Product Development Team Lead to turn product ideas and revisions into clear, accurate technical information. Your day-to-day work will include:

  • Create and update tech packs for assigned new products, existing garment revisions, and Collab or client requests, including measurements, construction details, and fabric specifications.
  • Review samples and document feedback, including QA findings, technical issues, and required revisions.
  • Check art proofs and briefs for garment accuracy, print compatibility, and production limitations.
  • Support supplier development by preparing technical specifications, reviewing supplier submissions, and coordinating follow-ups with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Keep product information accurate across technical records and website descriptions, specifications, colorways, and imagery.
  • Support new product development through tasks assigned by the Team Lead, flagging missing information, discrepancies, and potential production issues.

Your focus is to make sure other teams have complete, accurate product information they can confidently use.

Key Skills & Personal Attributes:

  • Commercial awareness and ability to execute within defined brand and market direction.
  • Advanced Adobe Illustrator skills (print design + garment CADs).
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop.
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, materials, and fit.
  • Confident English communication for factory and cross-team coordination.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong ownership of documentation and QA accuracy.

Qualifications:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in fashion design, apparel technical design, or product development.
  • Proven experience creating prints, CADs, and production-ready tech packs for apparel.
  • Experience communicating with manufacturers and managing sampling revisions.
  • Portfolio showcasing printed garments and technical design work (CADs + tech packs required).
  • Strong organization skills with clear production and timeline awareness.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Design, or a related field preferred.

Job Location: Work From Home / Remote

Working Hours: 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday

At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.

Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you’re asked to pay for a job, it’s not real.

jobs.title: Head of Strategic Communications
jobs.description:
About New_ Public

New_ Public is a nonprofit product studio that’s reimagining social media. Join us in building digital public spaces that connect people, embrace pluralism, and build community.

We are researchers, engineers, designers, and community leaders. We want more healthy, flourishing spaces on the internet. Up until now, we’ve used two main strategies to achieve this: helping local communities across America create more flourishing digital spaces and developing prototypes for digital conversation with public service media organizations.

Today, we’re leaning more into supporting the folks building products and platforms outside our walls, through our Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) program and our research into what works and what doesn’t.

We’re in this to serve, remove obstacles to power, and make life significantly better for all people — especially folks from underestimated communities — because we believe this work is essential for democracy and a flourishing society.

About the role

We are seeking a Head of Strategic Communications to join our team. In this role, you will be part of our efforts to shape the next wave of social technologies by helping people understand our work, where we’re headed, and what is possible in a world of prosocial tech.

You'll own our communications strategy, brand and narrative, and you'll switch often between the 30,000-foot view and the one-foot view. In the morning you might be deciding how we position New_ Public for the next two years. In the afternoon you might be tightening an op-ed or drafting the newsletter.

It's part strategist: working out who we need to reach, what we need them to understand, and the best ways to reach them. Part storyteller: writing and producing content that makes our work clear and memorable. And part narrative-shifter: finding creative ways (creators, media placements, leadership visibility, well-timed campaigns) to widen what people think is possible for the internet.

Right now our two most important audiences are philanthropic funders and product builders. You'll decide how to reach them and how to shape what they understand about New_ Public and our work.

We're a small team, so you won't have a comms department to execute. You'll write, produce and ship a lot yourself, working closely with colleagues across leadership, programs, and R&D — and securing additional support where you need it.

Key responsibilities

  • Own New_ Public's communications strategy: define priority audiences, what we want each one to understand and do, and the channels and tactics most likely to reach them
  • Develop our core narrative and messaging framework, including one clear, shared answer to "What is New_ Public?". Set brand and communications guidelines that keep every channel and spokesperson consistent
  • Support fundraising efforts, drive funder-facing marketing and comms, owning the development of funder decks and one-pagers and collaborating on grant materials and reports.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on positioning, reputation, and how New_ Public and its leaders show up in public
  • Help build our leaders' public profiles well beyond LinkedIn posts: op-eds, bylines, podcasts, conference talks and other chances to shape the conversation
  • Lead strategy and output for social media and friends-and-family communications and collaborate with other members of our comms team on our newsletter
  • Get creative about reach, including working with creators, partners and new formats to reach audiences we can't reach alone
  • Build relationships with reporters, pitch stories and secure media placements. Manage external PR partners when needed
  • Spot and drive opportunistic campaigns and rapid-response moments, when news in tech, AI or social media opens a door for our perspective
  • Partner on launches and big moments, such as EIR cohort announcements, R&D publications and events. Work with the Head of R&D and EIR Program Lead to turn their work into stories
  • Define what success looks like, track the right metrics, and use the data to learn what's working and adjust

About you

  • You believe in our mission and have a point of view on how communications can change what people believe technology can do for society
  • You can tell a hopeful story about the future of social media without overselling it. You ground big ideas about prosocial design in real examples and research, so builders, funders, and the public come away convinced and ready to act.”
  • You have 8+ years in communications, ideally in tech, philanthropy or mission-driven organizations, and you've owned strategy as well as execution
  • You're an excellent writer and editor who moves quickly from an idea to clear, engaging copy
  • You've pitched and worked with press, and you have the media placements to show for it
  • You have excellent communications judgment – understanding what will land with which audiences and (more importantly) what won’t
  • You've built and grown social media and newsletter audiences, and you use data to decide what's working
  • You have a current view of the media landscape, including creators, podcasts and community channels as well as traditional press
  • You use AI fluently and critically, and you’ve built AI-assisted workflows that help a small team do more without lowering the quality bar or losing the human element. (Here is our AI policy to see where we’re at with the technology)
  • You like rolling up your sleeves, you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you can prioritize without a big team behind you
  • Nice to have: relationships with reporters who cover tech, philanthropy or civic life; experience at a startup or small nonprofit; design sense and comfort with tools like Canva or Figma

More information

  • Location: United States or Canada (fully remote)
  • Compensation: $165,000 - $215,000 USD per year. This is a full-time position.
  • Reports to: Angelica Quicksey, Managing Director

The Process

  • Submission: Submit your application using the “Apply here” link below. If we are interested in pursuing your application, we may reach out to you for writing samples.
  • First Interview: After screening all applications, we will select candidates for Round 1 interviews, Those candidates will be contacted to interview with our Talent Coordinator.
  • Second Interview: Selected Round 1 candidates move forward to Round 2 of our interview process. Those candidates will be invited to interview with Angelica
  • Assignment: Following Round 2, selected candidates will be asked to complete an assignment that evaluates their technical and practical skills. Candidates will receive a $250 via Tango gift-card for completing this assignment.
  • Final Interview: Finalist candidates will have a short conversation with Eli Pariser.
  • Reference Check: After reviewing assignment submissions, we will request contact information for three (3) professional references from selected candidates. If you need time to inform your references of our upcoming outreach, please let us know!
  • Offer: We will extend an offer to the candidate who best aligns with the key criteria for this role.

We know confidence gaps can hold great candidates back — so if you’re excited about this role but don’t check every box, please apply anyway. What matters most to us is genuine interest in building healthy digital public spaces, a willingness to learn and grow, and a commitment to fostering an inclusive, respectful workplace. We especially welcome applications from people whose backgrounds and experiences are underrepresented in tech.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

About The Role

As an AI GTM Engineer, you will be the driving force behind Endor Labs’ internal AI transformation. In close coordination with the CEO & E-Staff, you will work across every non-engineering function – Sales, Marketing, Business Development, BizOps, and G&A – to identify high-impact use cases where AI agents and automation can dramatically improve productivity, speed, and quality of execution. This is not a strategy-only role; you will get your hands dirty building and shipping AI-powered workflows, from proof of concept through production deployment.

You will partner closely with department heads to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and operational bottlenecks. From there, you’ll design, build, and deploy AI agent-based solutions – leveraging platforms like Claude, Gemini, and custom integrations – that automate repetitive work, enhance decision-making, and unlock capacity across the organization.

Equally important, you’ll own the change management process: training teams, building internal champions, measuring adoption, and iterating until AI becomes a natural part of how every team operates.

If you’re energized by the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real business impact, thrive in fast-paced startup environments, and love turning ambiguity into shipped solutions, this role is for you.

How You'll Make an Impact

AI Strategy & Use Case Discovery

  • Conduct deep-dive assessments of workflows across functions to identify automation and AI augmentation opportunities.
  • Build and maintain an AI opportunity roadmap, prioritizing use cases by ROI, feasibility, and strategic value, in close partnership with department heads and the CEO.
  • Stay at the frontier of AI tooling and agent frameworks, continuously evaluating new models, platforms, and techniques to keep Endor Labs ahead of the curve.

AI Engineering & Workflow Development

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agent-based workflows and automations that solve real business problems – including multi-step agentic workflows, RAG-based knowledge systems, automated content pipelines, intelligent CRM enrichment, and more.
  • Own the full lifecycle from rapid prototyping to production-grade deployment, including monitoring, error handling, and iteration based on user feedback.
  • Integrate AI solutions with existing tools and systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, internal databases) to create seamless, end-to-end workflows.

Change Management & Adoption

  • Design and execute a comprehensive change management strategy to drive AI adoption across the organization, from executive alignment to individual contributor enablement.
  • Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and hands-on enablement sessions tailored to each department’s specific AI use cases and skill levels.
  • Identify and cultivate AI champions within each team to accelerate grassroots adoption and create a culture of AI-first thinking.
  • Track adoption metrics, gather feedback, and iterate on both the tools and the training to ensure sustained, meaningful usage.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 5+ years of experience in a combination of software engineering, data science, AI/ML engineering, or technical operations.
  • Proven ability to build and ship AI-powered solutions in a business context – not just research or prototypes, but production systems that real teams use daily.
  • Deep understanding of go-to-market operations, including Sales, Marketing, BD, and BizOps workflows. You know what an enterprise sales cycle looks like, understand pipeline mechanics, and can identify where AI can have the highest leverage.
  • Strong change management instincts – you understand that deploying AI tools is only half the battle; driving adoption, building trust, and shifting behaviors is where the real impact comes from.
  • A “builder” mindset with startup DNA – you’re energized by ambiguity, move fast, and prefer shipping imperfect solutions and iterating over waiting for perfection.

What We Offer You

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans.
  • 401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.
  • Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)
  • Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.
  • A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Malta

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Malta. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

jobs.title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, C
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Croatia

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Croatia. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

jobs.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent—technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Your Role

As a Product Manager for Rights & Royalties Modernization at WMG, you will own new platforms that define who owns what, and who is owed what, across one of the largest music catalogs in the world. Every stream, sync deal, and payout depends on accurate rights data and deal performance calculation. In this role, you will use modern, AI-enabled platforms to replace legacy royalty and accounting processes and to improve how we manage our global rights portfolio and pay our artists. You will shape the strategy, roadmap, and organizational change needed for how WMG captures, validates, and activates rights across our recorded music catalog, so music reaches fans and everyone gets paid accurately and on time.

What you'll do

  • Product Ownership: Own the roadmap, both tactical and strategic, for your area. Communicate priorities clearly to engineering, business stakeholders, and leadership.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX design, finance, accounting, legal, business affairs, and label operations stakeholders to turn complex contractual rules into clear, scalable software.

  • Rights & Royalties Data Management: Build new products that capture and maintain ownership splits, territorial rights, terms, and more at a global scale, and then use these contractual terms to automate financial tracking and artist payouts, replacing legacy tools and processes with scalable, auditable systems.

  • User Understanding: Develop a deep understanding of your users across business affairs, copyright administration, A&R, and finance, then design tools that remove manual work from their day.

  • Data-Driven Decisions: Define and track KPIs around rights (e.g. data accuracy, completeness) and royalties (e.g. time-to-pay, calculation accuracy).

Who you are

  • Product Experience: At least 7 years of product management or equivalent experience, including building technical products from idea to launch.

  • Music, Rights or Royalties Expertise: You have hands-on experience with music rights and royalties (e.g. royalty accounting, licensing, rights management). We'll also consider strong candidates with deep experience in music, or in accounting and finance systems.

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable working with engineers on data models, APIs, and system integrations. You understand the software development lifecycle and can go deep on complex data problems.

  • Navigating Ambiguity: Proven ability to simplify complex business rules and competing stakeholder needs into clear product decisions.

  • Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain rights concepts to technical teams and technical tradeoffs to business partners and executives.

  • Passion: A genuine love for music and a respect for the artists and songwriters behind it.

We'd love it if you also had

    • Experience with rights or royalty systems at a label, publisher, collecting society, or DSP

    • Experience interfacing with ERP systems like SAP or Oracle

    • Experience building master data or source-of-truth platforms

    • Experience using AI tools in a hands-on way to rapidly iterate and build products

    • Knowledge of key industry concepts (e.g. identifiers like ISRCs, common recording deal structures, neighboring rights and digital performance royalties)

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

Our client is building the software that hearing clinics run on patient records, bookings, hearing tests and sales. Clinic chains and hospitals use it every day. You join the team that owns the Sales domain: quote, invoice, insurance claim and payment. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who ships business outcomes, not just tickets. You own features end to end - from why a clinic needs them, through design and build, to checking in production that they worked. AI coding agents are a normal part of every step of your work.

Tech environment:C# / .NET 8.0, Azure Services (Azure SQL, AI Search, Service Bus, App Insights, Data Factory), Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, MassTransit, React with TypeScript, plus growing use of Python for AI tooling and experimentation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Design, build and run full-stack features in the Sales domain: .NET services, event-driven integrations and React front end.

  • Work with the Product Owner and QA from discovery onwards. Shape the spec and agree acceptance criteria before code is written.

  • Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.

  • Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.

  • Own quality: unit and integration tests, code review, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, observability) as part of the design.

  • Follow features into production: watch telemetry and usage, support releases, investigate incidents and close the loop with the product team.

  • Contribute to architecture discussions and decision records with the Tech Lead and architects and help pay down tech debt in the sales flows.

  • Make the team better at AI: mentor engineers and share the instructions, checks and small tools that work.

Product Mindset

As AI takes on more of the typing, the value of an engineer moves to judgement: knowing what to build, why, and what good looks like for the user. In this role you:

  • Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.

  • Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.

  • Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.

  • Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:

    • Core and Web APIs.

    • Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.

    • Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.

  • Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.

  • Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:

    • Azure Service Bus.

    • MassTransit.

    • Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.

  • Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.

  • Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:

    • Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.

    • Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.

    • Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.

  • Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.

  • Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.

  • AKS / Kubernetes.

  • You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

  • Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

  • Technical Interview:Depending on the position, you may complete a technical assessment or test task.

  • Client's Interviews: 2 rounds

  • Final Decision:After all steps, we’ll get back to you with the result and next steps.

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Clinical Training Support Specialist plays a vital supportive role in designing and managing high-quality onboarding and clinical training across the entire Included Health Clinical Practice/Clinical Org practice—spanning Virtual Care, Population Health, and emerging service lines. Your primary focus will be on instructional design, transforming complex clinical policies and workflows into engaging digital learning content (eLearning modules, video simulations, and interactive scenarios). As a core pillar of the training team, you will manage our Learning Management System (LMS), collect and analyze training data, and act as a dedicated learner assistant to ensure seamless educational rollouts.

While your primary focus is content creation and support, you will also assist in cross-covering live training sessions for various onboarding cohorts. You will be an AI-forward builder who uses AI tools and other technologies to accelerate content development, reduce manual work, and embed just-in-time support into the clinician experience. This role is ideal for an instructional design professional who excels at behind-the-scenes content creation and LMS administration, yet remains flexible enough to step into the room to support live learners and educators when needed.

Responsibilities:

1. Content Creation, Execution & Maintenance

  • Prepare, use, and update existing training materials (slides, facilitator guides, job aids, scenarios, and exercises) created and/or approved by the Senior Clinical Training Specialists, Manager, and CKE team.
  • Surface content gaps or inconsistencies you see during training (e.g., slide doesn’t match CRC, workflow screenshot is outdated) so they can be prioritized for formal updates.
  • Use LMS and training tools at a proficient user level (launching sessions, tracking completions, pulling basic reports).
  • Design instruction based on clinical workflows in collaboration with CKE team and stakeholders.

2. Cross-Service Line Clinical Facilitation

  • Deliver live virtual training (group sessions, small-group breakouts, and 1:1 coaching) for clinical new hires and tenured clinicians across Virtual Care and Population Health service lines.
  • Facilitate a mix of foundational, workflow, and application-based sessions (e.g., documentation practice, care plan workflows, triage scenarios, navigation workflows) using adult learning best practices.
  • Support or co-lead clinical simulations, mock calls, and role plays, observing performance, giving clear, behavior-based feedback, and escalating clinical safety concerns appropriately.
  • Flex into different service lines as hiring volume, redesign work, or audit findings shift the training portfolio — maintaining sufficient cross-training to be safe and effective wherever you are deployed.

3. Cohort Support & Learner Coaching

  • Partner with the Senior Clinical Training Specialists to execute the day-to-day plan for new hire cohorts (agenda, timing, logistics, handoff points).
  • Monitor learner engagement, participation, and performance during sessions; identify individuals who need additional support and provide targeted coaching or remediation as directed by the Senior(s) and Manager.
  • Use rubrics, checklists, and competency tools to document learner progress and escalate concerns regarding readiness for independent work.
  • Contribute to a psychologically safe learning environment where clinicians can practice, make mistakes, and receive direct but supportive feedback.

4. Data, Feedback, and Continuous Improvement

  • Capture and share learner feedback, questions, and pain points from the classroom in a structured way to inform curriculum improvements and service-line decisions.
  • Create and monitor formal metrics for learning and successful application of skills.
  • Use available data (e.g., knowledge checks, simulation scores, survey results) to describe trends you’re seeing in learner performance and experience, and to validate where additional coaching or clarification is needed.
  • Participate in course audits, pilots, and retrospectives, giving concrete recommendations on pacing, activities, and scaffolding from the trainer perspective.
  • Champion a “Spirit of Inquiry” by modeling curiosity, evidence-based practice, and openness to feedback in your own facilitation.

5. Surge Support & Operational Flex

  • During surge periods or large cohorts, act as co-facilitator/producer, managing breakout rooms, chat questions, tech issues, and basic operational workflows so Senior Trainers can focus on high-complexity clinical teaching and stakeholder interactions.
  • Lead or co-lead baseline operational sessions (e.g., navigation of training environments, structured documentation practice, non-clinical workflows) when appropriate to free up Senior bandwidth.
  • Adhere to and reinforce capacity rules and surge protocols defined by the Manager and Senior Trainers (e.g., ratio rules, blackout dates, backup facilitator coverage).

Required Qualifications:

Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in formal clinical/healthcare training, precepting, clinical education, or adult learning.
  • Specifically, instructional design, LMS management, data collection, learner assistance, etc.

Facilitation & communication:

  • Strong virtual facilitation skills (Zoom/Google Meet or similar).
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical workflows in clear, practical language and to give direct, respectful feedback to peers or learners.

Collaboration & adaptability:

  • Comfortable flexing between service lines, cohorts, and workstreams as priorities change.
  • Proven ability to build trust with clinicians, people leaders, and cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Clinical credentials: RN/BSN or other equivalent clinical degree with an active, unrestricted license (or able to reactivate an expired license, if applicable).
  • Experience in one or more of Included Health’s core clinical environments (e.g., Urgent Care, Behavioral Health, Virtual Primary Care, Care Management, Triage, Navigation).
  • Familiarity with Athena or similar EHR.
  • Exposure to instructional design principles (e.g., ADDIE, flipped classroom, scaffolding).
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-change or virtual-first environment, comfortable iterating based on feedback and data.
The salary range for this full time position is $67,850.00 - $94,000.00 + equity + benefits. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal pay band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C).

For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in higher-cost Zone D markets (e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured pay bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

Benefits & Perks:

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

Your recruiter will share more about the salary range and benefits package for your role during the hiring process.

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. jobs.title: Head of Merchant Growth & Retention
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, merchant growth and retention start with understanding the businesses behind our customer accounts. We value people who know how online merchants operate, recognize what drives long-term customer relationships, and build teams that help entrepreneurs succeed while supporting sustainable business growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Merchant Growth & Retention to lead Bask Health's merchant retention strategy, develop opportunities for existing account growth, and build a customer success organization that supports long-term merchant relationships.

This role combines merchant success leadership, commercial account strategy, customer retention, and operational execution.

You'll be responsible for helping merchants achieve value from Bask Health while improving customer retention and identifying appropriate opportunities to expand existing relationships.

Our merchants include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce operations, online storefronts, merchant economics, and the challenges entrepreneurs face when building and scaling businesses.

You'll develop a merchant growth and retention strategy that aligns customer needs with Bask Health's broader business objectives.

You'll define how the team approaches merchant onboarding, adoption, engagement, renewals, retention, and account expansion.

You'll establish processes for understanding each merchant's business goals, platform usage, operational challenges, and potential growth opportunities.

You'll help the team recognize when merchants are successfully adopting the platform and when they may need additional support.

You'll develop proactive strategies for identifying merchants at risk of leaving or reducing their engagement.

You'll establish customer health monitoring practices that provide visibility into merchant retention risks.

You'll work with customer success managers to ensure merchant goals, account priorities, and growth opportunities are clearly documented.

You'll establish expectations for proactive merchant communication, account planning, and follow-through.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer success team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll help team members strengthen their commercial judgment, merchant relationship management, renewal preparation, and account growth skills.

You'll build a team culture that values initiative, accountability, and a practical understanding of merchant businesses.

You'll work with leadership to establish merchant segmentation and account coverage strategies.

You'll help determine how resources should be allocated across strategic merchants, growing businesses, and smaller accounts.

You'll develop performance metrics and reporting practices for merchant growth and retention.

You'll monitor relevant indicators such as merchant churn, gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, renewals, expansion, and product adoption.

You'll establish processes for understanding why merchants leave and identifying recurring causes of churn.

You'll analyze merchant feedback, account engagement, and operational patterns to recommend improvements.

You'll create proactive retention strategies for merchants experiencing dissatisfaction, technical problems, or declining engagement.

You'll oversee important merchant escalations that may affect retention or long-term account value.

You'll build relationships with strategic merchant stakeholders, including founders, executives, and business owners.

You'll participate in high-priority merchant conversations when leadership involvement can help strengthen relationships or address concerns.

You'll guide the team in conducting business reviews focused on merchant goals, platform adoption, business progress, and opportunities for growth.

You'll work closely with sales leadership to coordinate renewal preparation and account expansion opportunities.

You'll establish clear responsibilities between merchant success and sales for identifying, qualifying, and pursuing expansion opportunities.

You'll help ensure commercial conversations are grounded in merchant needs and supported platform capabilities.

You'll identify opportunities for merchants to adopt additional features or expand their use of Bask Health when those capabilities support their business goals.

You'll collaborate with product and engineering teams to address recurring issues that affect merchant satisfaction, adoption, and retention.

You'll communicate merchant feedback, product limitations, and e-commerce-related workflow challenges to the appropriate internal teams.

You'll work with technical support and customer success engineering teams to address technical problems that create churn risk.

You'll help identify recurring implementation challenges that prevent merchants from successfully launching or operating their businesses.

You'll support improvements to merchant onboarding, platform education, and implementation handoffs.

You'll ensure the customer success team understands how Bask Health's capabilities support different merchant business models.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll help the team connect these capabilities to practical merchant needs without promising unsupported functionality.

You'll establish clear processes for recognizing when merchant requests require technical, clinical, pharmacy, or compliance expertise.

You'll coordinate with authorized teams when issues involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll ensure merchant-facing processes follow appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling requirements.

You'll develop scalable merchant retention and expansion playbooks.

You'll evaluate customer success tools, workflows, and reporting systems to identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll create consistent processes for tracking merchant renewals, retention risks, expansion opportunities, and customer commitments.

You'll collaborate with leadership on organizational planning, staffing needs, and team development.

You'll participate in hiring and evaluating customer success talent as needed.

You'll establish performance coaching and professional development practices that reinforce strong merchant account management and commercial execution.

You'll help create effective collaboration between customer success, sales, product, engineering, and technical support teams.

You'll work directly with company leadership to communicate merchant growth performance, retention trends, and emerging risks.

You'll provide recommendations for improving recurring-revenue performance through stronger post-sale merchant engagement.

You'll balance merchant advocacy with commercial priorities and operational realities.

You'll develop strategies that strengthen long-term merchant relationships while supporting responsible revenue growth.

We're looking for a leader with substantial post-sale customer success experience, proven team management ability, and meaningful recent e-commerce experience.

You should understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate and how retention, expansion, and account growth contribute to long-term company performance.

You'll need to be comfortable building processes, coaching teams, managing strategic merchant relationships, and making data-informed commercial decisions.

Success in this role means improving merchant retention, reducing preventable churn, increasing appropriate account expansion, and building a merchant success organization that contributes directly to Bask Health's long-term growth.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Bask Health's merchant growth and retention strategy.
  • Develop scalable processes for merchant renewals, retention, and expansion.
  • Establish merchant health monitoring and churn-risk identification practices.
  • Build proactive strategies to reduce preventable merchant churn.
  • Lead and coach customer success team members within the approved organization.
  • Establish clear expectations for merchant account ownership and commercial accountability.
  • Develop merchant segmentation and account coverage strategies.
  • Monitor merchant retention, churn, renewals, and expansion performance.
  • Track gross revenue retention and net revenue retention where applicable.
  • Establish merchant growth and retention reporting practices.
  • Analyze recurring causes of merchant churn and recommend improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen merchant engagement and product adoption.
  • Oversee strategic merchant relationships and executive-level engagements.
  • Guide customer success managers in conducting merchant business reviews and renewal discussions.
  • Support appropriate merchant account expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with sales on merchant growth and expansion strategies.
  • Establish clear handoffs between merchant success and sales.
  • Work with product and engineering on issues affecting merchant retention.

  • Improve merchant success tools, workflows, and documentation.

  • Take ownership of the merchant success function's retention and expansion effectiveness.

Benefits

  • 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, client services, or a closely related post-sale customer-facing function.

  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce businesses, online merchants, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business models, direct-to-consumer operations, and merchant needs.
  • Experience developing merchant retention and account growth strategies.
  • Proven ability to lead merchant onboarding, adoption, renewal, retention, and expansion initiatives.
  • Experience creating processes for identifying and reducing customer churn.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and evaluate customer-facing employees.
  • Experience establishing customer success performance metrics and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of customer retention, churn, account health, and renewal performance.
  • Familiarity with gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and recurring-revenue metrics.
  • Experience developing strategies for improving long-term merchant engagement.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting expansion opportunities within existing customer accounts.
  • Strong commercial judgment and understanding of recurring-revenue SaaS businesses.
  • Experience managing relationships with founders, executives, and senior merchant stakeholders.

  • Experience handling complex customer escalations and retention risks.
  • Experience collaborating with sales, product, engineering, and company leadership.
  • Ability to translate merchant feedback into operational and product recommendations.
  • Experience building merchant retention and account management playbooks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present retention and account growth performance to leadership.
  • Strong analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading customer success or account growth at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Experience managing customer success teams serving Shopify merchants.

  • Experience managing enterprise merchant relationships.
  • Experience improving gross revenue retention and net revenue retention.
  • Experience developing churn prediction and customer health scoring processes.
  • Experience creating renewal forecasting and retention reporting.
  • Experience designing account expansion and upsell processes.
  • Experience collaborating with sales on expansion opportunities.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing merchant segmentation and account assignment models.
  • Experience building customer success teams during periods of growth.
  • Experience leading cross-functional merchant retention initiatives.
  • Experience developing merchant lifecycle and engagement strategies.
  • Experience improving technical onboarding and implementation handoffs.
  • Familiarity with online storefront, checkout, and payment workflows.
  • Experience supporting healthcare technology or telehealth businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders and senior company leadership.

jobs.title: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Luxembourg
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Luxembourg

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Luxembourg. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Technical Writer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Technical Writer will develop and maintain clear, accurate, and accessible documentation that enables VA customers and technical teams to effectively use and support the Summit Data Platform.

This position will work closely with engineers, product teams, and customer enablement specialists to translate complex technical information into practical user guidance, operational procedures, and training materials. Documentation will reflect actual Summit configurations, approved processes, and available capabilities.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop, edit, and maintain technical documentation, including user guides, administrator guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), quick reference guides, and troubleshooting materials.

  • Create customer-facing documentation that explains Summit platform capabilities, available services, access procedures, and common user workflows.

  • Collaborate with data engineers, cloud architects, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) specialists, and other subject matter experts to document technical configurations, processes, and system functionality.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding materials, tutorials, frequently asked questions, and knowledge base articles that support customer adoption and self-service.

  • Document data ingestion processes, data access procedures, governance requirements, and platform operations in coordination with responsible technical teams.

  • Support development of training presentations, exercises, demonstrations, and other instructional materials for Summit customers and support personnel.

  • Review and update documentation following platform releases, configuration changes, process improvements, and changes to approved services.

  • Establish and maintain documentation templates, style standards, version controls, and review processes to promote consistency and accuracy.

  • Validate technical content with subject matter experts and incorporate stakeholder feedback before publication.

  • Organize and maintaindocumentation repositories to ensure materials are current, searchable, accessible, and appropriately controlled.

  • Collaborate with customer support and enablement teams to identify recurring questions, documentation gaps, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

  • Support preparation of technical reports, operational summaries, release notes, and other Government-required documentation.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Technical Communication, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • Four or more years of professional experience developing technical documentation for enterprise software, information technology systems, or cloud-based platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate documentation.

  • Experience developing user guides, SOPs, technical procedures, training materials, and knowledge base content.

  • Experience collaborating with engineers, developers, and technical subject matter experts to gather, validate, and organize information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and other commonly used documentation and collaboration tools.

  • Experience maintaining documentation standards, version control, and structured review and approval processes.

  • Ability to organize and manage multiple documentation assignments while meeting established deadlines.

  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, interviewing, and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.

  • The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal agency information technology modernization initiatives.

  • Experience documenting Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, cloud data platforms, or enterprise analytics solutions.

  • Familiarity with data engineering, data governance, AI/ML, and cloud computing concepts.

  • Experience developing technical documentation and instructional content for users with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Experience using documentation platforms such as Confluence, Git-based repositories, or comparable knowledge management systems.

  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements and experience producing accessible federal documentation.

  • Experience supporting customer onboarding, technical training, or enterprise technology adoption programs.

  • Certified Professional Technical Communicator (CPTC) or comparable technical writing certification.

Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement

jobs.title: Vice President, IT Service Management
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

About Live Nation Entertainment

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s largest live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. With 550 million fans and operations in over 40 countries, somewhere in the world every 18 minutes a Live Nation Entertainment event takes place. We manage some of the world’s biggest artists, produce some iconic music festivals, oversee world leading venues and, through Ticketmaster, operate one of the largest ecommerce sites. For additional information, visit . Our Global IT function is a critical enabler of this operation, delivering technology infrastructure, enterprise services, and innovation across every region we operate in.

Job Purpose

The VP, IT Service Management is a senior global leadership role within Live Nation's Global IT organisation, accountable for the strategy, delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of IT service management across all Live Nation Entertainment businesses globally.

Reporting to the SVP / Global Head of IT Operations, this role owns the global service management operating model supporting approximately 25,000 employees and a diverse portfolio of corporate offices, venues, and business operations.

The role has end-to-end accountability for global Service Desks and Tier 1 / Tier 2 support, ITSM processes and platforms, end-user technology, IT asset management, workplace technology, and the employee technology lifecycle. A key priority is to modernise service delivery through AI, automation, self-service, standardisation, strong operational governance, and a relentless focus on employee experience.

Role Description

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive global IT Service Management capability improvement roadmap that aligns with Live Nation's business objectives and incorporates disaster recovery & business continuity goals.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to identify and prioritize technology initiatives that drive growth and efficiency.
  • Envision and implement AI-native practices and tools to drive effectiveness and delivery throughput
  • Implement frameworks and ways of working to ensure regulatory compliance across all technology domains.​
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreements (SLAs), and other metrics to track performance.
  • Own budget management for the function, including forecasting, cost optimization, vendor spend, and capital expenditure planning across security, cloud, and third-party contracts

Global IT Service Management Leadership & Service Excellence

  • Own the global IT Service Management strategy, operating model, roadmap, standards, and governance across all Live Nation Entertainment businesses.
  • Lead global Service Desk and Tier 1 / Tier 2 support services, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across regions, businesses, offices, and venues.
  • Define and govern global service levels, KPIs, CSAT, operational performance, service quality, and continuous improvement programmes.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for major service issues and business-impacting support challenges, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and resolution.

ITSM Processes, Governance & Platforms

  • Own and mature core IT Service Management disciplines globally, including Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalogue, and Configuration Management.
  • Establish consistent global processes, controls, reporting, and governance aligned to ITIL principles and Live Nation standards.
  • Drive adoption, optimisation, and governance of ITSM platforms and tooling, ensuring they enable efficient workflows, accurate reporting, and a strong employee experience.
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Applications, and business technology teams to ensure service management processes support operational resilience, security, and compliance.

AI, Automation & Service Transformation

  • Lead the strategy and adoption of AI, automation, self-service, and digital support capabilities across IT Service Management and Service Desk operations.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activity, improve ticket deflection, accelerate resolution, and increase employee self-service.
  • Develop a data-led service improvement roadmap using service analytics, trends, employee feedback, and operational insights.
  • Drive standardisation and simplification across global support services while recognising appropriate business and regional requirements.

End-User Technology & Employee Lifecycle Management

  • Own the global operational service for desktop and end-user technology, including Windows and Mac environments, endpoint support, peripherals, and associated workplace technologies.
  • Ensure effective technology onboarding, offboarding, moves, adds, and changes for employees globally, with clear standards and a consistent employee experience.
  • Partner with engineering and security teams to ensure end-user devices remain secure, current, supportable, and aligned to enterprise technology standards.

IT Asset Management and Workplace Technology

  • Own global IT Asset Management processes covering the lifecycle, inventory, control, deployment, recovery, and disposal of end-user technology assets.
  • Oversee operational technology services within office locations, including office networking, Wi-Fi, meeting room technology, AV/VC, printers, and related workplace services.
  • Lead IT service delivery for office openings, relocations, expansions, moves, and changes, coordinating effectively with Real Estate, Facilities, business teams, and technology partners.
  • Manage office networking technologies, including observability, lifecycle refresh programmes, standards, and compliance, ensuring resilient, secure, and consistently managed services across the global office estate.
  • Drive vendor performance, commercial discipline, asset optimisation, and standardisation across workplace and support services.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential

  • Significant senior IT Service Management and IT Operations leadership experience within a large, complex, multi-site global organisation.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale global Service Desk, Tier 1 / Tier 2, end-user computing, and workplace technology services.
  • Deep knowledge of ITSM and ITIL disciplines, including Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalogue, and service-level management.
  • Demonstrable experience transforming IT support through AI, automation, self-service, service analytics, and process optimisation.
  • Strong experience of enterprise end-user technology environments, including Windows, Mac, endpoint services, office networking, AV/VC, printers, and workplace technology.
  • Experience owning IT Asset Management and employee technology lifecycle processes at enterprise scale.
  • Strong commercial and vendor management experience, including budget ownership, contract performance, cost optimisation, and outsourced or managed service partners.

Desirable

  • Experience working within a de-centralized IT organization
  • CISSP, CISM, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent professional certifications.
  • MBA or equivalent business qualification.
  • Experience working within a large, publicly listed organization.

Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Exceptional global leadership and stakeholder management skills, able to engage credibly from Service Desk teams through to C-suite executives and business leaders.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to translate service performance, technology issues, and transformation priorities into clear business outcomes.
  • Highly organised and comfortable leading multiple global services, priorities, vendors, and transformation initiatives simultaneously.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing geographically dispersed teams.
  • Data-driven and commercially minded, with a strong focus on employee experience, value delivery, cost discipline, and measurable operational performance.
  • Resilient and decisive under pressure, particularly during major incidents, service disruptions, and high-profile business escalations.
  • Passionate about simplification, standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Genuine passion for technology and service excellence as enablers of employee productivity and business growth.

Live Nation Entertainment is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

$243,000.00 USD - $304,000.00 USD
