jobs.title: City Manager, Atlanta
jobs.description:
Flex is building AI-native financial services for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

We're seeking an ambitious problem solver with a record of achievement on an exponential trajectory.

As City Manager, you'll lead Flex's growth in Atlanta. You know the business owners, the culture, and which rooms matter. Your job is to turn that into new Flex customers.

You'll build a target list of 50 business owners you'd most like to bring to Flex. From that list, you'll identify five North Star accounts; the high-priority relationships that could have a meaningful impact on Flex's growth and visibility in your market.

Your job is to develop a strategy for reaching those owners, building relationships, and ultimately bringing their businesses onto Flex. Some opportunities will move quickly, while others will take time. You'll also build relationships within their networks, creating additional opportunities for customer acquisition.

You'll take ownership of these relationships from the first conversation through conversion, working with our sales and industry teams to move opportunities forward.

You'll work closely with teams across Flex, including sales, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership, plus City Managers in other markets. Your city is yours to run, with a team behind you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the city’s dream list of 50 owners, prioritizing five North Star accounts and identifying the best path to each.
  • Curate rooms built around the people on your list: Plan and host events that bring the right people together, including intimate dinners, customer gatherings, and strategic brand activations.
  • Develop relationships with prospective customers and guide them from initial conversations through account opening, staying involved as their businesses grow with Flex.
  • Evaluate and negotiate sponsorships and memberships, and only say yes to the ones that put you in front of people on the list.
  • Develop a monthly market plan covering your priority accounts, upcoming initiatives, and progress toward customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to move opportunities forward, generate customer referrals, and share insights from your market.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline, track applications and referrals, coordinate events, and manage your local budget.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Your 50 are written, your five are picked, your first rooms have happened and you’re in real conversations with your North Star accounts.

First year: Your North Star accounts are on Flex, the customers you brought in are active and spending, and people around the city are sending you introductions without being asked.

Above all, we care about results: accounts closed and how they use Flex once they’re open. Plenty of great customers will come from outside your list, and those count too.

Requirements

  • Strong relationships with your city’s business owners. You could write the dream list this week and say how you know each person on it.
  • A track record in sales or business development, in financial services, private banking, real estate, hospitality, membership clubs, or another relationship-driven business. You’re comfortable asking for the business and closing.
  • A pulse on your city: the restaurant everyone’s talking about this month, the best rooftop, where to take someone for a serious cocktail. People trust your taste.
  • An eye for design: venue, event flow, how a space photographs, and the details, like menu cards and table settings, that make something memorable.
  • The ability to spot the right opportunities, build a strategy to pursue them, and stay organized throughout.
  • A competitive streak, and the judgment to know when bringing in a teammate helps close the deal. You make calls the way the CEO of Flex would, with the company’s interest first.
  • Currently based in Atlanta.

Nice to Haves

  • Bilingual skills, which may be preferred or required depending on the market.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Engagement)
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, our mission is to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions so people can move forward with confidence. We’re building a team of exceptional Nerds in an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re encouraged to grow, take smart risks, and be yourself. Whether you work remotely or in an office, we support how you thrive and invest in your well-being, development, and impact.

NerdWallet’s Engagement team helps millions of people take real action with their finances, tracking spending, monitoring credit, building net worth, and discovering the right financial products at the right moment. We’re now in the early stages of an AI-native transformation, shifting from traditional design-and-handoff workflows toward a model where design, prototyping, and even deployment are deeply augmented by AI.

As a Senior Product Designer on the Engagement team, you’ll own end-to-end design for one or more product pods, shaping the user experiences that bring people back to NerdWallet and help them make smarter financial decisions. You’ll work at the intersection of user needs, business outcomes, and technical possibility, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver high-quality experiences with speed.

This is an opportunity to help define what design looks like on an AI-native team, one of the most exciting and consequential design challenges happening right now in consumer tech.

This role reports to the VP, Product and Design.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Shape financial lives at scale. Your designs will be seen and used by millions of people navigating real financial decisions — from checking their credit score and managing debt, to managing budget, savings, and investments.

  • Help define AI-native design. You’ll be an early architect of how design works in an AI-native product team, influencing practice well beyond your own pod.

  • Set the design bar. At Senior level, your craft and working style create a visible standard for the broader design organization.

  • Own the product conversation. Embedded in a cross-functional pod, you’ll have direct influence on what gets built and why — not just how it looks.

  • Advance your skills in a fast-moving environment. You’ll gain experience designing AI-powered features, working with real consumer data, and iterating with speed in a high-impact product area.

What you’ll do:

  • Define a design vision that balances user needs with engagement and monetization goals, developing end-to-end journeys with a systems mindset. Partner with Product to shape roadmap priorities and advocate for the user based on industry trends and competitive insight.

  • Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate ideation and prototype AI-driven experiences — including personalized recommendations, conversational interfaces, and adaptive content. Help evolve the team’s design workflow in an AI-native development model.

  • Deliver production-ready designs at pace, contributing to NerdWallet’s design system through reusable components. Maintain a high bar for quality across iOS, Android, and mobile web, iterating on qualitative and quantitative signals.

  • Partner with PMs, Engineers, and Analysts on usability tests and concept validation, and use analytics, funnel data, and A/B results to evaluate decisions and identify opportunities. Translate ambiguous problems into clearly framed design challenges with measurable success criteria.

  • Build strong relationships across Engineering, Product, QA, and Marketing. Communicate design decisions through well-crafted artifacts and presentations, and actively contribute to a culture of critique and continuous improvement across the design organization.

Your experience:

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and fast-paced environments where the problem definition is still evolving

Where:

  • We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist (DTC / eCommerce)
jobs.description:
Every role in our company exists to drive measurable impact.

We are looking for individuals who take ownership, operate with urgency, and think in terms of results. You will be trusted with responsibility and expected to deliver against clear performance metrics.

Full-time · Remote · 7000 - 10,000 base compensation + uncapped performance compensation equivalent to 1–2% of ad spend

About the Company

We’re 115 Ventures, a fast-growing e-commerce group building and scaling consumer brands:

  • TrySpartan — Men’s grooming, hair-growth and beard-care products

  • FurLife — Pet health and wellness products

About the Role

We’re looking for a commercially minded Senior Creative Strategist who can turn customer research, market insights and performance data into winning paid-social ads.

You will own the creative strategy cycle—from research and concept development through briefing, production feedback, performance analysis and iteration.

This is not simply a scriptwriting role. We need someone who understands why ads win, why they fail and how to turn those insights into better creative.

  • You avoid performance data or commercial accountability

  • Customer psychology and buying behavior

  • Independent decision-making and ownership

  • You produce clear, research-backed scripts and briefs

After 60 Days

  • You independently manage the strategy for assigned campaigns

  • Your work produces winning ads or commercially useful learnings

How Performance Will Be Measured

Important Notice

Our Hiring Process

We run a structured, performance-focused hiring process designed to assess real capability and mutual fit.

jobs.title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
jobs.candidate_required_location: Czechia,  Denmark,  France,  Germany,  Ireland,  Italy,  Netherlands,  Poland,  Portugal,  Romania,  Spain,  Sweden,  UK
jobs.description:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

jobs.title: Financial Products General Ledger Team Lead
jobs.description:

Sofia, Bulgaria | Permanent, office-first

The Financial Products General Ledger (FGL) team sits at the strategic core of SumUp's financial operations. We own the financial integrity of SumUp's financial products (payment services, issuance of electronic money), ensuring every euro of revenue and cost from our payments, merchant business accounts, banking and cash advance lending products is accurately captured, reconciled and reported.

As SumUp scales, our work has become highly analytical and data-driven. We combine deep accounting knowledge with SQL, AI-assisted reconciliation tools and advanced data analytics to understand not just what was recorded, but why and how our business operates financially. You'll thrive here if you want to understand how the business works, not just record what happened.

This leadership role is the owner of the European FGL team. You will lead a team of 6 people, own the quality and timeliness of the e-money and PSP close, and drive the automation and controls that will support our IPO-readiness.

What you'll do

  • Lead the team of 6 accountants, setting clear expectations, priorities and workload distribution.
  • Coach team members on complex reconciliations, accounting judgment calls and month-end routines, supporting their professional growth and fostering a culture of precision, curiosity and continuous improvement.
  • Work on subject matter that covers the core activities of regulated business in the fintech industry: payment processing, issuance of electronic money and cash advances, characterized by complex financial transactions and big data sets.
  • Map the accounting flow for new products and ensure correct treatment before launch.
  • Lead the audit and year-end close readiness, with timely responses to auditors.
  • Own the documentation and continuous improvement of process governance (Desktop Procedures, Process Maps), internal control systems and key performance indicators.

jobs.title: KYB Operations Lead, UK
jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is scaling fast in the UK. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards UK and EU businesses across Ramp’s own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We’re a small team of specialists that runs on frontier AI tooling. Everyone builds and maintains their own automations and apps, and we’ve taken daily processes from hours to minutes. We’re hiring a senior UK KYB expert to raise the bar on how we onboard UK businesses. You’ll work the hardest cases and make the final first-line call, own escalations with our partners, keep the UK queue moving, and build the fixes that stop the same problems coming back. This is a hands-on role for someone who would rather redesign a broken requirement than work around it, and who is as comfortable in a difficult ownership structure as in the data on why cases get stuck.

What You'll Do

  • Work the hardest UK onboarding cases yourself and make the final first-line (1LoD) call: complex ownership structures, EDD, PEP and adverse-media outcomes, and anything that needs judgement rather than a checklist

  • Keep the UK queue moving: spot what’s stuck, decide what matters most, and pick up cases yourself through leave and spikes in volume

  • Be the senior expert the UK team leans on: share your reasoning on hard cases, raise the bar on decisions, and help everyone get better at building as well as reviewing

  • Own escalations with our card-issuing and payments partners, including recurring failures, disputed or unnecessary requirements, and turning each fix into a repeatable playbook

  • Set the standard for customer-facing onboarding communications: clear requests, fast follow-ups, no avoidable back-and-forth

  • Build fixes, not workarounds: automate your own work with AI, and work with Product and Engineering to remove requirements customers shouldn’t have to meet twice

  • Define and track operational metrics (caseload by provider, time to close, handling time) and use them to decide what to fix next

  • Write consistent, evidenced 1LoD decision standards that hold up to partner sample reviews and second-line scrutiny

What You Need

  • 5+ years in KYB / onboarding / financial-crime operations at a UK fintech, EMI, PI or bank

  • Practical working knowledge of the UK regulatory framework for EMIs/PIs: MLRs 2017, JMLSG guidance, and FCA expectations for customer due diligence

  • Strong judgement on complex business customers: multi-layer ownership, overseas parents, trusts, PEPs, and knowing when to escalate

  • Clear written communication, both with customers and in documented case decisions

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in your day-to-day work to go faster or do better work, with concrete examples

  • A bias to fix the process rather than just work the queue

Nice-to-Haves

  • Line management of operators or analysts (strongly preferred)

  • Experience working with card-issuing, BaaS or payments partners on onboarding (e.g. partner due-diligence requests, sample reviews)

  • Safeguarding / client-money reconciliation experience

  • Writing requirements for Product and Engineering teams

  • EU onboarding experience or a second European language

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

jobs.title: In-house CRA I/ In-house CRA II
jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine, Oncology and Rare Disease is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high retention rates compared to industry averages. We are now recruiting In-house CRA I/ In-house CRA II to join our team in Poland.

Position summary

The In-house CRA (IHCRA) provides centralized, non-site-facing support to CRAs and clinical project teams across the study lifecycle. The role supports consistent site oversight by maintaining study documentation and systems, reviewing and reconciling site-level data, preparing operational metrics, and completing agreed administrative follow-up activities. The IHCRA works in close collaboration with assigned CRAs and under the oversight of the CTM, escalating issues that require site-facing follow-up or clinical judgment.

This is a regional support role. Direct communication with investigator sites and travel to site visits are not part of the core scope. The role may support studies across European countries and therefore does not require a local language for each supported country.

Essential functions

  • Provide non-site-facing operational and administrative support to assigned CRAs and clinical project teams throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Prepare and maintain Investigator Site Files, including document distribution and coordination with shipping vendors where required. Route site communication and follow-up to the assigned CRA.
  • Where an electronic Investigator Site File is implemented, review it remotely for completeness and identify documents requiring CRA follow-up or filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Review documents received from CRAs and CTMs for legibility, completeness, correct orientation and filing readiness, and file documents in the eTMF in accordance with applicable processes.
  • Review the eTMF for missing or expiring site documents and provide clear follow-up lists to the assigned CRA.
  • Perform scheduled reconciliations between the Delegation of Authority Log, CTMS, eTMF and system-access records; create placeholders or update records as required by the agreed process.
  • Set up and maintain assigned site-level data, milestones and activities in CTMS and other study-specific systems based on information provided by the CRA and/or CTM.
  • Run available reports and provide assigned CRAs with agreed site metrics, including data-cleaning, enrollment and approval-status information where applicable.
  • Support sample tracking and other vendor or study reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and provide findings to the CRA for site-facing follow-up.
  • Complete agreed non-site-facing administrative actions arising from CRA site contacts or monitoring visits, such as coordinating supply orders, tracking completion and escalating delays.
  • Provide documentation and tracking support for audit and inspection readiness under CRA or CTM direction.
  • Support study tracking and reporting, maintain accurate activity status, and escalate risks, delays or data inconsistencies to the appropriate study team member.
  • Perform all activities in accordance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, company and sponsor SOPs, project plans and study-specific procedures.

Qualifications

Minimum required

  • Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent, preferably in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Initial experience in clinical research, clinical trial administration or study coordination within a CRO, pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.
  • Practical experience using CTMS, eTMF and other clinical trial systems or tools.
  • Familiarity with ICH-GCP principles and clinical trial documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Skills and competencies

  • Strong organization, prioritization and follow-through across multiple studies, sites and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to perform accurate document and data review for extended periods.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies, communicate findings clearly and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with CRAs, CTMs and cross-functional partners.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Self-motivation, flexibility, teamwork and commitment to delivering on agreed responsibilities.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multiple studies or countries in a centralized or regional clinical operations model.
  • Experience with Veeva Clinical applications.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Businesses come to Wayflyer to get the capital they need to grow. When they apply, connect their data or upload documents, every screen, word and transition either builds their trust or loses it. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with exceptional craft, strong product instincts and a builder mentality to shape how they access and manage capital.

You will take financial workflows and information-rich experiences from first idea to shipped product, and make them feel intuitive and trustworthy.

As part of our fully remote team of 15 designers across Product, Brand, Motion, and Design. Systems, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, share a common design system, and challenge each other’s work through open critiques, always pushing the quality of our craft forward.

How we think about craft

  • Craft is for the customer. Design should improve experiences, not just appearances.

  • Execution matters. From pixels to micro-interactions, nothing should feel accidental.

  • Trust is built through details. Especially when making decisions about their money.

  • Quality is a choice we make every day. It is not a final polish step or a handoff.

  • Speed and quality go together. We ship early, learn from real use and keep improving.

  • You can't write quality into a spec. It comes from people who care and who build.

Who Thrives Here

  • You don't wait for perfect requirements. You define the problem first.

  • You balance customer needs, business goals and technical limits.

  • You believe simplifying is one of the hardest and most valuable design skills.

  • You care deeply about craft and know that details matter.

  • You know that trust in financial products is built through hundreds of small interactions.

  • You push back when it matters, for the customer and for quality.

  • You use AI to explore, prototype and improve your work.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving team.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Own complex financial problems from discovery to delivery, and turn dense data into clear, scalable experiences.

  • Prototype early and often, with AI tools or code, to test ideas before they cost engineering time.

  • Build on our design system and help it evolve, with the design system designers.

  • Work with engineers until what ships matches the design.

  • Share your work in critiques and give feedback that raises everyone's work.

How You Think and Work

  • You have experience designing digital products, ideally in fintech, banking, lending, payments or other data-heavy domains.

  • You have a portfolio that shows strong product thinking and excellent visual and interaction craft, along with the reasons behind each decision.

  • You use evidence and data to inform decisions, alongside strong product intuition.

  • You care about outcomes as much as outputs, and understand how design contributes to business success.

  • You drive work forward independently.

  • You communicate clearly. You tell the story behind your decisions, and you give and receive feedback openly.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing lending, underwriting, credit, risk, payments, or financial products.

  • Strong accessibility and inclusive design practice.

  • Experience designing AI-powered products.

  • Experience contributing to design systems.

  • Experience working in high-growth startup environments.

Location and working policy

📍 Remote in Europe

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Senior Video Editor (DTC / eCommerce)

Every role in our company exists to drive measurable impact.

We are looking for individuals who take ownership, operate with urgency, and think in terms of results. You will be trusted with responsibility and expected to deliver against clear performance metrics.

About the Company

We’re 115 Ventures, a fast-growing e-commerce group building and scaling consumer brands:

  • TrySpartan — Men’s grooming, hair-growth and beard-care products

  • FurLife — Pet health and wellness products

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Video Editor with a proven track record of creating performance-driven ads for DTC and e-commerce brands.

You should understand not only how to make an ad look good, but also how hooks, pacing, storytelling and visual choices influence performance.

You’ll turn concepts, scripts, raw footage and customer insights into polished paid-social ads while collaborating closely with our Creative Strategists.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Editing paid-social ads from raw footage through final delivery

  • Turning scripts and briefs into persuasive visual stories

  • Creating strong hooks and scroll-stopping openings

  • Using pacing, captions, sound design and visual hierarchy to retain attention

  • Editing short-form ads and longer formats, including VSLs

  • Producing variations and iterations for creative testing

  • Exporting deliverables for Meta and other relevant platforms

  • Applying feedback and performance learnings to future work

  • Reviewing your work before submission

  • Organizing source footage, project files and final deliverables

  • Contributing informed creative ideas when an ad can be improved

  • Delivering at least seven high-quality, performance-driven ads per week

This Role Is Not for You If

  • Your experience is primarily in YouTube, film or cinematic content

  • You have not edited paid-social ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

  • You focus on aesthetics without considering performance

  • You require detailed direction for every editing decision

  • You are uncomfortable working in a high-output environment

  • You repeatedly submit work without reviewing it

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • At least five years of professional video-editing experience

  • At least three years editing paid-social or direct-response creative for DTC or e-commerce brands

  • A portfolio demonstrating high-performing Meta or paid-social ads

  • Experience working in a high-volume creative environment

  • Experience collaborating with Creative Strategists and marketers

  • Experience iterating creative based on feedback and performance data

Skills and Tools

  • Expert-level video editing

  • Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling and retention

  • Short-form, long-form and VSL editing

  • Captioning, sound design and platform-specific formatting

  • Basic-to-intermediate motion graphics

  • Strong attention to detail and time management

  • Adobe Premiere Pro

  • After Effects or an equivalent motion-graphics tool

  • CapCut

  • AI-assisted editing, video and voice tools

What Success Looks Like

After 30 Days

  • You understand our brands, creative standards and workflow

  • You independently edit short-form and long-form ads

  • Your work is delivered on time with minimal avoidable revisions

After 60 Days

  • You fully own assigned projects from raw footage through delivery

  • You consistently meet the agreed weekly output

  • You apply previous feedback before submitting new work

  • Your edits require fewer revision rounds

After 90 Days

  • You consistently deliver at least seven high-quality ads per week

  • At least 90% of projects are delivered on time

  • Most edits pass quality control within two revision cycles

  • You deliver quickly without sacrificing quality

  • You independently contribute useful creative observations

How Performance Will Be Measured

  • Weekly creative output

  • On-time delivery

  • Revision rate

  • Time to deliver

  • Quality and attention to detail

  • Application of feedback

  • Creative performance and winning-ad contribution

  • Communication, reliability and file organization

What We Offer

  • 3000 - 5,500 per month

  • Performance bonuses for successful creative

  • Reimbursement for approved tools such as Adobe, Envato and Storyblocks

  • Access to our internally hosted AI video-generation tool

  • A creative team with more than 30 Video Editors, Graphic Designers, Creative Strategists and project-management support

  • Potential progression into Lead Video Editor, Team Lead or Creative Production Lead roles

Working Conditions

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 (GMT+4)

  • Location: Remote

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Contract: Independent contractor agreement

Application Requirements

Please include:

  • Your résumé or LinkedIn profile

  • A portfolio demonstrating DTC or e-commerce paid-ad experience

  • Three ads that best represent your editing ability

  • A short explanation of your contribution to each example

  • Relevant performance results you are permitted to share

  • Your location, time zone, availability and compensation expectations

Important Notice

We are aware of scam emails. Please be informed our only email domain is @allinoneplace24.com

Our Hiring Process

We run a structured, performance-focused hiring process designed to assess real capability and mutual fit.

You can expect:

  • Clear communication throughout

  • Practical discussions about real scenarios

  • Transparent expectations

  • A focus on measurable impact

We encourage thoughtful applications. If this role aligns with your strengths and ambitions, we look forward to reviewing your application.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.

As an Engagement Manager within Customer Excellence and Professional Services at Smartsheet, you will play a critical role in setting customers up for success by prescriptively crafting and then leading the execution of large and transformative enterprise projects for our most strategic customers. The Engagement Manager serves as a trusted advisor to Smartsheet customers, provides mentorship to Sales & Professional Services teams, drives alignment across each customer’s projects, and ensures the highest customer satisfaction levels.

Partnered with the Account Team, Services Sales, and Service Delivery, the Engagement Manager contributes to pre-sales scoping and discovery activities, acting as a conduit across the organization to develop and articulate comprehensive implementation proposals. The Engagement Manager will then maintain the executive relationships and act as a critical issue point within these implementations in a billable capacity, ensuring tight customer alignment and offering proactive and prescriptive advice resulting in outstanding Customer Success.

As the Engagement Manager, you will manage several projects/programs concurrently spanning 1 or more Large Enterprise customers. Engagement managers will have a targeted utilization rate, be responsible for the development of best practices, and will manage business processes.

You will report to the Manager of Engagement Delivery, this is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered

You Will:

  • Support the account team with pre-sales scoping and discovery activities through Discovery Workshops and pre-engagement planning sessions with the customer
  • Actively enroll the required staff resources at the right time to maximize impact, utilization and customer outcomes.
  • Manage and drive competing requests across simultaneous strategic client engagements.
  • Identify, pull together, and drive project activities of teams from cross-functional and partner sources
  • Provide insight into Engagement and Client level revenue forecasting for Monthly and Quarterly targets
  • Manage project to time, budget, and contracted deliverables (including planning, scheduling, milestone reviews, etc.)
  • Manage project P&L to targeted margin results
  • Drive project reviews for management and customers. As requested, support the account team with preparing and leading customer Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) during and after project execution
  • Operate as additional eyes and ears within current accounts to identify and unlock follow-on opportunities.
  • Create momentum to accelerate delivery and shorten time to value with our customers
  • Ensure that engagements conclude with delighted clients that are willing to be referenced for new potential clients
  • Proactively mitigate and handle critical customer concerns and at-risk accounts; communicate optimally and appropriately with internal and external leaders and executives.
  • Own the escalation response using a consistent, documented escalation process and coordination for active projects and provide mentorship on escalation management to other Professional Services team members
  • Ensure quality and time management processes are followed by the team e.g., change controls, time card submissions, status reporting, risk and issue logging)
  • Contribute to the development and ownership of the Smartsheet Delivery Methodology and Professional Services PMO function
  • Contribute to engagement delivery standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Function as a frontline resource for “best practice” and informal customer questions
  • Liaison with necessary teams within Smartsheet to achieve the above items
  • Other duties as assigned

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience in customer-facing positions in a professional capacity ideally at Software or SaaS Provider
  • At least 2 years of Project and Program Management experience at the enterprise level
  • 2+ years of experience, leading customer-facing engagements in the enterprise space
  • Management of large billable projects for external customers
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate drafting, analysis, and process design, with sound judgment on accuracy, confidentiality, and customer data handling.
  • Experience with modern services deployment methodologies, with emphasis on software design and development
  • Use of formal project management tools
  • Expert-Level Scope control for fixed-fee engagements.
  • Passion for working with leading-edge, web-based technologies and a desire to understand Smartsheet’s benefits, values, use cases, and business and technical elements
  • Desire to work in a collaborative environment to promote and improve team performance
  • Strong analytical skills regarding client and project management issues
  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to manage competing client demands
  • Ability to interact and communicate with CxO-level personnel with confidence and clarity
  • Excellent communications and interpersonal skills
  • One or more Industry Recognized Certifications Including;
    • Project Management Professional Certification (PMP)
    • Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
    • Lean or Six Sigma certification
    • Smartsheet Core and/or Project Management Certification
  • Advanced degree (Masters Level) preferred or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and education
  • Willing to travel periodically (up to 20-30%) based on customer and business needs
  • Authorization to work in the U.S. for any employer on an ongoing basis
  • Has Smartsheet Certified Professional credential or has the ability to become certified within 3 months
  • Experience with process improvement and the development of tools & processes that enable team member success

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$92,500—$126,250 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Responsibilities

jobs.title: Senior Customer Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Customer Integration Engineer

Department: Product Delivery

About the Role: The Senior Customer Integration Engineer combines hands-on integration engineering with customer-facing technical leadership in multi-organization healthcare environments, working with state agencies, HIEs, EHR vendors, and implementation partners to determine how systems interact and exchange data. The position supports integration delivery across customer projects, including enterprise initiatives involving multiple systems, organizations, and technical stakeholders. The engineer is expected to understand how individual integrations fit within broader customer initiatives, identify technical dependencies, and provide technical guidance. For designated customers, the role may involve sustained technical engagement across multiple initiatives while continuing to support other integration projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Apply systems thinking to understand how applications, data flows, and technical dependencies interact across customer environments, and recommend feasible integration approaches using existing platform capabilities and standards.
  • Configure, implement, test, and troubleshoot healthcare integrations involving REST APIs, FHIR, authentication protocols, database-backed configurations, and secure data exchange.
  • Provide ongoing technical consultation for designated customers, maintaining continuity across integration initiatives and evolving requirements.
  • Lead and participate in technical discussions with customer IT teams, enterprise architects, technology vendors, and implementation partners to understand the broader technical environment and guide integration decisions.
  • Analyze internal and external technical specifications, API documentation, FHIR Implementation Guides, payloads, and application logs to validate integration approaches and resolve issues.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and implementation teams to investigate technical issues, address integration requirements, and identify product dependencies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including integration configurations, data flows, and implementation decisions.
  • Develop scripts, reusable utilities, and automation to improve integration testing, troubleshooting, and delivery efficiency.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare integration engineering, interoperability, systems integration, or related technical implementation roles.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, implementing, testing, and troubleshooting healthcare integrations, rather than solely designing solutions or coordinating technical teams.
  • Experience independently leading or actively contributing to technical discussions with customer IT teams, architects, vendors, and implementation partners to evaluate integration approaches, identify dependencies, and explain technical options and limitations.
  • Practical experience implementing and troubleshooting integrations involving REST APIs, HL7v2, FHIR, or similar healthcare data exchange technologies.
  • Experience using SQL and relational databases for integration configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with FHIR R4, US Core, FHIR Implementation Guides, REST APIs.
  • Experience with EHR integrations, Python or JavaScript scripting, cloud technologies, and multi-organization interoperability initiatives is preferred.
  • Strong systems thinking, including the ability to understand a customer's broader technical environment, recognize how individual integrations fit together, and recommend feasible implementation approaches.
  • Experience working with AWS services or similar cloud technologies to configure and troubleshoot integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent education and experience.

Our Mission:

Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • This position is remote, U.S. based.
  • This position may require 10-20% travel
  • The target pay range for this role is: $140,000-155,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies, as well as location.
  • All team members will be required to pass a background check which includes criminal, employment, and education verification

Benefits provided by Unite Us:

Medical, Dental, and Vision

We offer insurance to team members and eligible partners and dependents, including unlimited virtual mental health and acute medical visits.

Wellness

Mental health benefits, such as the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness platform subscription, are available to all team members.

Flexible Time Off

Take what you need, including volunteer days and mental health days. We also offer 14 paid, company-wide holidays.

Paid Parental Leave

Adoptive parents are included.

Employee Resource Groups

Join our ERGs to connect and engage with colleagues, like Military Veterans

Spending Accounts

We offer tax-advantaged health savings accounts (HSAs), flexible spending accounts (FSAs), and commuter benefits.

401(k) + Employer Match

Enjoy matching, immediate vesting and financial wellness resources

Additional Benefits

Life and AD&D - a company paid benefit, with the option to purchase additional coverage for yourself and your dependents

Disability Coverage

Accident Insurance

Pet Insurance

As part of this work at home job, we will provide you with all the necessary equipment to perform your duties, including a computer, mouse, keyboard as well as other items on our approved list of WFH supplies.

Unite Us is committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive culture, and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and encourage our employees' differences in race, religion, color, national origin, gender, family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, medical conditions, and other characteristics. jobs.title: Contract Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

  • Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.
  • Confirm the signed order form is complete: both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.
  • Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.
  • Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.
  • Verify approvals and required data: discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.
  • Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.
  • Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

  • Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.
  • Follow corrections through to completion: track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.
  • Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.
  • Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

  • Bring questions to the right person with full context: the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.
  • Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.
  • Track every open question until it's resolved, keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.
  • Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.
  • Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.
  • Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

  • Attention to detail: you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.
  • Process discipline: comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.
  • Clear, proactive communication: you ask questions early, write concise notes, and are comfortable working in Slack with a distributed team.
  • Collaborative and tactful: comfortable telling a sales rep or customer success manager their paperwork needs a fix, clearly and kindly, and working with them to get it right.
  • Follow-through: you keep track of open items and nudge politely until they're resolved.
  • Sound judgment about your limits: you recognize when something is unusual and escalate rather than guess.
  • Eagerness to learn: open to feedback and quick to pick up new systems and terminology.
  • Comfort with AI tools: willing to use AI-assisted tools as part of daily work and to verify their output.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM.
  • Familiarity with contracts, order forms, invoicing, or billing.
  • Prior experience in an operations, finance, or administrative role, or in a SaaS environment.
  • Coursework or interest in business, finance, accounting, or operations.
  • No prior Salesforce or revenue operations experience is required; we'll train you on our systems and procedures.

Engagement Details

  • Type: Contract
  • Hours: Part-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Reports to: Senior Director, Technical operations with day-to-day direction from the team's AI Operations Specialist
  • Compensation: $30/hr

Why This Role Matters

Contract reviews are the last checkpoint before a customer's billing and onboarding begin. By keeping this work accurate and on time, you protect the customer experience, reduce downstream cleanup for finance and customer success, and free up our specialists to build the automation and documentation that will make this process faster for everyone. That lets our teams spend more energy on what matters most: helping clinicians deliver excellent care.

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.
