jobs.title: Mission Success Manager -- Navy Accounts
jobs.description:
About Ethos
Ethos is an AI-enabled human readiness platform that identifies and addresses knowledge gaps before they become operational failures. We can quantify skills and competencies critical to an organization, assess the proficiency of a team, and modernize training programs to enable active interventions for individual students, trainers or courses. As a well-funded Series A startup ($40M+ raised), we are trusted by over 150 enterprise customers across sectors including the defense, life sciences, manufacturing, supply chain, and professional sports.

About the role

The Mission Success Manager is critical to our mission of combining learning, performance, and outcomes in one unified platform to optimize human readiness. You'll own the full customer lifecycle for a portfolio that includes one of Ethos's largest and most strategic customers, from onboarding and implementation through executive business reviews, renewals, and expansion. You'll build trusted relationships with leaders across fleet commands, TYCOMs, and program offices, and serve as the voice of your customers inside Ethos.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, curious, and determined, and can manage several customers at different stages of their rollouts with ease. You're passionate about discovering a use case's ROI and sharing those stories across teams to scale its impact. You'll also raise the bar for the team by mentoring Mission Success Managers and shaping the playbooks we use to deliver readiness outcomes.

The role is fully remote.

Preferred: Location near major Naval installations and an active or former security clearance.

Job responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer-facing activities, ensuring customers achieve measurable readiness outcomes through effective use-case discovery, implementation, training, and support.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Success – West
jobs.description:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

What we are looking for:

We are seeking a Director of Customer Success to lead execution and customer outcomes across the Western US. This is a regional people-leadership role, not an individual customer book-of-business role. You will lead and develop Customer Success Managers as applicable to the coverage model, and ensure the team consistently drives customer value, adoption, retention, and advocacy.

You will translate Semperis’s Customer Success strategy into strong day-to-day regional execution: building team capability, coaching customer strategy, inspecting portfolio health and renewal readiness, and coordinating with Sales, Renewals, Technical Delivery, Product, Support, and other partners. You will bring credibility in cybersecurity and the ability to connect identity-security outcomes to customer and business value.

What you will be doing:

As a Director of Customer Success at Semperis, you will help customers strengthen and recover their critical identity systems by building a team that delivers proactive, measurable value throughout the customer lifecycle. You will lead through people, establish a high bar for execution, and make sure customer insights and risks translate into clear action.

You will be responsible for:

Regional execution and portfolio outcomes

  • Own the operating plan for your assigned region, translating Customer Success priorities into clear team goals, coverage expectations, and execution rhythms

  • Lead team performance against gross retention (GRR), renewal attainment, portfolio health, success-plan execution, customer advocacy, and qualified customer success leads (CSQLs) in partnership with Sales

  • Review regional customer coverage and portfolio performance; identify gaps in capacity, focus, and execution, and recommend actions to the regional VP/AVP

  • Maintain a reliable view of account health, renewal readiness, customer sentiment, adoption, and expansion readiness across the portfolio

People leadership, coaching, and talent development

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a high-performing team; set clear expectations and manage performance consistently

  • Coach CSMs to move from reactive account coverage to proactive adoption, value realization, risk mitigation, and executive engagement

  • Establish a regular coaching and inspection cadence, including one-to-ones, portfolio reviews, calibration, and development planning

  • Build team capability and succession depth through feedback, stretch assignments, knowledge sharing, and career development

  • Address performance gaps promptly and fairly, recognize strong performance, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning

Customer value, adoption, and success planning

  • Inspect the quality and execution of success plans, ensuring customer business and security outcomes, use cases, milestones, owners, and value measures are clear

  • Coach teams to use customer telemetry, health indicators, deployment context, and product usage to identify adoption gaps and demonstrate value

  • Drive disciplined adoption of relevant Semperis use cases across the portfolio, including DSP posture reviews and hardening, ADFR recovery testing, DRET/Lightning detection and incident workflows, and maintaining current product versions

  • Ensure QBRs/EBRs and executive engagements connect technical progress, such as posture improvement and recovery readiness, to customer security and business priorities

  • Partner with Technical Delivery and other teams to keep deployment responsibilities distinct from ongoing adoption and value realization

Renewal readiness, risk, and expansion partnership

  • Inspect red/yellow accounts, at-risk renewals, and expansion-ready customers; ensure owners, next steps, mitigation plans, and leadership involvement are clear and documented

  • Coach teams to surface risk early, coordinate save strategies, and engage Sales, Renewals, Support, Product, and Technical Delivery as appropriate

  • Partner with Sales and Renewals on renewal readiness, account strategy, and expansion opportunities; ensure CSQLs are grounded in validated customer needs and followed through

  • Support major customer escalations within the region, aligning the right internal stakeholders and maintaining clear customer communication and accountability

Operating discipline and cross-functional collaboration

  • Establish and maintain consistent regional routines for portfolio reviews, success-plan inspection, QBR quality, renewal readiness, escalation follow-through, and team development

  • Use Salesforce (SFDC), TaskRay, and relevant customer-success dashboards to maintain accurate account context, health, risk, success-plan, renewal, and next-step information

  • Partner with CS Operations and regional leadership to improve visibility, data quality, playbooks, and repeatable customer-success practices

  • Represent the regional Customer Success team in relevant operating, product, and go-to-market forums; bring customer feedback and field learnings to internal partners

  • Collaborate effectively across Sales, Renewals, Technical Delivery, Support, Product, Security, and Marketing to improve customer outcomes and the end-to-end customer experience

What you’ll bring to the table:

Required experience and skills

  • 3+ years leading and developing high-performing Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Account Management, or related post-sale teams; experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or infrastructure software

  • A track record of improving team execution and customer outcomes across retention, renewal readiness, adoption, customer health, and value realization

  • Experience coaching teams that manage complex enterprise customers and multi-stakeholder program

  • Strong cybersecurity product or services experience and the credibility to engage with CISOs, CIOs, security operations leaders, IAM leaders, architects, and technical champions

  • Ability to explain identity-security concepts and connect customer outcomes to business value. Familiarity with Active Directory, Entra ID, identity security, incident response, and cyber-resilience concepts is highly relevant

  • Demonstrated skill in customer-risk identification, escalation leadership, renewal planning, and cross-functional problem solving

  • Strong people-leadership skills, including hiring, performance management, coaching, talent development, and building a healthy team culture

  • Data-informed operating skills: able to use portfolio dashboards, customer health signals, adoption measures, and CRM/CS tooling to set priorities and improve execution

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, sound judgment, and ability to influence across teams in a global, distributed organization

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in identity security, Active Directory/Entra ID, cyber recovery, security operations, or enterprise infrastructure

  • Experience with Salesforce, TaskRay, or comparable CRM and Customer Success platforms

  • Familiarity with customer-success measures and processes such as GRR, NRR, CSQLs, success plans, QBRs/EBRs, health scoring, and renewal forecasting

  • Relevant cybersecurity or customer-success certifications (for example, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or equivalent)

  • Prior experience in professional services, solutions engineering, technical delivery, security engineering, or incident response

How success will be measured

  • Team GRR and renewal attainment

  • Improvement in portfolio health and timely intervention on at-risk accounts

  • Success-plan adoption, quality, and execution across the team

  • CSQL creation and conversion support in partnership with Sales

  • Customer adoption and demonstrated value realization across relevant use cases

  • Team productivity, coaching cadence, performance improvement, talent retention, and bench development

  • Quality and consistency of QBRs/EBRs, renewal readiness, customer-risk management, and operating data

#LI-LP1

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days.

Semperis is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by the Semperis application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Semperis. Please inform Semperis representative Anna Taylor, Director of Global Recruiting, if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

Senior Executive Assistant to the Executive Team

About interos.ai

interos.ai is the operational resilience company reinventing how organizations manage their supply chains and business relationships. Our breakthrough AI-powered SaaS platform transforms complex business ecosystems into a living global map, down to any single supplier, anywhere. We help companies reduce risk, prevent disruptions, and build more resilient and adaptive enterprises.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced, proactive Senior Executive Assistant to serve as a trusted partner to our executive leadership team. This person will anticipate needs, manage competing priorities with minimal direction, and keep our executives organized, efficient, and focused on what matters most. The ideal candidate has supported C-level leaders in a fast-moving environment, communicates with clarity and sound judgment, and brings a strategic, solutions-oriented mindset to every interaction.

Essential Functions/Duties

  • Provide high-level, proactive administrative and strategic support to the CEO and members of the executive leadership team, anticipating needs and resolving issues before they escalate.
  • Manage complex, high-volume calendars, prioritizing and scheduling internal and external meetings across time zones from HST to EST, and making sound judgment calls on competing demands.
  • Coordinate travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries.
  • Assist executives for meetings by gathering materials, building agendas, and capturing and distributing notes and follow-ups.
  • Support executive operating rhythms, including leadership team meetings, board and investor preparation, and company-wide communications.
  • Process and track expense reports, reimbursements, and purchasing requests, and monitor executive budgets as needed.
  • Handle highly sensitive and confidential information, including board, financial, and personnel matters, with discretion and professionalism.
  • Plan and lead internal events and offsites for executive leaders from concept through execution.
  • Serve as a senior liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, including board members, customers, and partners.
  • Identify, recommend, and implement improvements to administrative processes and AI-enabled tools that help executives and the team work more efficiently.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in an Executive Assistant or similar administrative role, including direct support of C-level executives.
  • Proven ability to support multiple senior leaders concurrently.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/p7mZAaKx9GKjQtS2YMqN87/jobs-at-freebird

Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers. We’re hiring a Senior Creative Strategy Lead to develop and scale acquisition creative across multiple products.

You’ll own the creative strategy for your assigned lanes: understanding our customers, finding new angles, writing persuasive hooks and scripts, developing visual formats, and expanding proven winners. Working closely with writers, creators, editors, and Paid Media, you’ll turn customer insights and performance learnings into clear creative direction and ads that drive profitable growth.

We’re looking for a hands-on strategist with strong direct-response fundamentals, visual creative instincts, and experience evaluating Meta creative at scale. You should be able to explain why an ad converts, show how you helped make it work, and identify what to test next. Success means discovering new sources of growth and increasing the profitable spend supported by what’s already working.

What You'll OwnBuild Deep Customer Intelligence That Drives Creative

The creative portfolio is only as good as the customer understanding behind it. You'll own that understanding for every lane you're assigned.

  • Establish a research foundation for each lane using customer reviews, interviews, surveys, comments, competitor analysis, and performance insights.
  • Develop specific personas grounded in real desires, fears, objections, buying triggers, necessary beliefs, and actual moments where our products matter to customers.
  • Translate research into actionable creative opportunities, with clear customer insights and hypotheses behind every new concept direction.
Discover New Angles and Open New Acquisition Opportunities

You'll build new sources of acquisition growth while systematically expanding proven winners.

  • Continuously identify and test new customer segments, purchase motivations, use cases, and creative territories that aren't yet represented in the portfolio.
  • Produce new winning angles that can sustain meaningful spend within lane-specific acquisition targets.
  • Maintain a deliberate discovery pipeline that broadens the portfolio's sources of growth rather than concentrating on the same angles until they exhaust themselves.
  • Personally develop angles, hooks, and scripts using direct-response fundamentals: consumer psychology, awareness levels, market sophistication, necessary beliefs, mechanisms, proof, and storytelling. Compress the core promise into clear, compelling hooks.
Develop Winning Visual Formats and Executions

You'll own how an idea is packaged visually, from the opening hook through the proof that makes it persuasive.

  • Identify, adapt, and develop visual formats that make customer insights compelling across UGC, native content, demonstrations, animation, creator-led storytelling, and static creative.
  • Define how each concept comes to life through opening visuals, demonstrations, shot direction, pacing, on-screen text, and editing direction.
  • Reverse-engineer successful paid and organic creative from competitors, other brands, and adjacent industries. Understand why it works and adapt the underlying approach to Freebird's customers and products.
  • Partner with creators, editors, and production to carry the strategic intent through the finished ad.
Build and Maintain a Diversified Creative Portfolio

You'll own a living creative territory map for every assigned lane. That map is not a filing system. It's the strategic view that tells us where we are, what we know, and where we need to go.

  • Track what is winning, declining, promising, under-tested, and unexplored across each lane.
  • Ensure purposeful coverage across priority personas, angles, awareness stages, formats, ad frameworks, and creator demographics.
  • Identify portfolio concentration and coverage gaps, then direct testing toward the opportunities most likely to improve acquisition performance.
Turn Strategy Into Clear, Executable Sprint Plans

Strategy that doesn't translate into production-ready direction is not strategy. It's ideas.

  • Build monthly Creative Portfolio Sprint Plans supporting 30 concepts per month per active lane.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on customer evidence, performance learnings, business needs, and production capacity.
  • Give writers and production clear direction on audience, awareness level, customer tension, angle, hypothesis, mechanism, proof, visual format, and opening execution.
  • Deliver on time and resolve strategic questions quickly enough to support the sprint cadence.
Systematically Expand Winning Creative
  • Identify what is actually driving a winner's performance: the customer insight, message, proof, or execution that's making it work.
  • Build expansion plans across relevant personas, hooks, formats, creators, proof, scripts, stories, and demonstrations.
  • Increase the profitable spend supported by winning territories while continuing to develop new opportunities alongside them.
  • Recognize declining performance early and direct the next wave of expansion or discovery before the territory runs dry.
Build a Reliable Performance Learning Loop
  • Partner with Paid Media and Analytics to evaluate creative by CAC, purchase volume, and profitable spend potential across lanes, personas, angles, concepts, and formats.
  • Understand how Meta testing and delivery affect results. Distinguish proven winners, clear losses, and inconclusive tests by considering spend, purchase volume, distribution, and execution quality.
  • Use hook, hold, click, and engagement metrics to diagnose performance alongside acquisition outcomes.
  • Turn completed tests into clear decisions: expand, revise, retest, deprioritize, or explore further.
  • Feed findings back into territory maps, briefs, and sprint priorities so the portfolio actually improves with each cycle rather than repeating the same tests.
Raise the Strategic Quality of the Creative Team
  • Give writers, creators, and production a shared understanding of who we are speaking to, what we need them to believe, and why a concept should work.
  • Coach writers on customer insight, angle development, persuasion, and strategic coherence.
  • Partner with creator leadership to identify the talent, demonstrations, stories, and footage needed to execute the portfolio strategy.
  • Build reusable briefs, examples, and decision rules that help the team make stronger decisions independently over time.
What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months:

  • You have a strategy with clear coverage across personas, angles, formats, and awareness stages.
  • Sprint plans are running on time with clear strategic direction that writers and production can execute without ambiguity.
  • You've discovered multiple new angles or customer segments that weren't in the portfolio before and have shown evidence of scaling.
  • Proven winners are supporting more profitable spend through systematic expansion across hooks, formats, creators, proof, and scripts.
  • Your visual and messaging decisions are producing creative that meets lane-specific CAC targets and supports meaningful purchase volume.
  • The performance learning loop is working: completed tests are turning into clear decisions, not just data.
  • Writers and creators are producing stronger work because the briefs are better.

What We're Looking For
  • Demonstrated success developing performance creative strategy for DTC or ecommerce brands, with real acquisition results you can speak to specifically.
  • A demonstrated record of both discovering new winning angles and expanding proven creative into additional profitable spend.
  • Hands-on experience conducting customer research: reviews, interviews, surveys, VOC analysis. You know how to get beneath surface-level demographics to actual motivations and beliefs.
  • Experience directing writers and collaborating with creators, editors, production, and paid media teams. You can translate strategy into clear direction.
  • Evidence of managing creative strategy across multiple products, audiences, or acquisition portfolios simultaneously.
  • Strong commercial judgment: you understand how creative performance connects to CAC, contribution economics, and business results, not just engagement metrics.
  • Hands-on experience developing and evaluating Meta acquisition creative at meaningful spend levels.
  • Strong visual creative judgment and hands-on direct-response copywriting skills, supported by examples of ads you helped develop and scale.
  • AI fluency and a resourceful approach to workflow improvement, using modern tools to accelerate research, ideation, scripting, and execution while maintaining quality.
Why Freebird
  • Remote-first & flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy, trust, and meaningful overlap with US working hours.
  • Competitive compensation & benefits. Competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) with company match, and unlimited PTO.
  • A profitable, high-growth brand. Join a 9-figure DTC brand with significant ad spend, an established creative operation, and plenty of opportunities to grow and make an impact.
  • Real ownership & accountability. Own your creative strategy, make decisions, and be directly accountable for performance and acquisition results.
  • Move fast and make an impact. We measure what matters, keep things simple, and turn great ideas into action without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • High autonomy, low politics. We trust people to do great work, make data-driven decisions, and take ownership without micromanagement.
  • A kind, people-focused culture. We communicate openly, collaborate, support each other, and celebrate wins together.
  • Always growing and improving. We embrace change, challenge ourselves to do better, and innovate without fear.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada
URL: http://www.mozilla.org

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost  including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:
  • Own New Products financials: Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported
  • B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model,  updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.
  • Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights.
  • Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.
  • Drive team standardization and reporting: Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.
  • Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.
  • Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.
What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.
  • B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.
  • Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.
  • Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.
  • Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.
  • Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.
  • Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.
  • Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.
  • Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.
Nice to have:
  • Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization
  • Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment
  • Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.
  • Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.
Success Factors

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

  • Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.
  • Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.
  • Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.
  • Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.
  • See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.
What you'll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly wellbeing stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Director of Referral Services
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.luxinfusion.com

 

See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

 

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Referral Services who wants their work to mean something—someone who brings care, accountability, and purpose to how referrals become treatments and how systems become services.

Why This Role Matters

The Associate Director of Referral Services plays a critical role in delivering a patient‑first infusion experience by ensuring referrals move efficiently, accurately, and compassionately from intake to care delivery.

The Associate Director of Referral Services will be responsible for the oversight and management of the front end referral process including, Benefit Verification and PA processes for LUX Infusion Neurology, Immunology, Transplant and Specialty Infusion areas. The Associate Director will understand the specific BV and PA roles and support the day-to-day department activities. This position will work closely and collaboratively with other internal department leads, including Intake Coordination CRT, Nursing Services and Pharmacy Services.

In this role, you’ll contribute to work that:

  • Ensures patients experience timely, coordinated access to infusion therapy
  • Supports clinicians and referral partners through clarity, responsiveness, and reliability
  • Strengthens the foundation of care delivery through strong reimbursement, documentation, and intake workflows

Every referral represents a real person navigating a complex healthcare moment—and your leadership helps that journey begin with confidence and trust.

What You’ll Do

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Set standard metrics and goals for Referral Management team members for pull through of referrals, documentation management, BV, PA processing
  • Sets the tone for the Referral Management departments, develops and supports LUX Infusion’s culture in the work environment, and ensures there is opportunity for team professional
  • Establish training protocols for new employees and evaluate performance against metrics/goals; and determine corrective action or training plans to support performance improvement when needed
  • Establishes communication processes and procedures for Referral Management team members to engage necessary internal and external stakeholders to gather missing or inaccurate information
  • Work cohesively with internal department leadership to ensure continuity of patient referral activities are performed optimally.
  • Provide administrative and/or leadership support for accreditation related process or data collection activities that entail information from the Intake or Referral departments.
  • Work collaboratively with referral and pharmacy operations management peers to support successful outcomes overall end to end processes to support getting referrals to their proper destination
  • Daily & Weekly (or as needed) – Review department alignment with stated SLAs for the department, identify trends among reporting periods, and take action with team or peers as needed
  • Support staffing and resource adjustments as found necessary to support referral volumes and overall growth goals for the organization
  • Maintains necessary and thoughtful communications to the intake and Patient Services specialist team members delivering information supplied by leadership with impact to people, process, and technology updates within a given location.
  • Serves as a point of escalation for issue management and resolution support related to services provided by Intake & Referral Specialists

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Triages work and assigns duties to staff
  • Perform employee management tasks, including, but not limited to review of productivity, management of job descriptions, timely performance reviews, disciplinary process/corrective action, and all associated personnel paperwork.
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and projects concurrently
  • Must have scheduling flexibility and be able to work overtime [Exempt]
  • Overnight travel on occasion by car and plane
  • Careful attention to detail
  • Performs related duties as requested

What You’ll Bring

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5-7 years of experience in managing patient referral and prescription activities in infusion or specialty therapies
  • 3-5 years of general infusion or specialty therapy reimbursement or payer experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in supporting prescriber, healthcare setting, patient, and field facing communications related to referral or prescription services in infusion or specialty therapies
  • 1-3 years of successful management/leadership of department employees
  • Strong customer service skills internal and external customers, including meeting quality standards for services and evaluation of customer satisfaction.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, Bachelors' Degree preferred
  • Advanced computer and internet skills (e.g. Microsoft Office)
  • Must know and understand financial information and reporting aspects
  • Willing to travel up to 5% of the time for business purposes (when necessary to attend meetings, conferences, seminars, etc.)

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED:

  • 1-3 years people management experience overseeing team members responsible for pharmacy intake or referral process activities
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of infusion therapies, the steps needed to qualify a patient for such therapy, and the ability to lead team members through these steps
  • General knowledge and understanding of payer contracts for infused therapies and operational requirements to support contracts for pharmacy or prescription services

KNOWLEDEGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong knowledge of specialty prescription and referral documentation workflow, provider communication needs, and necessary steps to vet a referral to outcome
  • Strong working knowledge of medical / pharmacy terminology
  • General knowledge of intake requirements for all insurance payors including Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare D, Commercial and pharmacy plans
  • Ability to actively communicate, inspire and motivate all levels of staff
  • Ability to think and act strategically and proactively
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare reports and correspondence related to the work
  • Ability to organize and coordinate the work of others
  • Ability to set priorities and assign work to other professionals
  • Ability to identify areas for opportunity and process improvement and enact change
  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills
  • Excellent group presentation skills

Communication & Technical Skills

  • Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions and intake/referral issues
  • Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively
  • Computer skills
  • CPR+ knowledge, Microsoft business programs – Excel – Word – Access Database

You don’t need to check every box—we care just as much about how you lead, support, and show up as what’s on your resume.

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe infusion care deserves more light—more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose‑driven leadership work with real patient impact
  • A patient‑first, clinician‑led culture
  • Collaborative, supportive teammates who value high standards and empathy
  • The opportunity to grow with an organization building something meaningful

Come help us elevate infusion care—and see what’s possible when leadership, care, and purpose come together.

Pay Range/Rate
$100,000—$110,000 USD

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Us
Gather AI is the Physical AI platform for logistics. We give the companies that run the world’s warehouses ground truth on every product and every movement, dock to dock.
Our platform reads the warehouse floor through autonomous drones and cameras mounted on material handling equipment, then turns what it sees into intelligence and action. Facilities run safer and more accurately, with fewer ladders and fewer manual counts. If you want to do the defining design work for a new category in a vital industry, we’d like to meet you.
About the Team
Product at Gather AI sits at an unusual intersection: we build software for people who work on warehouse floors, not at desks. Our users are associates checking inventory on a tablet from the seat of a forklift, shift teams running drone workflows, field technicians troubleshooting on site, and facility leaders reading AI-generated insights in Sage.
Design here is about more than pixels, though craft matters a lot. It starts with understanding how people work under pressure, and it ends with software that gets out of their way and looks as advanced as the technology behind it.
About the Role
Most design roles ask you to improve something that already exists. This one asks you to define what good looks like for a new category of product.
You’ll be Gather AI’s first and only designer. You’ll own design end to end, from field research and information architecture to visual craft and working prototypes. Your work spans the apps floor teams use alongside our drones and MHE Vision systems, and Sage, our AI insights layer. The job is to help the product team ship products that solve real problems and happen to be very well designed, not to make screens for their own sake.
You won’t design from assumptions. You’ll stand next to the people using our software and let what you see shape what you build.
We’d love you near our Pittsburgh office, and we’ll seriously consider strong candidates anywhere in the US. The role includes about 20% travel, roughly one trip a month, to customer sites in Houston and Dallas and to our Pittsburgh office.
There’s no established design team to slot into, and that’s the point. You’ll set the standard and build the foundations, with a visible path to Director of UX as design at Gather AI grows.
What You’ll Do

  • Own design for the MHEV app: ramp fast and propose a v2 concept by month 3, then take full ownership of the product line
  • Design interfaces for people working directly with drones and forklifts: tablet experiences used mid-shift, in noisy environments and under time pressure, where clarity is the whole job
  • Expand into the Sage dashboard as your second product line, shaping an AI insights product that’s early enough for your decisions to define its direction
  • Build on the foundations of the Gather design system and own it across our dashboards and apps
  • Travel to customer sites to observe how people use our products in the field, and bring that context into every design decision
  • Partner closely with mobile and front-end engineering in Pittsburgh and Noida, from MHEV stand-ups and weekly requirements planning through handoffs that remove ambiguity rather than create it
  • Use Claude and other AI tools to move from concept to functioning prototype, and design with an eye to how engineers will use your work with AI to build front ends faster. The team moves fast and expects you to as well
  • Over time, extend your work to internal tools and the occasional piece of marketing material

What You’ll Need

  • Visual craft: a portfolio with strong, simple, modern design that holds up even in data-dense interfaces. We look closely at typography and layout
  • Analytical rigor: you turn data and requirements into clear information hierarchy, and you can show how you knew a design worked, through measures like task time, error rates or training time
  • Experience shipping real products at scale, with users in real workflows, where we can see the thinking behind the screens
  • A desire to be the only designer: you want to own design end to end now, without a larger design team around you
  • Comfort using Claude or other AI tools to build working prototypes, not just static Figma designs
  • Experience designing through user research: you’ve watched people work and changed what you built because of it
  • Figma fluency, or deep experience with a comparable design and prototyping tool
  • The ability to work without a lot of structure: spot what needs designing before you’re asked, and ask good questions when you’re stuck
  • Willingness to travel about 20% of the time (roughly one trip a month) to customer warehouses and our Pittsburgh office

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing interfaces for physical systems such as robotics, drones, industrial machinery or other non-desk environments
  • Founding or sole designer experience, ideally building 0-to-1 at a startup
  • A blend of consumer-grade polish and enterprise analytical depth
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system
  • Background in warehouse, logistics or fulfillment
  • 5 to 10 years of product or UX design experience. Strong candidates with less tenure who have shipped real products at scale are encouraged to apply
  • Experience with generative UI tools beyond Claude, or a software development background

jobs.title: Technical Oversight - Underwriting
jobs.description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About The Role

We’re seeking an entrepreneurial Technical Oversight - Underwriting. This role involves both strategic oversight and hands-on management of third party fulfillment providers to ensure efficient, compliant loan origination while enhancing systems and workflows for high-quality, scalable operations.

You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our platform, developing underwriting workflows, standard operating procedures, and quality control measures. You will provide tactical guidance to engineering teams, emphasizing scalable human out of the loop solutions.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about building flexible automated systems with rigorous oversight that can scale, this role is for you.

About You

  • Possess expert-level knowledge of the entire mortgage lending process, detailed underwriting knowledge specific to loan requirements and comprehensive understanding of federal, state, and regulatory guidelines related to residential mortgage lending.

  • You are a visionary leader with a clear perspective on building scalable, modular origination infrastructure.

  • Comfortable operating in highly regulated industry whilst optimizing for performance. You build with a compliance first lens, respect regulations, continuously review, and update processes as needed.

  • Obsess over the customer and uphold the highest standard. You build for our customers and their borrowers, doing whatever it takes to make them successful on the platform.

  • Adhere to a scalable software first approach, operational workaround last. You surface issues, lead discussions around long-term solutions, document them, and manage temporary manual workarounds if needed.

  • Ability to oversee numerous 3rd party fulfillment partners, ensuring high quality, on-time originations. You build deep relationships and drive consistent results.

  • Have strong, principled opinions that you’re willing to defend. We have a culture of vigorous discussion and debate on decisions. We’ll push you to articulate your choices, and defend them where necessary.

  • Have great ideas, and lots of them. You should see opportunities all around you to make the product and team better. We’ll provide the environment to act on those ideas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement underwriting workflows, SOPs, SLAs, checklists, and QC measures to ensure high-quality and efficient loan underwriting.

  • Regularly access and enhance our Underwriting Systems to ensure smooth file flow, high quality, regulatory compliance and efficiency.

  • Oversee day-to-day operations with fulfillment partners, ensuring consistent loan delivery.

  • Define and monitor productivity standards and performance goals and ensure that they are met on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis.

  • Conducting 2nd level reviews, handling exceptions, and managing escalations to ensure quality control.

  • Act as a subject matter expert, aiding decision-making and driving product improvement.

  • Working closely with internal teams, partners, and engineering to drive product improvements and optimize the fulfillment infrastructure.

  • Provide technical and guideline training, recommend areas of improvement, and conduct ongoing training as needed.

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of mortgage origination and regulations to ensure compliance.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in underwriting and managing underwriting teams across diverse loan types, including Conventional, Jumbo, NON-QM, GOVT across purchase and refinance.

  • Proven track record in developing underwriting workflows, SOPs, SLAs,and QC measures.

  • Proficiency in configuring Underwriting Systems for efficiency,quality and compliance.

  • Proven track record in managing and leading de-centralized underwriting teams.

  • Experience in the management of strategic 3rd party fulfillment partners.

  • Experience working on mortgage products within a fintech environment is strongly preferred.

Benefits

  • Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon.

  • Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with support for dependents.

  • 401(k): Ability to save for your future.

  • Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off.

  • Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to fix up your workspace.

  • Annual Off-sites: Fully paid for team off-sites in beautiful corners of the world.

  • At-cost Mortgages: We’ll help you finance your next home when you’re ready.

jobs.title: Marketing and Commercial Specialist (Canada)
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

You’ll be the operational co-pilot for our Canadian team as we build Who Gives A Crap into a household brand in Canada. Day to day, that means keeping campaigns moving, keeping commercial pipelines organised and making sure the day-to-day runs smoothly. It isn’t just about updating trackers. It’s about the groundwork that makes sure our brand lands locally and our regional commercial milestones get hit.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Coordinating campaign delivery across social, influencer, PR and events, so cross-functional work lands on schedule
  • Flagging project blockers early and keeping shared timelines and status documentation up to date
  • Being the day-to-day point of contact for our local agencies
  • Coordinating the Canadian social calendar with our global creative team and local agencies
  • Reviewing global and local content to make sure it feels authentically Canadian and on brand
  • Reviewing agency pitches for influencers and giving constructive feedback before they go to the Director for sign-off
  • Keeping the Canadian marketing budget tracker accurate, with zero errors
  • Working through inbound Canadian B2B enquiries, from bulk requests to reorders

Let’s talk about you

You’re a details person who loves a fast-moving team

We’re launching a new market, which means the work moves quickly and the to-do list changes often. You like having lots of moving parts in play and keeping them tidy. You know when to chase a deadline, when to flag a blocker early and when to ask for help.

You have a sharp instinct for what feels right

You notice when copy, an asset or an agency pitch sounds off brand or out of touch with Canadian nuances, and you can say why. You’re keen to suggest local ideas worth testing.

You like to follow the numbers

You’re comfortable in a dashboard. You enjoy spotting what’s working, what isn’t and what to test next, and you’d rather turn a messy report into a clear next step than wait for someone else to do it.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Hardware Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Gather AI
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.
About the Team
Gather AI’s Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers’ material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.
About the role
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you’ll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.
What you'll do

  • Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
  • Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
  • Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
  • Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
  • Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
  • Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
  • Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
  • Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
  • Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

What you bring

  • You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
  • You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you’ve build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
  • You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
  • You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
  • You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

Nice to have

  • Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
  • Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
  • Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
  • Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

Location Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.
How we hire A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
jobs.description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the team:

At Angi, security is woven into everything we build, from PCI-scoped payment flows to the AI agents now handling homeowner/pro conversations and scheduling end-to-end. Detection signal spans cloud, endpoint, identity, SaaS, and a growing set of autonomous agents. You'll own detection and response as an engineering problem: build the detections, build the automation that works them, and carry the pager for what still gets through.

While this is a remote position, we are a global company and are looking for applicants located in eastern or central time zones to align with our team's working hours.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and own detections across AWS (GuardDuty, CloudTrail, SecurityHub), EDR, identity, SaaS, and our AI gateway. Coverage, precision, and latency are properties we manage across a rule's lifecycle.

  • Own the security log pipeline, and own it as a product with consumers: audit and security logs land centrally and are exposed to the teams that need them for triage, analysis, and incident response.

  • Own detection on the application protection layer - account takeover, credential stuffing, and abuse patterns against a two-sided marketplace.

  • Build the triage layer - enrichment, correlation, containment, evidence capture - working toward a median alert that resolves without a human touching it. Use LLM and agentic tooling where it earns its place, and own the verification layer that makes that output trustworthy.

  • Buy the tool where a tool is right, build where it isn't, and extend where it's close. You'll ship code in a repo, not only configure consoles.

  • Extend detection coverage to Angi's agentic AI products: what anomalous behavior looks like for an autonomous agent holding calendar and account access - prompt injection attempts, tool-call abuse, data exfiltration through the agent surface.

  • Actively participate in all facets of the incident response lifecycle by participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

  • Own the technical controls InfoSec retains for detection within compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS (tamper-detection monitoring, log integrity, alerting coverage).

  • Partner with platform and product teams so new services ship with telemetry, threat models, and response playbooks. You will be in the room when these are designed, not brought in after the fact.

Who you are:

  • You have 5+ years of experience working on a security team supporting product/engineering functions, cloud infrastructure, and corporate infrastructure development

  • You have software engineering experience (Python preferred) and an engineering mindset for building reliable / maintainable security infrastructure to support a large organization with CI/CD software engineering practices

  • You are at home in the analytics and observability stack detections get measured on - Grafana, Looker, NewRelic or similar. You will build your own coverage and precision dashboards rather than filing a ticket for them.

  • Hands-on with AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent); working knowledge of EDR, SIEM, and SOAR platforms and their APIs.

  • Hands-on with containers and Kubernetes, including what detection and forensics look like on that surface.

  • Sound build-versus-buy judgment with no allergy to either answer. You reach for what exists when it fits, and you're comfortable wrapping, extending, or replacing it when it doesn't.

  • You've owned incidents end to end - page, diagnosis, fix, postmortem.

  • Some level of exposure to LLM/agentic system security (prompt injection, agent identity, data exfiltration via AI systems).

  • A daily, fluent user of AI-assisted coding/security tools. You are able to speak concretely about how you direct and verify AI output.

  • Strong written communication: you'll write detection documentation, postmortems, and design feedback that other engineers rely on.

  • Comfort executing the technical side of a compliance framework (PCI, SOX, or similar) is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The base salary band for this position ranges from $150,000 - $225,000, commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs.

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it.

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K).

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world.

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Lead
jobs.description:
About the job:
Hi, I’m Atlee and I’m the Controller at Ashby. We're hiring a Global Payroll Lead to own payroll for our fast-growing, global employee base. We pay employees across an ever-growing number of U.S. states and internationally, through a mix of local entities and employers of record (EOR). Every pay cycle has more people, more jurisdictions and more complexity than the one before.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll be the company’s payroll expert and the person accountable for getting it right. You’ll run the day-to-day work yourself and also design how payroll should run as we scale. We’re looking for someone who stands out in customer service, analytical horsepower, attention to detail, independent time management and speed.

Payroll is a critical part of both the employee experience and business operations. You’ll own the full payroll cycle (semi-monthly and monthly) across all of our populations. That covers the details behind it: employee data changes, leave events, bonuses, commissions, deductions, off-cycle payments and final pay. It also covers the controls, vendors and processes that hold it all together. You’ll partner closely with Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Legal, managers, employees and external providers so that payroll is right the first time, and when it isn’t, issues get resolved quickly and the root cause gets fixed.

What you’ll do

  • Own recurring payroll activities across U.S., U.K., Canadian, and international EOR/contractor populations, coordinating timelines, inputs, approvals, processing, and final review.

  • Collect, validate, and enter payroll changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, promotions, bonuses, commissions, deductions, reimbursements, leave, and return-to-work events.

  • Review payroll registers and supporting reports for accuracy, reconcile discrepancies, and coordinate corrections, off-cycle payments, and retroactive adjustments.

  • Partner with Finance on payroll funding, payroll accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and month-end or year-end close activities.

  • Coordinate with payroll, tax, benefits, HR, and EOR vendors to resolve issues, manage escalations, and maintain exceptional service levels.

  • Support payroll tax filings, notices, audits, year-end reporting, and other compliance activities in partnership with internal stakeholders and external providers.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee payroll questions, explaining complex issues clearly and following through to resolution.

  • Build and maintain payroll calendars, checklists, standard operating procedures, and control points that make payroll more predictable and scalable.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve the connection between payroll, People systems, benefits, and Finance.

  • Support projects related to payroll infrastructure, global expansion, system changes, and process improvements.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in payroll operations or payroll administration

  • Direct experience supporting payroll for employees in multiple countries, including U.S. and Canadian payroll and/or international EOR or contractor populations.

  • Experience in payroll for both exempt and non-exempt employee populations.

  • Experience managing payroll inputs, validating payroll registers, reconciling results, and processing corrections or off-cycle payments.

  • Working knowledge of payroll compliance, tax concepts, wage and hour requirements, leave-related pay, and year-end processes.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of accurate execution against firm deadlines.

  • Comfort working across multiple systems and vendors, with the ability to trace an issue back to its source and determine the right fix.

  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, including the ability to audit data and explain variances.

  • Excellent judgment and discretion when handling compensation, tax, banking, and other sensitive employee information.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication with employees, managers, Finance, People, and external partners.

  • A proactive, process-oriented approach: you notice recurring problems, document what you learn, and improve the system rather than relying on workarounds.

  • Ability to work independently in a distributed, asynchronous environment while keeping stakeholders informed.

You should apply if

  • You are the person others trust to catch the detail that could otherwise become a payroll problem.

  • You have experience with payroll platforms such as Gusto, Deel, Remote, or similar systems.

  • You can balance precision and urgency without losing sight of the employee experience.

  • You have operated in an environment where the process is growing and not every answer is already documented (and you’re the one who is excited to document!)

  • You communicate early when something is unclear, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and follow through until the issue is closed.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough - we assess if you are the right fit for Ashby and we will provide ample information for you to determine if Ashby is the right place for you. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Recruiter Screen with Talent Acquisition- 30 min

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Atlee - 45 min

  • Practical Assessment

  • Final Round - 2.5 hours, consisting of four 30 minute interviews with key stakeholders

Benefits

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby, do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution, regardless of your contribution.

  • If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
