jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager at DataGrail, you’ll partner with customers to help them operationalize and scale their privacy programs using our agentic privacy platform. Acting as a trusted advisor, you’ll drive onboarding, adoption, and long-term customer success by delivering strategic guidance, fostering engagement, and helping customers realize measurable value from the platform. You’ll also advocate for customer needs cross-functionally, helping shape the product experience and the future of privacy operations.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the customer journey from onboarding through long-term success and retention.
  • Lead customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating timelines, stakeholders, and delivery milestones.
  • Drive platform adoption and customer value by helping organizations operationalize privacy best practices.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including privacy, security, legal, and executive teams.
  • Proactively monitor customer health, identify churn risks early, and drive resolution plans.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Product, Support, and Sales to improve the customer experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding workflows, customer engagement, and operational scalability.
  • Advocate for customer needs and share actionable feedback to help shape product improvements

What You'll Bring:

  • Experience in customer success, onboarding, implementation management, or customer-facing SaaS roles
  • Strong understanding of privacy operations and data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA
  • Experience working with privacy platforms or related technologies, including tools like DataGrail
  • Strong project management and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple customer priorities
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Clear communication skills and confidence working with customer leadership teams
  • Ability to proactively identify customer risks, drive adoption, and improve customer outcomes
  • Passion for customer success, privacy, and helping organizations navigate evolving compliance challenges

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with privacy, security, legal, or compliance teams
  • Familiarity with SaaS onboarding or implementation workflows
  • Experience supporting customers in fast-moving or highly regulated environments

What Success Looks Like:

Within 90 Days You'll:

  • Develop a strong understanding of the DataGrail platform, privacy workflows, and customer use cases
  • Shadow onboarding and customer success engagements across a variety of accounts
  • Begin leading onboarding activities, customer training sessions, and proactive customer check-ins
  • Successfully onboard your first customers and help drive early adoption and platform value
  • Build strong working relationships across Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, and Support
  • Start identifying customer risks, surfacing product feedback, and contributing to internal process improvements

Within 180 Days You'll:

  • Independently manage onboarding and ongoing success across your customer portfolio
  • Drive customer adoption, engagement, and long-term value realization
  • Proactively identify customer risks and lead retention or mitigation efforts
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across privacy, legal, security, and operations teams
  • Contribute to onboarding best practices, playbooks, and scalable customer success processes
  • Share actionable customer feedback and insights to help influence product improvements

Within 365 Days You'll:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor across your customer portfolio, driving strong retention, satisfaction, and customer advocacy
  • Lead strategic customer conversations around privacy operations, adoption, and growth opportunities
  • Contribute to scalable onboarding, enablement, and customer success initiatives across the organization
  • Mentor newer team members and share best practices across the Customer Experience team
  • Demonstrate measurable impact on customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and product evolution

The OTE compensation (salary + variable) range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state.

All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change.

Compensation Range

$150,000—$180,000 USD

About Us:

DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales.

Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer — Generative AI Mission Systems
jobs.description:
AI/ML Engineer — Generative AI Mission Systems

Location: Mainly remote within the United States, with onsite collaboration in Laurel, Maryland, typically one day approximately every six weeks for team-wide sprint planning.
Clearance: Active final DoD Secret clearance required

This position supports a pending contract opportunity and is contingent upon contract award, with an anticipated start in November 2026.

Build Applied AI for Secure Mission Software

Help turn generative-AI concepts into dependable capabilities used within secure mission-planning and decision-support software.

At Rackner, you will integrate large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic AI, prompt-engineering workflows, and inference pipelines into an established software application supporting a high-impact national-security mission. You will work across AI, software engineering, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and customer technical teams to move capabilities beyond standalone demonstrations and into practical application workflows.

This role offers the opportunity to deepen your applied-AI experience, influence how emerging capabilities are designed and evaluated, and contribute to software where reliability, security, and mission usefulness matter.

This is a primarily remote role within the United States. Work will be performed using customer-provided systems, with virtual collaboration across the engineering team. Any classified work will be completed onsite at the customer location.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and integrate AI-enabled software capabilities.
  • Build and integrate LLM-enabled capabilities into secure application workflows.
  • Develop or integrate retrieval-augmented generation capabilities.
  • Develop and support agentic-AI components and multi-step workflows.
  • Design and refine prompts, system instructions, and supporting AI workflows.
  • Build and maintain inference pipelines.

  • Document AI designs, workflows, limitations, evaluation results, and implementation decisions.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical reviews, and security-remediation activities.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, security professionals, DevSecOps teams, and customer stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • A master’s degree or Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field, along with demonstrated experience working on or developing AI/ML capabilities.
  • At least four years of relevant AI/ML experience that includes work with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and prompt engineering.
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM-enabled software and RAG capabilities into applications or workflows.
  • Developing or supporting agentic-AI capabilities and multi-step AI workflows.
  • Designing, building, or supporting inference pipelines.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-enabled capabilities and clearly document findings, design decisions, and results.
  • Testing and documenting AI-enabled software capabilities.
  • Ability to clearly explain your personal technical ownership and contributions.
  • Strong collaboration and technical-communication skills.

Preferred Background

Experience with several of the following can strengthen your fit:

  • Moving AI capabilities beyond coursework, personal projects, or demonstrations into operational software workflows.
  • Evaluating grounding, reliability, output quality, hallucinations, or other limitations of AI-enabled systems.
  • Integrating AI services with backend APIs or established software applications.
  • Secure software-development lifecycle and DevSecOps practices.
  • OpenShift, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or containerized application delivery.
  • Secure, restricted, disconnected, on-premises, or classified development environments.
  • Defense, government, aerospace, mission-planning, or other regulated environments.
  • Collaboration with software-engineering, cybersecurity, platform, and customer-facing technical teams.

Why Rackner

At Rackner, you will have the opportunity to build technology that supports critical defense and public-sector missions.

You will work on more than isolated AI experiments or prompt-engineering tasks. This role combines hands-on LLM integration, retrieval and agentic-AI development, secure software delivery, and close collaboration across AI, software, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and mission-focused teams.

Rackner has delivered more than $30 million in recent federal awards and supports mission-critical work across defense, civilian, and public-sector environments. We are looking for an applied AI engineer who can build on that momentum by turning emerging generative-AI capabilities into secure, dependable software with meaningful mission impact.

Benefits & Professional Growth

  • Company-supported certifications aligned with current and future program work

jobs.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

You will move clients from high-level strategy to live, functioning versions of Cognite’s solutions through Fast AI Prototyping via Cognite Atlas AI™ and Cognite Data Fusion®.

You will leverage the Atlas AI workbench to automate complex industrial workflows, ensuring solutions are technically feasible, scalable, and grounded in the contextualized data foundation of our Industrial Knowledge Graph.

You will build executive confidence by delivering client-focused demos and reference architectures that prove the ROI of Industrial AI.

Translate "field friction" and deployment learnings into actionable product requirements and scalable best practices that strengthen Cognite’s position as the leader in Industrial DataOps.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

  • Agentic AI Proficiency: Demonstrated experience building with LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT-4) and a deep understanding of the Agentic AI landscape to create trusted, mission-critical industrial agents via Cognite Atlas AI™.

jobs.title: Dispatch Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Remote - United States

Level: Specialist I (entry-level — clear growth path to Specialist II and Senior)

Reports to: Dispatch Manager

About Proof

Launched in 2018, Proof is a national platform for service of process supporting thousands of law firms across the United States. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing through a modern, technology-driven platform — automating document ingestion, compliance, real-time job matching, and integrations with leading legal software. Today, Proof delivers over 60,000 documents per month through a network of ~2,000 contracted process servers.

About the role

A Dispatch Specialist I is the front line of Proof's marketplace. You ensure all service of process jobs in your territory are successfully dispatched by connecting job opportunities with independent contractor process servers. You negotiate fairly with both clients and servers and learn from every job outcome. Your work directly shapes the client experience, server relationships, and marketplace economics in the territory you own.

What you'll do

  • Own a territory. Become the subject-matter expert on the operational requirements (e.g., regional licensing and coverage rules) for the regions you're assigned.
  • Keep jobs moving and own your queue. Match every job in your territory to a process server quickly and manage your dispatch requests so work doesn't pile up. Meet SLA targets and make the best decision for our clients and the process servers.
  • Build relationships with servers. Servers are independent contractors who choose which jobs to take. Call, text, and email them respectfully and professionally. Take notes on their preferences. Find solutions that work for both sides of the marketplace.
  • Communicate with clients. Handle client conversations by phone and email, negotiating the path that works best for everyone.
  • Negotiate fair pricing. Set prices that work for the server and the business, and hold the line when it counts.
  • Document everything. Keep records of client and server communications and the decisions you made on the job.
  • Improve as you go. Spot inefficiencies in your workflow. Share pricing and network gaps with the broader team to strengthen the market.
  • Support your peers. Help teammates solve problems when they ask. Contribute to an overall team that runs better because you're on it.
  • Use data to learn. Use data and dashboards to track your own performance, identify trends, and improve your decisions and workflows.

Who you are

  • A customer-oriented communicator. You're respectful and kind, even when things are hard or moving fast.
  • Composed under pressure. Tense conversations don't rattle you. You stay calm and professional.
  • Detail-oriented and organized. You don't let things slip through the cracks. Your task queue stays clean. You write clear notes that support your decisions.
  • A negotiator. You can hold a price, explain the why, and find creative paths forward when the first option doesn't work.
  • Data-curious. You're comfortable opening a dashboard, asking a question, and using the answer to improve your work.
  • A team player. You help peers when they ask. You bring ideas to your manager. You make the team better.
  • Adaptable. You're comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment, and you pick up new tools and procedures quickly.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of professional experience (dispatch, logistics, operations, customer service, or related).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable making outbound phone calls every day.
  • Experience or natural ability building trust-based relationships, especially with independent contractors or other partners.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments with frequent change.
  • Proficiency in MacOS and Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Slides).
  • Rapid learner — able to embrace new technology and new procedures quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience in dispatch, logistics, or operations.
  • Experience on a marketplace or gig economy platform.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools for self-serve analytics.

Compensation & Location

  • Full-time, hourly
  • Anticipated compensation range of $41,600–$47,840 paid on an hourly basis, eligible for overtime earnings.
  • Eligible for company bonus plan

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401(k) options
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) and paid holidays
  • Company equipment provided

E-Verify

This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer, Interim
jobs.description:
Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 100+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.2 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

Opportunity & Impact

Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. The Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 90+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.6 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

We’re a fully remote team within the U.S. that operates with radical transparency and a strong bias toward ownership.

Impact on Team:

As Interim Chief Financial Officer for a venture-backed health tech company, you will lead the finance function while we search for our permanent CFO. Your job is to keep finance running smoothly, give the CEO and leadership team accurate, timely financial insight, and keep momentum on our growth and cash priorities. This is a hands-on role: you will lead a small, capable finance team and work alongside them, not just oversee the work. You will also set the function up for a smooth handoff to the permanent CFO.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Financial Operations and Reporting: Own the monthly close, financial statements and management reporting. Keep reporting accurate, timely and compliant with applicable standards.

  • Cash Management and Forecasting: Manage cash and maintain a rolling forecast. Give the CEO a clear, current view of the business and the trade-offs between growth investment and cost.

  • Budgeting and Planning: Finalize and manage the annual operating plan and budget with the CEO and executive team.

  • Board of Directors (BOD) Engagement: Prepare board financial materials and present financial results and analysis at board meetings.

  • Team Leadership: Lead and support the finance team, including pricing and FP&A, through the transition. Keep priorities clear and the team engaged.

  • Deal and Pricing Support: Work with Sales and the CEO to price and structure complex customer deals.

  • Audit, Tax and Compliance: Coordinate the annual audit, tax filings and other compliance requirements with external partners.

  • Transition to Permanent CFO: Document key processes, priorities and open issues, and onboard the permanent CFO once hired.

What You'll Bring:

  • Proven track record as a CFO or senior finance leader at a SaaS or technology company, including interim or fractional engagements.

  • Experience at venture-backed, growth-stage companies, and comfort with a fast-moving, scrappy environment.

  • Background in health tech, ideally with exposure to data interoperability or provider, payer and health tech vendor markets.

  • Ability to step in quickly, learn the business within weeks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.

  • A hands-on style: comfortable running the close, building models and pricing deals yourself.

  • Experience preparing board materials and presenting to boards and investors.

  • Strong command of cash management, forecasting and SaaS metrics.

  • A creative, solutions-oriented approach: you bring options, not just constraints.

  • Clear communication and the executive presence to work with a direct, debate-oriented leadership team.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work, and the ability to bring AI into how you and the finance team operate.

  • CPA, or a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.

  • MBA (preferred, but not required)

Who You'll Be Engaging With:

  • CEO and the executive leadership team

  • Board of Directors and investors

  • Finance team, including pricing and FP&A

  • Sales team, on complex customer deals

  • External audit, tax and compliance partners

  • The permanent CFO, during the transition

Compensation

Compensation: The pay range for this position is expected to be between $140 to $155 per hour.

Additional Information

About Redox - Take a look here: https://youtu.be/4OjENXR6UXA

What We Do

Healthcare organizations and technology vendors connect to Redox once, then authorize what data they send to and receive from partners through a centralized hub. Redox's cloud-based platform is vendor and standards-agnostic and enables the secure and efficient exchange of healthcare data.

This approach eradicates the need for point-to-point integrations and accelerates the discovery, adoption, and distribution of patient and provider-facing technology solutions. With hundreds of healthcare organizations and technology vendors exchanging data today, Redox represents the largest interoperable network in healthcare. Learn how you can leverage the Redox platform at www.redoxengine.com.

Other Stuff About Us

Redox is an EEO company. We fully support the diversity of our team! Read more about our stance on diversity and belonging: Diversity at Redox

As part of our ongoing work to build more diverse teams at Redox, you will be asked to complete a voluntary EEO survey when applying. This survey is anonymous, we cannot link your application record with your survey responses. We request that you complete this voluntary survey as we run monthly reports for each team which provides data for diversity in terms of gender and ethnic background in our Applicants and our Hired Redoxers. We take this data very seriously and appreciate your willingness and time to complete this step in the process.

We believe in holding ourselves to a high standard of conduct. Here's how we think about this: Redox Code of Conduct

Successful candidates must be eligible to be employed in the U.S. and must reside & work in the continental U.S.

Thank you for your interest in Redox!

jobs.title: Founding Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Founding Sales Engineer (NY, NY or US Remote)

Why we're hiring

Tracebit is helping some of the world's best security teams at Snyk, Docker, Riot Games and many more to achieve an 'assume breach' strategy at scale. Tracebit detects intrusions in critical environments using canaries - decoy assets deployed to deceive attackers.

We're at a massive inflection point and there has never been a more exciting time to join us:

  • We've built a product that security teams love. You'll be our founding Sales Engineer (a key part of our Customer Engineering team), helping build the technical foundation for how we grow our customer base and deliver outcomes at scale.

  • We are backed by some of the best investors in the space (Accel, FirstMark and more).

  • We are growing very quickly (we doubled ARR last quarter), having recently closed some incredible customers that we can't disclose publicly!

  • We are one of the most exciting startups to be part of in cybersecurity, have seen some great feedback from the market and are ready for explosive growth.

  • We have strong traction in the US (80% of our customer base and forward-looking business). We've hit product-market fit and it's time to accelerate our growth by building our US presence.

  • Regularly featured on top startup lists from industry veterans... Creandum's Euro Seed top 50 list, Sifted's 2025 London Startups To Watch, Notions Cloud Top 100, AlbionVC's NHI Breakdown, MMCs Proactive Security Analysis, Accel's Euroscape Top Startups 2024, etc.

  • Trusted by teams at Docker, Chainguard, Xbow, Riot Games, Snyk and more.

  • Our research has recently helped fix a P1 security flaw in Google's Gemini CLI.

Who we're looking for

You have strong technical sales experience. You've spent 3-5 years in a customer-facing technical role at a B2B SaaS company, ideally in cybersecurity or developer tooling. You don't need to code, but you understand and have experience in areas such as cloud infrastructure or DevOps and can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives.

You learn technical concepts quickly. You can rapidly grasp new technical concepts and translate them into clear value propositions. You're comfortable diving into technical documentation and asking smart questions to fill knowledge gaps.

You work well with GTM teams. You understand the sales process and know when to lead technical discussions versus when to support account executives. You can identify technical blockers and work collaboratively to overcome them.

You're comfortable in startup environments. You've experienced the pace of an early-stage company and this pace excites you. You can handle ambiguity, build processes from scratch, and adapt quickly as priorities shift.

About the role

You'll report directly to Bryan O’Neil, our Director of Customer Engineering. You'll partner closely with sales, product, engineering, and directly with our customers to ensure successful evaluations and wider outcomes via our platform.

Your core focus:

  • Run discovery calls and product demos. Partner with sales to understand prospect requirements and deliver tailored demos that showcase how Tracebit solves their specific challenges. Adjust your approach based on whether you're talking to a CISO or a security engineer.

  • Design and execute PoVs. Scope Proof-of-Values that demonstrate clear alignment within prospect environments. Guide customers through setup, monitor progress, and ensure successful outcomes and technical wins.

  • Build technical sales collateral. Input on demo scripts, technical one-pagers, architecture diagrams, and FAQ documents that help prospects understand our platform. Make it easy for AEs to have informed technical conversations.

  • Provide technical guidance throughout the sales cycle. Address questions about security, compliance, and integrations. Work with engineering when deeper expertise is needed. You will be a Tracebit SME.

  • Feed product insights back to the team. Bring customer feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence to product discussions. Help shape what we build based on market needs.

  • Represent Tracebit at events. Attend key cybersecurity conferences to run technical demos, answer questions, and build relationships with prospects.

FAQs

Where is the office?

We're establishing our New York office in Manhattan. You'll work closely with our London team and other US team members as we grow.

Are you doing hybrid/remote?

We are an office-first company - all of our team works together in the office 5 days a week. However, we're making an exception for this role given the nature of the work and the need to hire the best talent in this space.

If you're based in New York, you'll work from our office. If you're remote, we expect you to come to the office at least quarterly to collaborate with the team in person.

We think 9am-6pm will bring a great cadence to work. As a founding team member, there will definitely be times you need to pick up work outside of these hours, we're keen to limit this where we can but also offer flexibility in return.

Can you sponsor visas?

You must have the right to work in the US.

jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: US-based, remote, covering AMER customers.

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Within a year you are successful if…

  • Net retention across your book has grown, and you can name the renewals and upsells that did it

  • You have found and qualified new opportunities inside your existing customers, and converted or handed off a good number of them

  • Your customers are live and ramping volume, with their executive sponsors still engaged

  • Customers come to you first, on their compliance programme and on their commercial relationship with us

What you will be doing:

  • Owning enterprise customers from signature onward: implementation, adoption, business reviews, renewal and expansion

  • Mapping each customer for growth across adjacent business units, entities, regions and products, and working with Sales to close the net-new ones

  • Running your own renewals and upsells, including pricing, commitments and the conversation with the economic buyer

  • Running business reviews early enough to shape the renewal outcome

  • Working directly with customer integration teams: API documentation, test calls, transaction and webhook data, and a clear diagnosis when something is stuck

  • Guiding customers through their Travel Rule programmes and their stablecoin payment products

  • Keeping long implementations on track. FIs take months to go live and ramp slowly, and executive attention has to be held for all of it

  • Building relationships across compliance, operations, engineering and the C-suite, so the relationship never rests on one contact

  • Bringing customer and competitor insight back to product, sales and marketing

  • Keeping records current in HubSpot

  • Some on-call duty outside office hours

What you bring:

  • Based in the US, able to cover AMER customers

  • Senior experience in Customer Success or Account Management at a crypto, fintech or regtech SaaS company, or in another complex technical market, owning enterprise customers

  • Comfort with technical products. You can work through API documentation, read a request and response, form a view on why an integration is behaving the way it is, and hold that conversation with a customer's engineers

  • Commercial ownership. You have run your own renewals and upsells, negotiated pricing and carried a retention or expansion number

  • A history of growing customers you already had, and comfort working with Sales on what you surface

  • A doer. You own the detail yourself, and you move without waiting for a process to exist

  • Patience for enterprise: long cycles, slow ramps, decisions made by committee

  • Experience across the full lifecycle, from onboarding through to expansion

  • Good judgement with people and real interest in solving their problems

  • Credibility with an integration engineer and with a CFO

  • Comfortable working autonomously and getting stuck in

Nice to Have

  • Travel Rule, stablecoin payments or digital asset compliance experience

  • Time at a company that moved up-market into enterprise

  • Solutions engineering, implementation or technical account management background

  • Experience with banks and regulated financial institutions entering digital assets

  • Having built Customer Success processes and playbooks from scratch

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

Own customer onboarding and delivery

  • Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.

  • Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.

  • Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.

  • Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

Technical implementation

  • Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.

  • Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.

  • Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.

  • Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.

  • Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.

  • Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

Debug and troubleshoot

  • Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling

  • Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.

  • Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

Bridge the customer and engineering

  • Talk to engineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation.

  • Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion.

  • Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words.

  • Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value.

Use AI tooling to scale your work

  • Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes.

  • Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use.

What you'll bring:

Essential

  • Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips.

  • Creative thinking and problem-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them.

  • Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome.

  • Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer-facing technical role or substantial project work.

  • Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set-up to live use of a technical product.

  • API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors.

  • Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements.

  • Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture.

  • Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge.

  • Cloud Services. You understand core cloud-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE.

  • Demonstrable use of AI tooling. You can show real examples of using AI to troubleshoot, script or automate, and you can say where it fell short.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Wurl, LLC.

At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.

In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.

Staff Platform Engineer:

Wurl is seeking a Staff Platform Engineer to build and operate the systems that power our ad-serving and streaming platforms. You’ll be the key technical leader driving the vision and evolution of the infrastructure foundation that enables our teams to deploy, scale, and observe high-throughput, low-latency workloads serving hundreds of thousands of requests per second.

You’ll own the platform layer, ensuring it’s reliable, cost-efficient, and measurable, while enabling multiple engineering teams to deliver world-class video and advertising experiences.

Responsibilities

Platform Infrastructure & Automation

  • Define, architect, and set standards for composable IaC (CDK or Terraform) patterns for Cloud Infrastructure (EKS).
  • Drive the adoption and implement composable, idempotent, multi-environment GitOps workflows.
  • Optimize scalability and cost-per-performance using metrics-driven automation and autoscaling technologies such as Karpenter.

Observability & Reliability

  • Develop and maintain observability across the platform using Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts with application teams to define SLOs and capacity models for mission-critical services.
  • Lead major production incident response efforts, drive blameless postmortems, and mentor other engineers on production incident response, postmortems, and reliability reviews.

Delivery & Culture

  • Create and operate resilient CI/CD pipelines for safe, rapid deployments and rollbacks.
  • Champion automation, low-toil operations, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Develop agentic workflows utilizing the team-wide context layer and operational data to accelerate development without compromising reliability.
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor to elevate the team, with a strong ability to listen, evaluate, and give constructive feedback on ideas.

Requirements

Core Experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in architecting, deploying, and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems in cloud production environments, ideally in Platform, SRE, or DevOps roles. Prior ownership of a stateful deployment
  • Deep expertise in systems-level coding skills for automation and systems development (Go, Python, or TypeScript).
  • Proven experience operating Kubernetes at scale (EKS preferred) and applying IaC patterns (CDK, Terraform).
  • Working knowledge of GitOps and reconciliation loops in Kubernetes controllers.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline)

Operational Excellence

  • Expert in defining, designing, and optimizing global monitoring and alerting pipelines (PromQL, metrics correlation, alert noise reduction).
  • Experience with large-scale streaming or ad-serving workloads, including HTTP-based delivery (oRTB, VAST), event streaming (Kafka), and AWS network architecture (VPC, load balancers, peering)
  • Understanding of cloud security best practices (IAM, encryption, network segmentation, zero trust).
  • Proven ability to conduct deep performance analysis, tuning, and optimization across the entire infrastructure stack to achieve optimal cost-per-performance and latency targets.

A Plus if you have:

  • Experience with advanced GitOps patterns using Github Workflows.
  • Exposure to extended observability tools such as Loki or Tempo
  • Experience designing or operating distributed, high-throughput stateful data pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient data flow.

What We Offer:

  • Strong Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits, 100% paid by Wurl
  • Remote first policy

  • 10 US Holidays
  • 401(k) Matching

  • OneMedical subscription for 24/7 convenient medical care
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave for all family additions
  • Discounted PetPlan and easy at home access to Covid testing with empowerDX

Few companies allow you to thrive like you will at Wurl. Join us to revolutionize the way the world watches television while enjoying mentorship, collaboration, and innovation.

We encourage all applicants, even those who don’t meet 100% of the requirements, to apply. Passion and potential go a long way here at Wurl.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Finance Manager to be the finance partner to the people who run our manufacturing network. You’ll own the financial picture for our manufacturing sites and our third-party lab network, and help operators fully understand their cost structure and identify opportunities.

This is a role for someone who wants to be close to the physical business. You’ll spend real time in the details of overhead absorption, cost per unit, and vendor economics, and you’ll also be in the room when we decide whether to buy a piece of equipment, open or consolidate a site, or bring work in-house. It’s a high-ownership seat with visibility across Operations and Finance leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Manufacturing Site Leads. Own the finance relationship with each site. Make sure every site lead knows their budget cold, understands what’s driving their variances, and has what they need to act on it. Be the person they call before they make a decision, not after.

  • Partner with the 3P Labs team. Bring financial clarity to the routing decisions this team owns. Build the analysis that shows what each routing choice costs us, and make sure the trade-offs are understood in real time — not discovered at close.

  • Run the operations monthly close. Lead pre-close and prelim close meetings with site leads: align with Cost Accounting in advance, set clear expectations with attendees, drive follow-ups to completion, and ensure every variance explanation is properly quantified and owned.

  • Own the accuracy of manufacturing COGS. Perform expense detail review on fixed overhead COGS to confirm costs are booked correctly. Analyze third-party lab costs to validate routing. Run gold and precious metals margin analyses to confirm we’re pricing to our markup targets.

  • Make the process better every month. This close is not in its final form. We want someone who treats each cycle as an opportunity to remove manual work, tighten timelines, and raise the quality of what comes out the other side.

  • Support strategic decisions. Build the analysis behind manufacturing equipment purchases, manufacturing footprint decisions, and insource vs. outsource evaluations — and have a point of view on the answer, not just the model.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of finance experience, including meaningful time in a physical-product business in a high growth environment

  • Demonstrated success partnering with operators. You’ve built strong working relationships with operators and can translate between operational reality and financial impact in both directions.

  • Strong ownership of recurring processes. You’ve run a close, a forecast cycle, or a reporting cadence and left it better than you found it.

  • Excellent modeling skills - proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and also comfort w/ automating spreadsheet work with Claude Co-Work or other AI tools. Comfortable getting into large, messy datasets.

  • Exceptional communication skills — able to distill complex analysis into a clear recommendation for an executive audience.

  • Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity. You’re willing to have backbone with senior stakeholders and push for the right answer.

Req ID: J-1224

Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, architecture, platform engineering, and customer delivery.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building, coding, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with customers on mission-critical initiatives involving APIs, AI gateways, service connectivity, modernization, and cloud-native platforms.

You will collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure successful customer outcomes while also influencing Kong’s product direction based on field experience.

Working at Kong is a unique opportunity to make a massive impact on Fortune 50/500 customers as they modernize mission-critical systems for the AI era.

What’s in it for you?

Impact

Work directly with some of the world’s largest enterprises to modernize API infrastructure and accelerate AI adoption through Kong’s connectivity platform.

Growth

Accelerate your technical and professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, AI connectivity, automation frameworks, and large-scale enterprise architectures.

Opportunity

Be part of a rapidly growing Professional Services organization that is shaping how enterprises adopt APIs, AI gateways, and modern connectivity platforms globally.

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, platform engineering, professional services, site reliability engineering, or software engineering roles.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering and implementation experience.

  • Experience with API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure expertise.

  • Experience building automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling.

  • Strong proficiency in Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Programming experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, or Lua.

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tooling such as Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or GitOps frameworks.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Passion for innovation, modern infrastructure, APIs, AI, and cloud-native technologies.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

The Client Coding Project Manager will provide superior quality by performing audits pertaining to risk adjustment coding efforts. jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM People Business Partner
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring a Senior Director, GTM People Business Partner to be the senior people leader for our global go-to-market organization. Reporting to our Chief People Officer, you will sit on the Chief Revenue Officer’s leadership team and partner with the leaders of Direct Sales, Sales Engineering, Sales and Business Development, Channels, Revenue Operations and Enablement across the Americas, EMEA and APJ.

This is a builder’s role at a pivotal moment. Kong’s Series E is funding global go-to-market expansion, our field teams are growing across more than a dozen countries, and our sales motion is moving from API management to AI connectivity. You will shape how the revenue organization is designed, led, paid and grown, and lead the People Business Partners who support it.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the CRO and GTM leadership. Be the people voice on the CRO’s staff: org, talent, leadership and culture counsel, and the translation of each year’s revenue plan into a people plan.

  • Design the GTM organization for its next stage. Lead coverage-model changes, spans and layers, regional structures, and role architecture and leveling for sales, solutions engineering, SDR/BDR, partner and enablement roles, including new AI-connectivity selling roles.

  • Run headcount and capacity planning. With Finance, Revenue Operations and Talent Acquisition, build the ramp-adjusted capacity model, sequence hiring by territory and start date, and run a monthly GTM hiring review.

  • Govern sales compensation. With Global GTM Compensation and Total Rewards, shape plan philosophy, OTE and pay-mix benchmarks, quota-setting fairness, rollout, exceptions and disputes.

  • Build the GTM performance system. Run quarterly talent and attainment reviews, calibration, promotion criteria and fair, fast performance management across US, EMEA and APJ employment law.

  • Build the sales leadership bench. Assess first- and second-line leaders, own succession plans for the CRO’s leadership team, coach senior leaders, and launch a front-line sales manager program with Sales Enablement.

  • Shorten ramp and keep top performers. Define 30/60/90 plans with Enablement and Talent Acquisition, track time to quota, find the causes of early attrition and run targeted retention plans.

  • Protect culture, inclusion and engagement in the field. Own the GTM engagement read and the actions that follow, manager effectiveness, belonging and the norms of a distributed team.

  • Own employee relations and people risk for GTM. Lead investigations, restructures and international employment compliance across more than a dozen countries, with Legal and regional People leads.

  • Bring the data. Build the GTM people dashboard (attrition, ramp, attainment distribution, span of control, hiring velocity, representation) and present it at every QBR.

  • Lead the people side of change. Territory realignments, comp-plan changes, reorganizations, acquisition integrations and the field’s shift to AI connectivity.

  • Lead the GTM People Business Partner team and help shape Kong’s People operating model, including how AI and automation change HR work.

What You’ll Bring:

• 12+ years in People, including 5+ years as the lead business partner to a CRO, Chief Sales Officer or SVP of Sales at a B2B software company that at least doubled revenue during your

tenure.

• A background in infrastructure, developer-platform, API, cloud or open-source software. You know how technical sellers, solutions engineers and channel teams work, and how an open-source funnel feeds enterprise sales.

• Experience designing sales organizations with Finance and Revenue Operations: coverage models, spans and layers, role architecture, leveling and ramp-adjusted capacity plans.

• Fluency in sales compensation: OTE and pay-mix benchmarking, quota setting, accelerators and SPIFs, plan rollout, exceptions and disputes, and plans for usage-based products.

• A track record running performance management and talent reviews for quota-carrying teams in the US and in EMEA or APJ, including exits and restructures under different employment laws.

• Experience assessing and developing sales leaders, building succession plans for a revenue leadership team and coaching VP-level executives.

• Data fluency: you build and defend a people dashboard and bring analysis, not anecdotes, to a CRO staff meeting.

• Executive presence and judgment that a CRO and a CPO both trust, with speed and discretion on sensitive issues.

• Based in Southern California, or able to spend regular time in person with GTM leadership, with travel to San Francisco and the field.

How You’ll Work:

You are in the room before the decision, not after it. You say what the data says,

including to the CRO, and you leave managers more capable than you found them.

Nice to Have:

• You have been through a platform-to-AI shift in a company’s sales motion.

• You have integrated an acquired team into a sales organization.

• You have worked in a People function that uses AI and automation in recruiting and operations.

• You have partnered Customer Success and Business Development as well as direct sales.

• You have built or led a team of People Business Partners.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Junior Expansion Account Executive
jobs.description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across Mexico, team members located within 80 kilometers of our Guadalajara office (Calle Amado Nervo 2200, Jardínes del Sol, 45050 Zapopan, Jal.) are expected to work onsite to support collaboration, speed, and execution.

Drive Customer Growth. Deliver Better Outcomes.

As an Junior Expansion Account Executive, you’ll drive revenue growth within Nextiva’s existing small business customer base. This is a high-velocity sales role where you’ll proactively reach out to customers, uncover opportunities, and deliver solutions by connecting customer challenges to the value of Nextiva's AI-Powered Platform. You’ll support US-based customers, with customer interactions and day-to-day work conducted in English.

You don’t need a traditional sales background to succeed here. We’re looking for people who have demonstrated success against revenue-related targets, whether in sales, account management, retention, collections, or another commercially focused customer role—and are ready to build their career in technology sales.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Drive Expansion Revenue: Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within Nextiva's existing small business customer base.
  • Create Opportunities: Proactively engage customers through outbound calls, email, SMS, and other channels rather than waiting for leads.
  • Understand the Customer's Business: Engage small business customers across a variety of industries, ask effective questions, uncover business challenges, and connect their needs to the right Nextiva solutions.
  • Position Nextiva's AI-Powered Solutions: Clearly articulate the value of Nextiva’s platform, including AI-driven capabilities that improve customer experience and business outcomes
  • Demonstrate Value: Deliver focused product demos and clearly explain how Nextiva’s solutions can help customers achieve better business outcomes.
  • Move Quickly: Manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up to keep a high-velocity sales cycle moving.
  • Own Your Pipeline: Manage opportunities from outreach through close while maintaining accurate pipeline, activity, and forecasting information in Salesforce.
  • Continuously Improve: Apply coaching, performance insights, and AI-enabled tools to continuously improve your customer conversations, productivity, results, and product knowledge.

What Success Looks Like

You’re motivated by growth—both in the results you deliver and the career you’re building. You take ownership, follow through on commitments, and bring energy and resilience to a fast-paced sales environment. You’re coachable, curious, and willing to keep learning.

Successful Team Members

  • Consistently meet or exceed expansion revenue targets
  • Are comfortable creating opportunities through proactive outbound outreach
  • Represent Nextiva professionally in customer conversations, including video meetings.
  • Build rapport quickly, and confidently move customer conversations toward an outcome
  • Stay organized while managing multiple customer conversations and opportunities at once
  • Bring consistency and discipline to follow-up, keeping opportunities moving
  • Respond well to coaching and quickly put feedback into practice
  • Stay resilient, learn from setbacks, and maintain momentum in a performance-driven environment
  • Effectively incorporate AI tools into your workflows to improve speed, quality, customer experience, and outcomes.

Experience matters, but mindset and execution matter more. This role is a strong fit for someone building or transitioning into a career in technology sales, where effort, consistency, and a growth mindset translate directly into success.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years' experience in a customer-facing role where you were directly accountable for revenue-related goals or targets, in a fast-paced environment
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding those goals
  • Advanced English fluency, both spoken and written, with the ability to simplify complex and/or technical concepts
  • Comfort with frequent outbound customer conversations and proactive outreach
  • The ability to thrive in a high-velocity environment with short, fast sales cycles
  • A professional, customer-ready presence and communication style. You’ll regularly interact directly with customers by phone, email, and video
  • Business curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different customers, industries, and business needs
  • Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail
  • Coachable, with demonstrated ability to apply feedback to improve performance
  • Self-motivated and resourceful, you take ownership of your work and take initiative to solve problems
  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI and technology; motivated to continuously learn, apply new tools, and build your sales and product knowledge

Relevant experience can come from many backgrounds. Examples include roles with sales quotas, upsell or cross-sell goals, customer retention/save targets tied to revenue, collections or recovery targets, account growth, or other commercially focused performance goals.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
  • Exposure to SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecommunications, or other technology products
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM
  • Experience supporting US-based customers in a B2B environment
  • Exposure to AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) in a professional setting

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
  • Opportunity to grow and advance your career with a company at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

  • Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
  • Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
  • Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

  • Health 🍏- Major Health insurance for you, your legal partner, and children under 25 years, including Vision and Dental coverage
  • Insurance 💼- Life Insurance (24 times your monthly salary)
  • Work-Life Balance ⚖️ - Newly hired full-time employees at Nextiva receive 10 personal days before their first anniversary, 12 vacation days on their first anniversary, and 5 personal days annually thereafter in addition to vacation time
  • Financial Security 💰- Enjoy a 30-day Christmas bonus, 50% vacation premium, company-matched food vouchers (1 UMA/month), and a 13% matched savings fund (capped at 1.3x annual UMA)
  • Wellness 🤸‍- Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives
  • Growth 🌱- Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

#LI-AL1 #LI-Remote

Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform.

Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about? Connect with us on Instagram, Instagram MX, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the Nextiva Blog.

jobs.title: Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
ReSpark - Field Implementation Manager

Location: Remote

The opportunity:

ReSpark is a fast-growing start-up pioneering the future of the industrial scrap recycling industry ($120bn and growing!). We serve the world's leading industrial recyclers, helping them transform industrial and consumer scrap into new, usable materials. Our platform modernizes end-to-end workflows within the scrap recycling industry and is the core solution on which their business runs.

We are seeking a proactive Field Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience Team. This role will help drive progress on customer implementations including hardware configuration, end-user training, and workflow recommendations.

There will be travel involved (~30%) to visit customer sites and drive in-person hardware configuration and product training required for going live on the platform. This is a remote position.

About ReSpark

ReSpark is a venture-backed SaaS company formed through the merger of GreenSpark Software and ReMatter — the two leading modern operations platforms for metal recyclers. Together, we serve over 1,200 metal recycling facilities around the world.

Despite being a crucial part of the recycling ecosystem, the $120B+ scrap metal industry has long lacked intuitive, modern software for managing metal transactions, inventory, and yard operations. ReSpark exists to change that. With 12 years of combined production experience, our platform follows the metal all the way through the yard — from point of purchase through ultimate sale — all under one roof.

Today, we're building the AI-first operations layer for the recycling industry: an agentic platform that doesn't just digitize scrap yard workflows, but actively runs them.

We're a mission-driven team of innovators built on principles of competitive greatness, autonomy, and collaboration. Our culture is one of transparency, mutual respect, and constructive feedback — all aimed at collective progress and a brighter, more sustainable future.

As an Implementation Manager, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end software implementations for new ReSpark customers
  • Travel to scrap yards for in-person go-lives and training on a regular basis
  • Become an expert on the ReSpark product, its use cases for recyclers, and how ReSpark helps recyclers operate more efficiently and improve business outcomes
  • Configure customer hardware supporting ReSpark’s software platform such as IP cameras, scales, and printers
  • Lead virtual and live end-user trainings during and after onboarding
  • Hone your customer experience skill-set including clear communication, expectation-setting, problem-solving, and more

We’re looking for someone that has:

  • 4+ years of prior success in a customer-facing role, preferably in training, support, or a related function in a SaaS environment
  • Prior work experience with Windows operating system, remote desktop software, and other software/IT programs
  • Experience installing and setting up hardware (E.g. cameras, scales)
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • A positive attitude and can-do mindset
  • Strong self-motivation, grit, and a competitive spirit
  • A customer-first mindset and bias towards action
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment

Nice to have:

  • Fluent Spanish is a huge plus!

Benefits:

  • Flexible time off policy to balance your work and life
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k)
  • Great start-up culture

ReSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ReSpark’s employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Compensation Range: $85,000-$95,000
