jobs.title: Technical Oversight - Processing
jobs.description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Oversight - Processing with deep mortgage operations experience and strong independent judgment. This is not a traditional customer support or relationship-only role. You will act as a senior operational partner to our originating customers, owning issue resolution end-to-end and ensuring loans move cleanly, compliantly, and predictably through the lifecycle.

You will work directly with customers while collaborating closely with underwriting, processing, product, and engineering to reduce errors, prevent rework, and improve system-driven workflows. This role is ideal for someone who has worked inside the loan file, understands where mortgages break, and is motivated to help build scalable, automated systems that eliminate those failures over time.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about operating with rigor today while helping design the future of automated mortgage infrastructure, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Origination Ownership

  • Act as a operational point of contact for originating customers, owning issue resolution from identification through closure

  • Guide customers through the full loan lifecycle, providing clear, accurate direction on requirements, timelines, disclosures and next steps

  • Own the operational health of assigned loans end-to-end, ensuring files progress on schedule and close on time by proactively identifying blockers, driving resolution, and coordinating across internal teams and customers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Travel & Hospitality
jobs.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

The client is building a socially connected travel platform that enables users to discover, rent, and exchange homes through trusted personal networks.

The product combines elements of home sharing, social networking, payments, trust and safety, and home exchange. An initial mobile product has already been developed, and the company is preparing for a broader public launch, starting with approximately 200 homes in the United States.

The company is now entering its next phase, focused on strengthening the existing product, improving the user experience, expanding the web experience, and building a scalable foundation for future growth.

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Designer to help evolve an existing MVP into a polished, intuitive, and launch-ready product.

The designer will work closely with the Founders, technical leadership, and engineering team to review and improve the existing mobile experience, identify usability gaps, refine key user journeys, and translate product requirements into high-quality mobile and web designs.

The mobile product already has an MVP/beta application and existing Figma assets, while the web experience is less mature and will require more new design work.

This role requires strong product thinking and the ability to work with an imperfect existing product, challenge assumptions, and help distinguish launch-critical functionality from future enhancements. Business priorities and technical direction will be provided by the leadership team.

Responsibilities

  • Review and evolve the existing product and its Figma assets.

  • Collaborate with product and technical leadership to refine the existing MVP experience, identify UX gaps, and prioritize improvements for the initial US launch.

  • Translate business and product requirements into intuitive user flows and interfaces.

  • Improve and evolve the existing React Native mobile experience while designing new responsive web experiences aligned with the core mobile product.

  • Improve key product journeys, including:

    • Onboarding and account creation.

    • Home discovery.

    • Social and trusted-network interactions.

    • Home listing.

    • Booking and rental flows.

    • Home exchange.

    • Payments.

    • Messaging and communication.

    • Trust and safety workflows.

  • Identify usability inconsistencies and opportunities to simplify the current product.

  • Create wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and reusable design components.

  • Maintain and evolve the product's design system.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are feasible and accurately implemented.

  • Provide product design recommendations, challenge assumptions, and help leadership distinguish launch-critical UX improvements from future enhancements.

  • Help create a consistent experience across mobile and web.

  • Contribute to product documentation so future team members can understand key UX decisions and flows.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Proven experience improving and evolving existing consumer products, ideally taking an MVP or beta product toward production or public launch.

  • Strong experience designing consumer digital products.

  • Excellent product thinking and UX fundamentals.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma.

  • Experience designing both mobile and responsive web applications.

  • Ability to work within an existing product rather than exclusively on greenfield projects.

  • Experience working directly with engineers and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and design systems.

  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage environment where requirements continue to evolve.

  • Ability to balance product quality with the need to ship quickly.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with travel, marketplaces, social platforms, booking products, or consumer marketplaces.

  • Experience designing payment or checkout flows.

  • Experience with social graphs, messaging, or community-driven products.

  • Experience working with React Native products.

  • Front-end development knowledge or the ability to collaborate closely with front-end engineers.

  • Experience with design-to-code or AI-assisted product development workflows.

  • Experience helping companies transition an early MVP into a scalable production product.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

Apply now!

jobs.description:

Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Description

Our Business Technology team is looking for a Senior Security Operations Engineer to own the security of the tools, devices, identities, and data Fleetians rely on every day. You will help run corporate security operations end to end, covering detection and response, identity, endpoint, email, and SaaS security, data loss prevention, AI security, and vulnerability management, and make the day-to-day security calls that keep Fleetio safe.

You will be hands-on: engineering controls, writing and tuning detections, automating response, and closing gaps, not just administering tools. The goal is one connected defense, not a collection of consoles: a signal from Okta, CrowdStrike, Mimecast, or Google Workspace should drive action in the others automatically, so the environment protects itself and people step in only where judgment is needed. Around-the-clock monitoring is handled by our external SOC (CrowdStrike Falcon Complete); this role engineers the environment it watches, owns what happens when it escalates, and extends what it can see. You will work closely with our IT Operations and Compliance teams, our 3rd party SOC, and the Product Security team in Platform Engineering.

Our team treats AI as a core part of how we work. We build and use AI agents and automated workflows to handle toil, speed up investigation and response, and give our team more time for high-leverage work.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate is a security engineer who likes to build. You are as comfortable writing a detection or a response playbook as you are working an incident. You think in systems: you see the gaps between tools and close them by wiring the tools together. You make sound security decisions on your own, explain them clearly to technical and non-technical people, and balance risk with how people actually work.

You stay calm when something breaks. You can take a vague report, work out quickly what happened and who is affected, and give leaders a clear, evidence-backed answer. Then you fix the root cause so it doesn't happen the same way twice.

You're curious about how AI is changing security operations, and you're eager to put it to work on triage, enrichment, and response.

Your Impact

As a Senior Security Operations Engineer on Fleetio's Business Technology team, you will:

  • Own detection engineering and threat hunting in CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM: onboard log sources, write and tune detections across identity, email, SaaS, and endpoint telemetry, and keep false positives down
  • Own security automation: chain our tools together through CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR and our workflow automation platform so a signal in one (a risky Okta sign-in, a Falcon detection, a Mimecast hit, a Google Workspace sharing change) triggers enrichment, containment, paging, and ticketing in the others, plus AI agents that speed up triage and investigation, so routine response runs without waiting on a human
  • Lead corporate incident response as technical lead, including third-party and supply-chain events: scope exposure quickly, confirm or rule out compromise, run forensics, tell leaders and employees what to do, keep runbooks current with Product Security, and serve in the escalation rotation, backing up the Incident Commander when needed
  • Own CrowdStrike Falcon configuration and detections, manage the Falcon Complete relationship and escalations, and maintain device trust checks and an inventory of software and extensions on company devices with clear guidance on approved tools
  • Own Okta authentication policy, MFA, session policy, and privileged access management, and automate user access reviews and audit evidence with Compliance so SOC 2 controls run with less manual effort
  • Own Mimecast policy, secure network access, Google Workspace and key SaaS security settings, and SaaS security posture in CrowdStrike Falcon Shield, driving findings to closure with app owners
  • Own data loss prevention: define and classify Fleetio's sensitive data, design and tune DLP policies across email (Mimecast), Google Workspace, endpoints (CrowdStrike), and key SaaS apps, and investigate and respond to data exposure, whether from accidental oversharing, a compromised account, or insider misuse
  • Own security for Fleetio's use of AI: visibility into AI tool usage, identity and access for AI agents, guardrails for internal agents and automations, and AI detection and response (CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian, formerly AIDR)
  • Run vulnerability management for corporate assets, prioritizing by exploitability and holding owners to fix deadlines, and report on security posture with clear, honest metrics that help set program priorities

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, detection and response, or security engineering, ideally at a SaaS company
  • Detection engineering and threat hunting in a SIEM (CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM or similar)
  • Security automation: building SOAR playbooks (CrowdStrike Fusion or similar) that connect identity, endpoint, email, and SaaS tools into a single response flow, with Python or PowerShell and REST APIs
  • Incident response from first triage through forensics, root cause, and follow-up across cloud, identity, and SaaS environments, including working with an MDR or managed SOC provider
  • Identity security with Okta or a similar provider: authentication policy, privileged access, and access reviews in a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 control environment
  • Endpoint security with CrowdStrike or similar, including macOS, plus device trust and endpoint query tooling
  • Email security (Mimecast or similar) and SaaS security posture management
  • Designing and running a DLP program: data classification, policy design and tuning across email, cloud collaboration, and endpoints, and investigating data exposure
  • Securing developer tooling and the software supply chain (IDE extensions, package registries, AI coding tools)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining risk to non-technical leaders

Considered a Plus

  • Experience securing a company's use of AI: AI tool governance, identity and access for agents, data-exposure and prompt-injection risk, and AI detection and response tooling (CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian/AIDR or similar)
  • Experience building AI agents, LLM-powered automations, or integrations (e.g., using tool/function calling or MCP) for security operations workflows
  • Experience using LLMs on real security alerts for triage, enrichment, and investigation

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)

  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you’re driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

You’ll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform’s technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you’ll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don’t run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn’t the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll be up to

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you’ll bring to the team

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you’ve used.
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don’t have a dedicated QA function.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up.
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany.
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options.

Where you’ll work from

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We’re also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

jobs.title: Procurement Advisory Services (contract)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Partnerships Team

The Partnerships team sources, negotiates, and manages external relationships behind DuckDuckGo's products, from AI model and cloud infrastructure providers to distribution, content, and monetization partners. Alongside that work, the team also handles a steady stream of vendor deals for the software, tooling, and service contracts that keeps the company running.

Our Need

We are seeking a well-established, independent Procurement Advisor Practice to advise the partnerships team in DuckDuckGo's vendor selection, procurement and negotiations. Our procurement efforts cover a broad set of vendors including collaboration tools, AI services, SaaS, analytics and data tools, developer tooling, and professional services. We are seeking a procurement advisory practice that will provide our team with counsel on needs scoping, vendor identification, vendor conversations, price negotiations strategies and benchmarks, and guidance on proposed terms. DuckDuckGo remains responsible for our internal processes and approvals, and for signing vendor contracts.

Advisory Practice Profile

  • 10+ years advisory practice in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with a focus on software and SaaS. Your practice has provided direction on hundreds of contracts and has deep enough experience to provide clients with guidance on where the leverage usually is.

  • Your practice has a well-established approach to commercial and contractual details -- including deep experience in providing guidance on order forms, MSAs, and DPAs terms, a time-tested methodology for vendor comparison, and proven track record of working across a client organization including with legal, security, finance, product, engineering.

  • Your practice has sufficient capacity to advise many small deals in parallel, each with a different internal owner.

  • Your practice has deep experience in providing deal advisory across a broad set of vendors: collaboration, recruiting, analytics, developer tooling, data and research subscriptions, professional services.

  • Your practice has a proven track record of building trust quickly with client teams, providing clear client communications, and working asynchronously across multiple time zones in North America and Europe.

  • Your practice cares about privacy and has experience in navigating data handling and security issues with clients and vendors.

  • Your practice is an established business: an operating entity or registered sole proprietorship with other current clients, its own professional liability insurance, and client references available on request.

  • Your practice is located in the US.

Engagement Details

We expect the scope of work to cover an estimated 3 to 5 deals per month (estimated approximately 15-20 hours per week) compensated by a fixed rate, with pricing for additional volume set out in the statement of work, starting with an initial six-month term with the option to extend. This is a business-to-business services engagement, not employment. Your practice will deliver advisory services remotely on its own schedule with working sessions scheduled by mutual agreement. Your practice will use its own equipment, tools, and methods. jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
About Us:

Nivoda: Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎

At Nivoda, we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.

We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.

Our Mission

The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.

The Engineering & RevOps Team

Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. You’ll consolidate and harden what we’ve built, retire legacy tools into Salesforce, and help shape what comes next: deeper Sales Cloud capability, exploring Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud, and putting Salesforce’s newer AI features, including Agentforce, to real use.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Consolidate processes and tooling into Salesforce, replacing point solutions and manual workarounds with flows, Apex and native features

  • Build and maintain Sales Cloud improvements: lead and opportunity automation, routing and round-robin, stage gates, Lightning pages and LWCs

  • Prototype and deliver Agentforce and AI use cases with RevOps, such as rep assistants, next-best-action and record summaries

  • Support the exploration and rollout of Service Cloud (e.g. Cases for onboarding and support processes) and Marketing Cloud

  • Build back-end Salesforce solutions — writing Apex code, managing workflows, process automation, and API integrations

  • Maintain integrations with our GTM stack (Snowflake, Gong, Customer.io, Shopify), working with our data engineering team to keep data clean after the migration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer and Supplier-facing teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions

  • Take part in sprint planning, effort estimation and prioritisation, and deliver on sprint commitments

  • Work a shared sprint backlog with our other Salesforce developer: peer-review code, share on-call bug fixing, and keep documentation current

  • Document everything you build — create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure smooth handovers and maintainability

What do we need from YOU?

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (essential)

  • Strong Apex coding skills — you write clean, efficient, well-documented code

  • Solid SQL skills and ability to build and map APIs and integrations

  • 2–5 years of Salesforce development experience, ideally in a scaling company

  • Confident with Flow, LWC, SOQL and the Salesforce deployment lifecycle (sandboxes, change sets or SFDX, version control)

  • Strong Sales Cloud experience; exposure to Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud a plus

  • Self-motivated with a strategic mindset — you identify problems before they become fires

  • Collaborative: comfortable sharing a codebase, reviewing others’ work and taking feedback

  • Strong documentation habits — you leave things better than you found them

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II, Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud certifications

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS businesses

  • Background in companies at Series A–D stage where you’ve built things from scratch

  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing tools

  • Experience stabilising or consolidating an org after a CRM migration

  • Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein or Prompt Builder

Our culture and what we offer

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.

Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company.
Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.

jobs.title: GTM System Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:

Nivoda: where innovation and gemstones meet

At Nivoda, we help jewellery retailers and gemstone suppliers trade more easily. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery businesses of all sizes with global diamond and gemstone supply.

Nivoda has more than 400 employees across the world. Our platform helps buyers and sellers trade diamonds and gemstones securely, efficiently and at competitive prices.

The Data & Financial Platform team

The Data & Financial Platform team owns Nivoda's data platform plus the shared financial capabilities of the marketplace. Its job is to make core data and financial systems reliable, useful and scalable.

This role sits in the team but works day to day with GTM. You will work with the Head of Data, engineers, analysts, Sales and Marketing as we rebuild Nivoda's GTM infrastructure.

About the role

Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.

You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io, enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.

What would you be doing?

  • Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.

  • Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.

  • Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.

  • Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.

  • Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.

  • Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.

  • Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

What do we need from you?

  • 2+ years in software, systems or integration engineering. You have shipped real integrations or services using APIs, webhooks or event-driven systems.

  • Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. Working SQL plus confidence using Git and code review.

  • Experience integrating with business systems such as CRM, payments, finance, marketing or operations platforms. Salesforce experience is useful but not required.

  • You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders. You can challenge an unclear request and turn the underlying need into something buildable.

  • You can learn unfamiliar systems quickly, then choose the simplest solution that will hold up in production.

  • You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators - Public Sector

As the Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators (FSI), you will lead joint capture and channel coordination across Datadog's federal systems integrator and prime-contractor ecosystem, serving as the connective tissue between those partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams. You will make sure capture activity happening inside FSI partner organizations is visible to, aligned with, and reinforced by Datadog's own federal sellers, and vice versa, so that partner-led and direct-led motions strengthen a pursuit rather than duplicate or collide with it. The role reports to the Channel & Alliances (C&A) organization and works cross-functionally with federal sales, distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft), deal desk, and legal to drive joint capture outcomes on priority federal pursuits.

Travel: Less than 25%

Clearance: An active U.S. government security clearance is preferred but not required. Candidates without an active clearance are encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the joint-capture strategy and partner alignment for a portfolio of approximately 20 priority federal programs, engaging 12-24 months ahead of RFP release
  • Manage each named program as a distinct capture effort, coordinating dedicated engagement across agency stakeholders, FSI partners, and independent software vendors (ISVs)
  • Identify requirements, shape acquisition strategy, engage agencies, primes, and partners, and position Datadog ahead of procurement
  • Act as the primary liaison between FSI partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams, ensuring each side knows what the other is doing on a given program
  • Build and maintain a documented capture plan for each named program covering mission, stakeholders, funding, acquisition path, competition, partners, Datadog's position, and next milestone
  • Identify and resolve channel conflict early, surfacing where a partner-led and direct-led pursuit are converging on the same account or contract vehicle and brokering a single aligned approach
  • Partner with distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft) to keep pricing, SKU naming, and quoting consistent across contract vehicles, including the GSA Schedule and SEWP (Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement)
  • Coordinate teaming strategy with FSI partners, including how partners team with primes and other systems integrators, and flag most-favored-nation (MFN) or pricing-consistency issues to deal desk before they become customer-facing problems
  • Coordinate Requests for Information (RFIs) and sources-sought responses in partnership with federal sales, solutions engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders. This role shapes response strategy and reviews submissions but is not solely responsible for authoring them.
  • Advance qualified pursuits through customer discovery, partner teaming, and architectural inclusion, then transfer qualified pursuits to Account Executives (AEs) and Partner Sales Managers (PSMs) for execution
  • Build durable working relationships with FSI partner capture and Business Development (BD) leads and with Datadog's federal account teams so coordination happens proactively, not only when escalated

Who You Are:

This role carries defined leading indicators rather than a direct bookings quota, since captures in this motion typically run 12-24 months before transferring to an AE/PSM for close. jobs.title: VP, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Team: Finance (G&A)

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.

Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.

We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.

Why this role & why now

You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.

What you will own

Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.

Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.

Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.

Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.

Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.

Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.

What good looks like

First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.

90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.

Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.

The standard

A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.

Three things must not fail in this role.

  • Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.

  • Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.

  • Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.

That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.

What you bring

  • A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.

  • You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.

  • You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.

  • A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.

  • You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.

  • You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.

Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.

What this role is not

It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.

It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.

What we offer

Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it.

Our current benefits include:

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • Participation in our equity programme

  • Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development

  • The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale

Interview Process

  • Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition

  • Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager

  • Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team

  • Final conversation with the C-suite

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool

If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - German Speaking (Europe)
jobs.description:
Location: Remote in the Europe

Salary: Competitive base + Commission

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

About the Role 🤔

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.

  • Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.

  • Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.

  • Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.

  • Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.

  • Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.

  • A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.

  • Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.

  • Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.

  • Native or professional proficiency in English and German is required for this role.

  • Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

Not quite the right fit?

If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience across our participant-facing ecosystem: web, native mobile, and our Chrome extension.

You combine sharp interaction and visual craft with systems-level thinking, keeping the experience unified across both platforms. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering in a fast-paced environment powered by AI-augmented workflows.

You default to extreme ownership. You define the product vision, hold the bar for what ships, and identify critical gaps before anyone asks.

This is a wide-scope, fully hands-on IC role focused on driving participant growth. As you get up to speed and evaluate the ecosystem, we expect you to identify where design bottlenecks lie and make the case for how we scale the function over time.

How we work

AI environments like Claude and Cursor are first-class design tools here. We don’t throw static specs over the fence or get bogged down in alignment decks. Instead, we use AI tooling to spin up interactive prototypes and live code early, letting us test real interactions and iterate on actual software.

We operate as curious, low-ego builders who value showing over theorizing. We share unfinished work early, critique often, and solve problems collaboratively across disciplines. You will have a direct hand in shaping both our product ecosystem and the way we build together.

What you'll do

  • Set cross-surface product vision: Define and drive the design direction across mobile, web, and our Chrome extension, ensuring the ecosystem feels intuitive, cohesive, and unified.
  • Act as a core product thought partner: Collaborate across multiple PM work streams to sharpen product strategy, deconstruct complex problems, and find simpler, faster paths to release.
  • Execute hands-on at high velocity: Design core flows, components, and high-fidelity interfaces yourself, leveraging modern AI tooling to maintain quality across a wide footprint.
  • Bridge design and native engineering: Work in lockstep with engineers to navigate platform-specific constraints, inspect implementations, and ensure production releases match the intended design fidelity.
  • Evaluate and evolve design infrastructure: Audit our component libraries and design tokens across all surfaces, establishing a scalable foundation and identifying where future design investments or resources are needed.
  • Drive collaborative product discovery: Partner with Product and Research to uncover participant needs, while independently spotting usability gaps and growth bottlenecks to shape upcoming initiatives.
  • Directly inspect post-launch performance: Pull data, synthesize participant feedback, and query product telemetry directly via AI tools and MCPs to iterate fast on live features without waiting in a reporting queue.

What you bring

  • Senior-level multi-surface craft: Shipped portfolio work showing exceptional visual and interaction design across native mobile, web, and extensions.
  • Design system governance: Proven experience building, maintaining, and governing design systems in direct partnership with engineering, including keeping components, design tokens, and interaction patterns aligned across multiple connected platforms.
  • Strong systems thinking: You naturally look for recurring patterns, reusable frameworks, and structural solutions rather than one-off fixes, without sacrificing visual polish or interaction craft.
  • AI-native daily workflow: Hands-on mastery of modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and production design.
  • High technical fluency: Deep interest in frontend implementation details, component architecture, and the mechanics of how software gets built.
  • Vision plus execution: Comfort operating at 30,000 feet to shape product strategy, then immediately dropping down to design high-fidelity details.
  • Extreme agency & ownership: You identify problems before anyone flags them and own the quality bar from kickoff through release.
  • Comfort with evolving environments: High resilience and autonomy inside a fast-moving team that is actively establishing its operating model.

Nice to have

  • Marketplace experience: Background designing for two-sided marketplaces, dual-sided user journeys, or platform dynamics.
  • Front-end fluency: Practical experience writing code (especially modern React, HTML, and CSS) to build production-grade prototypes or ship interface polish directly.
  • Micro-interaction & motion craft: Hands-on experience with motion design (e.g., Rive, Lottie, or code-based transitions) to bring nuance, feedback, and personality to interface states.
  • Mentorship & leadership instincts: Experience mentoring other designers, leading design crits, or helping scale a small design function.

Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager.

About Dscout

Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we’re at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us - how in-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.

We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world’s most loved brands.

It doesn't stop there. When you join the Dscout team, you will get:

  • A strong and competitive compensation package with a built-in bonus and equity program.
  • An incredible and progressive benefits package (for both you and your dependents) to support work/life balance, including flexible PTO, 15 company holidays, 12 weeks of paid parental leave, 401k match, and much more.
  • An education stipend to support your growth & development, and a remote work stipend.
  • A company that is open and transparent with our team. You will know what is happening and why it matters.

Dscout is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity. We do not discriminate based on identity, including race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged or sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

If you need reasonable accommodations for any part of the employment process, please email us at accommodations@dscout.com with the nature of your request and your contact information. We'll do everything possible to ensure you're well-prepared for success during our interview process, while also upholding your privacy, including accommodating any special requests. Please note that only inquiries regarding requests for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

When you apply at Dscout, we will process your job applicant data, including your employment and education history, transcript, writing samples, and references, as necessary to consider your job application for open positions. For more information about our privacy practices, please visit our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Manager, Accounts Payable
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager, Accounts Payable to lead Accounts Payable and Expense operations. This role will manage individual contributors and may oversee team leads while ensuring invoices, payments, reconciliations, tax reporting, and employee expenses are processed accurately and on time.

The Manager, Accounts Payable will own team performance and execution while driving process improvements, automation, and reporting. You will work across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and other teams to resolve complex issues, strengthen controls, and improve the procure-to-pay experience.

The ideal candidate is a reliable people leader who uses business context and data to make decisions, advises stakeholders, and delivers measurable operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop AP and Expense team members.
  • Manage team performance, staffing, workload allocation, and day-to-day execution.
  • Build a high-performing team with clear expectations, strong accountability, and consistent results.
  • Oversee invoice processing, purchase order matching, coding, approvals, payments, vendor inquiries, and employee expense operations.
  • Ensure AP and Expense activities are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies and controls.
  • Own balance sheet reconciliations, AP close activities, accrual support, aging reviews, and related reporting.
  • Lead annual 1099 reporting and support other AP-related tax and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the primary AP contact for internal and external audits, ensuring requested documentation is accurate and complete.
  • Monitor unmatched invoices, open purchase orders, payment exceptions, duplicate payments, credits, and other outstanding items.
  • Identify inefficiencies across AP and Expenses and lead process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability;
  • Drive automation and AI initiatives related to invoice processing, matching, approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, and reporting.
  • Develop reporting and insights using tools such as Zip, Ramp, Tableau, ERP systems, and other operational data sources.
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics, including processing volume, aging, cycle times, exception rates, and on-time payments.
  • Partner across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and business teams and lead cross-functional initiatives when needed.
  • Evaluate complex issues using business context, advise team members and stakeholders, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Escalate risks and issues that could affect costs, controls, service levels, or short-term business goals.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in accounts payable, Expenses, accounting operations, or procure-to-pay, including people-management experience.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, manage performance, and deliver reliable results.
  • Experience owning and improving an operational area with measurable impact.
  • Strong knowledge of invoice processing, purchase orders, payments, expense management, reconciliations, accruals, and the monthly close.
  • Experience managing 1099 reporting and supporting internal and external audits.
  • Experience using procurement or finance platforms such as Zip, NetSuite, and Ramp.
  • Sound judgment when addressing diverse challenges, applying policies, and escalating financial or operational risks.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and reliability in a high-volume environment.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. jobs.title: Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Playson

Playson builds premium casino games and platform solutions for operators worldwide. Our products reach millions of players across regulated markets, and we ship frequently - which means our certification and compliance evidence has to be as well-engineered as the games themselves.

We are hiring a Software Developer, Compliance, to own that engineering: a pipeline that lets us ship faster and safer, and a defence of the platform and the games that holds up in front of a lab, an ISO assessor, and a future SOC 2 auditor.

About the role

You are a software developer sitting inside compliance. You will build and continuously evolve a secure compliance pipeline so we can ship games and platform changes faster and safer - and you will be the technical person who defends what we shipped when an auditor, a certification lab, or a regulator asks.

The scope is not games alone. You will stand in front of game certification labs, and you will also defend the platform: ISO certification of our systems and the evidence work that leads into a future SOC 2 audit. In every case, the job is the same. You produce the proof. You walk the auditor through it. You answer the question that was asked, with the evidence that was requested, and you stop there.

You will own the technical side of game certification. You take a game math package from the review channel to the lab, you produce the evidence the lab needs - build hashes, PAR sheets, configuration snapshots, version manifests - and you answer the lab's technical questions yourself, without a developer sitting next to you. When a certificate comes back, you are the person who confirms every deficiency is closed before the game is allowed past the pre-release gate.

Between lab submissions, you treat the pipeline as a product. Manual evidence collection, one-off screenshots, and tribal knowledge are the things you replace. You automate controls, tighten the audit trail, and shorten the path from "ready to ship" to "ready to show an auditor" without weakening the bar. Faster and safer at the same time is the point of this role - not one at the expense of the other.

What we're looking for

  • You are a developer first. 3+ years writing production code, comfortable reading someone else's codebase and forming your own opinion about what it does. You are not a documentation coordinator who learned some technical words

  • Strong Node.js and TypeScript. Our game math packages, engine integration, rules and bets migrations, test suites, and compliance automation are all JavaScript-side. You will read game math code and verify that what it does matches what we told the lab it does - and you will write the tooling that makes that check repeatable

  • You know what it takes to build certified products. You have worked for an iGaming game provider, a lottery, or another business where products require certification. You understand how that shapes development, testing, and releases, and why the code and supporting evidence need to stay aligned.

  • You build pipelines, not checklists. You have taken a manual, high-stakes process and turned it into something engineered: automated evidence, versioned artefacts, gates that fail closed

  • You can read data and write queries. SQL against a production analytics store, log investigation, understanding a metrics pipeline well enough to tell a real control failure from a broken dashboard

  • Composure in front of an auditor. In a lab session, an ISO assessment, or a future SOC 2 walkthrough, you answer the question that was asked with the evidence that was requested. You communicate with auditors and certification labs precisely and factually. You provide complete evidence for the question or control being assessed, avoid speculation, and escalate regulatory interpretations to the Head of Compliance

  • You know where your authority ends. When a question moves from technical fact to regulatory interpretation or commercial consequence, you route it to the Head of Compliance instead of improvising

  • You write clearly and permanently. Compliance evidence is read years later by people who were not in the room. Your documentation has to survive that

  • You are comfortable saying no. You will be the person telling a squad, under release pressure, that their change does not pass the gate. That conversation needs to be calm, specific, and final

  • Precise by temperament. You check the version number rather than remembering it. You are not bored by an audit trail

Nice to have

  • Direct dealings with a certification lab (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, iTech Labs, or similar) or a gaming regulator

  • Hands-on evidence work for ISO 27001, SOC 2, or an equivalent information-security audit

  • Understanding of RNG, RTP mathematics, and how statistical certification evidence is produced

  • Familiarity with multi-jurisdiction licensing (UKGC, MGA, and regulated EU and LatAm markets)

  • Observability and alerting tooling - Datadog or equivalent, including building automation on top of it rather than just reading dashboards

  • Experience with change-management controls, audit trails, and segregation-of-duties models

  • Incident response experience, particularly where the incident had a regulatory or audit dimension

What you can expect on this role

  • A role with real authority: you hold gate sign-off, and a release does not go past you without it

  • Genuine engineering work - you own the compliance pipeline as a product, not a pile of checklists with a technical title

  • Direct exposure to certification labs, ISO assessors, and the path to SOC 2 - rare and portable experience

  • Close collaboration with math, QA, platform, and SRE across games and the platform

  • A compliance function that is being built up deliberately, with room to shape how it works

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary

  • Quarterly Bonuses

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Unlimited Paid Sick Leave

  • Remote & Flexible Working

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Financial Support for Life Events

  • Professional Development Budget

  • International Exposure

  • Regular Company Events

*Benefits may vary depending on location and contractual agreement

Join us today!
